title: 🔥 THE TRUTH AND LIES ABOUT GUARDIAN ANGELS – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE REALLY SAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE TRUTH AND LIES ABOUT GUARDIAN ANGELS – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE REALLY SAY? 🔥
📖 Hebrews 1:14 – "Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?"

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I’ve always been told that everyone has a personal ‘guardian angel’ watching over them. Some people even pray to their guardian angels for protection. Is this true? What does the Bible really say about guardian angels?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people have grown up believing in guardian angels, but most of what is taught today is based on tradition, Hollywood movies, and false teachings—not the Bible!
🚨 Let’s separate biblical truth from deception and expose the lies about guardian angels!

🔥 1. BIBLICAL TRUTH: ANGELS ARE REAL AND THEY SERVE GOD!
📖 Psalm 91:11 – "For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways."
🔥 YES! The Bible clearly teaches that angels exist, and they serve God’s purposes!

✔️ Angels are messengers of God. (Luke 1:26 – "The angel Gabriel was sent by God.")
✔️ Angels protect God’s people. (2 Kings 6:16-17 – Elisha’s servant saw an army of angels protecting them!)
✔️ Angels fight spiritual battles. (Daniel 10:13 – The angel Michael fought against demonic forces!)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
When Peter was in prison, an angel appeared and freed him from chains! (Acts 12:7-10)
👉 Angels are powerful servants of God, sent to fulfill His divine will!
🚨 BUT NOWHERE DOES THE BIBLE SAY WE EACH HAVE A "PERSONAL" GUARDIAN ANGEL!

🔥 2. LIE: EVERY PERSON HAS A PERSONAL "GUARDIAN ANGEL"
📖 Matthew 18:10 – "See that you do not despise one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven."
🔥 Some people misunderstand this verse and assume it means every person has a guardian angel—but that is NOT what Jesus said!

✔️ Jesus did not say "their angels protect them"—He said they stand before God.
✔️ Angels are assigned by God according to His will, not to every person individually.
✔️ Nowhere in Scripture does it say every person has a specific angel following them.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If every person had a personal guardian angel, why didn’t Paul’s angel protect him from being beaten, shipwrecked, or imprisoned?
👉 Because angels are NOT assigned to serve human desires, but God’s divine plan!
🚨 THERE IS NO BIBLICAL EVIDENCE THAT EVERY HUMAN HAS A PERSONAL GUARDIAN ANGEL!

🔥 3. LIE: WE SHOULD PRAY TO ANGELS FOR HELP
📖 Colossians 2:18 – "Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you."
🔥 NOWHERE in the Bible does it say we should pray to angels!

❌ Angels are NOT God. (Exodus 20:3 – "You shall have no other gods before Me.")
❌ Angels are NOT mediators. (1 Timothy 2:5 – "There is one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus.")
❌ Angels themselves REFUSE worship! (Revelation 22:8-9 – An angel told John, "Do not worship me! Worship God!")

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Some people pray, “Dear Guardian Angel, protect me!”
👉 But the Bible says we should pray to GOD ALONE! (Matthew 6:9)
🚨 PRAYING TO ANGELS IS A DEMONIC DECEPTION—ONLY GOD ANSWERS PRAYER!

🔥 4. LIE: DEAD LOVED ONES BECOME GUARDIAN ANGELS
📖 Hebrews 9:27 – "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment."
🔥 Humans and angels are COMPLETELY DIFFERENT creations!

❌ Humans DO NOT become angels after death. (Psalm 8:5 – "You have made them [humans] a little lower than the angels.")
❌ Angels were created BEFORE humans. (Job 38:4-7 – Angels witnessed the creation of the world!)
❌ Once a person dies, they go to judgment—not to become an angel!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If your grandmother passes away, she does not become your guardian angel.
👉 She either goes to be with Christ (if saved) or faces judgment (if unsaved).
🚨 LOVED ONES DO NOT BECOME ANGELS AFTER DEATH—THIS IS A FALSE TEACHING!

🔥 5. THE REAL PURPOSE OF ANGELS ACCORDING TO THE BIBLE
📖 Hebrews 1:14 – "Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?"
🔥 Angels are messengers and warriors who serve GOD—not us!

✔️ Angels execute God’s commands. (Psalm 103:20 – "Bless the Lord, O you His angels, who do His word!")
✔️ Angels rejoice when sinners repent. (Luke 15:10 – "There is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.")
✔️ Angels will accompany Jesus at His return. (Matthew 25:31 – "When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.")

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
When Jesus was tempted in the wilderness, angels came to minister to Him! (Matthew 4:11)
👉 Angels exist to serve GOD and His divine plan—not to be our personal bodyguards!
🚨 ANGELS FOLLOW GOD’S WILL, NOT HUMAN REQUESTS!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DO NOT BE DECEIVED BY FALSE TEACHINGS ABOUT ANGELS!
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 – "Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light."
🚨 SATAN USES FALSE TEACHINGS ABOUT ANGELS TO DISTRACT PEOPLE FROM JESUS!

🔥 WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?
❌ Do not pray to angels.
❌ Do not worship angels.
❌ Do not believe Hollywood lies about angels.
✔️ Trust in JESUS CHRIST alone—He is the ONLY Savior!

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Biblical truth about angels?
❌ Or false traditions that lead to deception?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—THE TRUTH WILL SET YOU FREE!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR DISCERNMENT
"Lord Jesus, I repent for believing lies about angels. I choose to trust Your Word over man-made traditions. Keep me away from deception, and help me worship You alone. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE PRODIGAL SON – GOD IS CALLING YOU HOME! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE PRODIGAL SON – GOD IS CALLING YOU HOME! 🔥
📖 Luke 15:11-32 – "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him, and kissed him."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I feel like I’ve strayed too far from God. Does He still love me? Can I ever return?"
🔥 YES! This is exactly why Jesus told the Parable of the Prodigal Son!
🚨 No matter how far you’ve fallen, God is always ready to welcome you back! But the real question is—WILL YOU RETURN TO HIM?
⚠️ WARNING: If you continue to run from God, you will face destruction. But if you turn back, He will restore you!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE PRODIGAL SON?
📖 Luke 15:11-13 – "There was a man who had two sons. The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them. Not long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living."
🔥 MEANING:

✔️ The father represents God.
✔️ The prodigal son represents sinners who run away from God.
✔️ The older son represents self-righteous people who don’t understand God’s grace.
💡 The Prodigal Son wanted his father’s blessings, but NOT his father’s presence—just like many today who only seek God when they need something!
🚨 Are you seeking God for who He is, or just for His blessings?

🔥 2. THE PROBLEM – A LIFE AWAY FROM GOD LEADS TO DESTRUCTION!
📖 Luke 15:14-16 – "After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need. So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs. He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything."
🔥 WHAT HAPPENED TO THE PRODIGAL SON?

❌ He wasted everything. (Luke 15:13)
❌ He ended up in poverty and suffering. (Luke 15:14)
❌ He hit rock bottom—working with pigs, the lowest job for a Jew. (Luke 15:15-16)
💡 SIN ALWAYS PROMISES FREEDOM, BUT IT ONLY BRINGS SLAVERY!
🚨 Are you running from God, thinking you can handle life on your own? Look where it led the prodigal son!

🔥 3. THE TURNING POINT – THE SON REALIZED HIS NEED FOR THE FATHER!
📖 Luke 15:17-19 – "When he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have food to spare, and here I am starving to death! I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired servants.’"
🔥 TRUE REPENTANCE BEGINS WITH RECOGNIZING YOUR SPIRITUAL POVERTY!

✔️ He realized his mistake. (Luke 15:17)
✔️ He humbled himself. (Luke 15:18-19)
✔️ He made the decision to return home. (Luke 15:20)
🚨 THE FIRST STEP TO RESTORATION IS REPENTANCE!
💡 Are you ready to come back to the Father, or will you keep running?

🔥 4. THE FATHER'S LOVE – GOD IS WAITING FOR YOU!
📖 Luke 15:20 – "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him."
🔥 THIS IS GOD’S HEART FOR EVERY SINNER WHO REPENTS!

✔️ He saw him from far away – God is always watching and waiting for your return!
✔️ He RAN to him – In Jewish culture, fathers never ran to rebellious sons, but God’s love breaks all traditions!
✔️ He embraced him and kissed him – God doesn’t just accept you back—He restores you completely!
🚨 YOU DON’T HAVE TO CLEAN YOURSELF UP FIRST—JUST COME HOME!
💡 ARE YOU READY TO RUN BACK TO GOD?

🔥 5. THE OLDER BROTHER – DON’T BE SELF-RIGHTEOUS!
📖 Luke 15:28-30 – "The older brother became angry and refused to go in. He said, ‘Look! All these years I’ve been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.’"
🔥 THE OLDER BROTHER REPRESENTS:

❌ Self-righteous religious people who think they are better than others.
❌ Those who serve God but don’t understand His grace.
❌ People who are bitter when God forgives someone they think is undeserving.
💡 DON’T BE LIKE THE OLDER BROTHER—REJOICE WHEN A SINNER COMES HOME!
🚨 Are you full of grace, or full of pride?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: WILL YOU RETURN TO THE FATHER?
📖 Isaiah 55:7 – "Let the wicked forsake their ways and the unrighteous their thoughts. Let them turn to the Lord, and He will have mercy on them, and to our God, for He will freely pardon."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay lost, broken, and spiritually starving in the world?
✔️ Run back to the Father and receive His love, grace, and restoration?
🚨 GOD IS WAITING FOR YOU—BUT YOU MUST CHOOSE TO COME HOME!
💡 Will you make the decision to return to Him today?

🙏 PRAYER TO RETURN TO GOD!
"Father, I have sinned against You. I have run away and tried to live life on my own, but I am broken and empty without You. Forgive me, Lord. I choose to return to You today. Restore me, change me, and help me live for You alone. Thank You for Your grace and love. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 DID THE ROMAN EMPIRE ACCEPT PAUL’S TEACHING? HOW PAGANISM INFILTRATED THE CHURCH! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 DID THE ROMAN EMPIRE ACCEPT PAUL’S TEACHING? HOW PAGANISM INFILTRATED THE CHURCH! 🔥
📖 2 Corinthians 11:13-15 – "For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ. And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, the Roman Empire accepted Paul’s teachings, right? That’s when the Catholic Church was built, but later, it was mixed with pagan worship. Is this true?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people assume that the Roman Empire "converted to Christianity" and became a true Christian nation. But is that what really happened?
🚨 Let’s go back in history and uncover the truth!

🔥 1. DID THE ROMAN EMPIRE REALLY ACCEPT PAUL’S TEACHING?
📖 Acts 9:15 – "But the Lord said to Ananias, ‘Go! This man [Paul] is my chosen instrument to proclaim my name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.’"
🔥 Paul preached the true gospel of Jesus Christ, but the Roman Empire DID NOT accept it. Instead, they persecuted Christians for over 250 years!

✔️ Christians were imprisoned, tortured, and executed under Roman emperors like Nero, Domitian, and Diocletian.
✔️ Paul himself was beheaded in Rome under Emperor Nero.
✔️ The early church remained underground because Rome rejected biblical Christianity.
💡 FACT: The Roman Empire did not "convert" to Christianity—it only pretended to in later years!
🚨 TRUE CHRISTIANITY AND THE ROMAN EMPIRE WERE NEVER FRIENDS!

🔥 2. WHEN DID THE ROMAN EMPIRE CLAIM TO BECOME CHRISTIAN?
📖 2 Thessalonians 2:3 – "Let no one deceive you in any way. For that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction."
🔥 Everything changed in AD 313, when Emperor Constantine legalized Christianity with the "Edict of Milan."

✔️ Before Constantine, Christianity was illegal, and Christians were persecuted.
✔️ After Constantine, Christianity became "acceptable"—but it was mixed with pagan Roman traditions.
✔️ By AD 380, Emperor Theodosius made "Christianity" the official religion of Rome—but it was no longer pure biblical Christianity!

💡 FACT: The "Christianity" that Rome accepted was NOT the same Christianity that Jesus and the apostles taught.
👉 It became a religion of the state, controlled by government leaders—not led by the Holy Spirit!
🚨 THE MOMENT CHRISTIANITY BECAME A GOVERNMENT RELIGION, IT WAS CORRUPTED!

🔥 3. HOW DID PAGANISM INFILTRATE THE CHURCH?
📖 Deuteronomy 12:30 – "Be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, ‘How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same.’"
🔥 Rome mixed biblical Christianity with pagan Roman beliefs. Here’s how it happened:

✔️ Worship of Roman gods was replaced with "saints" and "Mary."
✔️ Pagan holidays (like Saturnalia) were "Christianized" into Christmas and Easter.
✔️ Pagan temples were converted into "churches" instead of being destroyed.
✔️ The Roman emperor declared himself the "head of the church"—replacing Christ’s authority.

💡 FACT: Many unbiblical Catholic traditions (like praying to Mary, purgatory, and the veneration of relics) came from these pagan influences.
👉 Instead of standing firm in the truth, Rome compromised with false religions!
🚨 WHEN THE CHURCH COMPROMISES WITH THE WORLD, IT LOSES ITS POWER!

🔥 4. WHAT DID THE TRUE CHURCH DO DURING THIS TIME?
📖 Matthew 16:18 – "I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it."
🔥 The TRUE church of Jesus Christ never joined Rome’s corrupted version of Christianity!

✔️ True believers rejected the Romanized version of "Christianity" and remained faithful to Scripture.
✔️ They were persecuted, driven underground, and labeled as "heretics" by the Roman church.
✔️ Despite persecution, the true church survived—because Jesus promised that His church would never be destroyed!

💡 FACT: The real followers of Christ never accepted a government-controlled religion.
👉 The TRUE church remained separate from Rome’s false version of Christianity!
🚨 NOT EVERYONE WHO CLAIMS TO BE CHRISTIAN IS FOLLOWING CHRIST!

🔥 5. WHY DOES THIS MATTER TODAY?
📖 Colossians 2:8 – "See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than on Christ."
🔥 Many people today still follow church traditions that came from Rome, NOT from the Bible!

✔️ Are you following man-made traditions or the Word of God?
✔️ Do you obey the Bible, or do you trust church leaders more than Scripture?
✔️ Would you rather be accepted by the world or stay faithful to Christ?

💡 FACT: The Bible is the FINAL authority—not any church or religious leader!
👉 We must follow JESUS, not religious systems created by men!
🚨 ONLY THE WORD OF GOD LEADS TO SALVATION—NOT RELIGIOUS TRADITIONS!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: MANY CHURCHES TODAY ARE STILL COMPROMISING!
📖 2 Timothy 4:3-4 – "For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear."

🚨 Many modern churches are doing the SAME THING Rome did:
❌ Compromising truth to please the world.
❌ Mixing Christianity with false beliefs.
❌ Turning churches into entertainment centers instead of places of worship.

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Follow man-made religion and traditions?
✔️ Stand firm in the Bible and follow JESUS CHRIST ALONE?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ The TRUTH that saves?
❌ Or a religion that pleases the world but leads to destruction?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—YOUR SOUL DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO STAY IN GOD’S TRUTH
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to see the truth. I reject every false teaching and every compromise. Fill me with wisdom to follow Your Word alone. Let me stand firm in my faith, no matter what. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 IS TITHING JUST ABOUT MONEY? THE TRUTH MOST CHURCHES WON’T TELL YOU! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 IS TITHING JUST ABOUT MONEY? THE TRUTH MOST CHURCHES WON’T TELL YOU! 🔥
📖 Romans 12:1 – "Present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship."

Most churches today teach that tithing is about giving 10% of your income. Every Sunday, pastors quote Malachi 3:10 to tell people they are "robbing God" if they don’t give financially. But is tithing just about money?
🚨 What if God wants more than your money? What if true biblical tithing is about your entire life, not just 10%?
👉 Let’s break free from tradition and see what the Bible actually teaches!

🔥 1. THE OLD TESTAMENT TITHE WAS NEVER JUST ABOUT MONEY
📖 Deuteronomy 14:22-23 – "Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year... so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always."
The original tithe was not about money—it was about giving back to God what He had already given.

🔥 The tithe in the Old Testament included:
✔️ Crops and harvests (Leviticus 27:30)
✔️ Livestock and animals (Leviticus 27:32)
✔️ Special feasts and offerings (Deuteronomy 14:23)
❌ NOWHERE does the Bible say that tithing was strictly about money!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a farmer in ancient Israel. He didn’t go to the temple and drop money in a basket—he gave the first fruits of his harvest, his best livestock, and his time in service to God.
👉 Tithing was about giving the BEST of what God had blessed you with—not just finances!

🔥 2. THE NEW TESTAMENT NEVER COMMANDS CHRISTIANS TO TITHE MONEY
📖 2 Corinthians 9:7 – "Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver."
🔥 The New Testament never commands believers to give a mandatory 10%!

❌ Jesus never told His disciples to tithe money.
❌ The apostles never told the early church to tithe money.
❌ Nowhere in the New Testament is financial tithing a command.
Instead, Jesus and the apostles taught giving from the heart, led by the Spirit.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a poor widow gives her last $5 to God, while a rich businessman gives 10% of his millions but has no true sacrifice, who gave more in God’s eyes?
📖 Mark 12:43-44 – "This poor widow has put in more than all the others... she gave out of her poverty, but they all gave out of their wealth."
👉 God is not looking for a fixed percentage—He is looking for true surrender!

🔥 3. WHAT DID JESUS SAY ABOUT "TALENTS"? IT’S NOT JUST MONEY!
📖 Matthew 25:14-30 – "To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, each according to his ability."
Many people assume that "talents" in this parable refer to money. But in biblical times, a "talent" was a measurement of weight, not just currency.

🔥 Your talents include:
✔️ Your gifts and abilities – Preaching, teaching, music, serving, evangelism
✔️ Your time and energy – Every breath you take belongs to God
✔️ Your life itself – Surrendering everything to His will

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A musician has the ability to write songs for God’s glory. A teacher has the ability to disciple others in the Word. If they only give money but never use their God-given gifts, have they truly given to God?
👉 Tithing is not about 10% of your income—it’s about 100% of your life!

🔥 4. GOD WANTS YOUR WHOLE LIFE, NOT JUST 10%!
📖 Romans 12:1 – "Present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship."
🔥 True giving is not about a percentage—it’s about TOTAL SURRENDER!

✔️ Giving your time in worship and prayer
✔️ Serving others with the gifts God gave you
✔️ Using your career, talents, and passions for God’s glory
✔️ Living every day as a sacrifice, fully committed to Christ

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man faithfully gives 10% of his paycheck every Sunday, but he never prays, never shares the gospel, and never seeks to grow in faith. Has he truly given to God?
🚨 God doesn’t need your money—He wants YOU!

🔥 5. IF TITHING ISN’T REQUIRED, SHOULD CHRISTIANS STILL GIVE?
📖 Acts 2:44-45 – "They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need."
🔥 Giving is not about obligation—it’s about love.

✔️ Give generously to support the work of the kingdom.
✔️ Give to help the poor and those in need.
✔️ Give as the Holy Spirit leads, not as a religious requirement.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If someone is struggling financially, they should not feel pressured to give money. Instead, they can give their time, service, and love to others. Giving should be led by the Spirit, not by guilt or manipulation.
👉 A true giver doesn’t ask, "How much do I HAVE to give?" but "How much CAN I give for God’s glory?"

🔥 FINAL WARNING: STOP LIMITING YOUR GIVING TO 10%!
📖 Matthew 6:21 – "For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also."
🚨 If your giving is only about money, you’re missing the point.

💡 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
✔️ Will you surrender everything to God, including your talents and time?
❌ Or will you hold back, thinking 10% is enough?
📖 Luke 14:33 – "Whoever does not give up everything they have cannot be My disciple."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER OF SURRENDER
"Lord, I give You everything—not just my money, but my time, my talents, and my whole life. Use me for Your glory. Teach me to give freely, without fear or obligation, but with a heart full of love. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THE MOST IGNORED COMMAND OF JESUS: ‘REPENT OR PERISH!’ 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE MOST IGNORED COMMAND OF JESUS: ‘REPENT OR PERISH!’ 🔥
📖 Luke 13:3 – "Unless you repent, you too will all perish."
Many people claim to follow Jesus, yet they ignore His most urgent warning—REPENTANCE.

🚨 The modern church loves to preach about God’s love, blessings, and grace.
❌ But where is the call to holiness?
❌ Where is the message of turning away from sin?
❌ Where is the warning of judgment for those who refuse to repent?

Jesus didn’t say, "Live however you want, and I’ll still accept you."
🔥 He said, "Repent, or you will perish!"
This is the most ignored command in today’s churches. Let’s uncover the truth about repentance and why your eternity depends on it!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO REPENT?
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord."

The Greek word for "repent" is "metanoia" (μετάνοια), which means:
✔️ A complete change of mind
✔️ A turning away from sin
✔️ A radical transformation of heart

🚨 Repentance is NOT just feeling sorry!
❌ Repentance is not just crying after you sin and going back to it.
❌ Repentance is not just saying "Sorry, Lord" but never changing.
❌ Repentance is not just confessing sins while still living in rebellion.

🔥 TRUE REPENTANCE MEANS:
✔️ Turning away from sin and running to Jesus!
✔️ Surrendering your will to obey God’s commands!
✔️ Living differently because you are transformed!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A thief who steals, confesses, but keeps stealing has NOT repented.
A thief who steals, is convicted, and stops stealing—THAT is repentance!
👉 Are you just sorry for your sin, or have you truly repented?

🔥 2. WHY IS REPENTANCE NECESSARY FOR SALVATION?
📖 Acts 17:30 – "In the past, God overlooked such ignorance, but now He commands all people everywhere to repent."
🔥 Without repentance, there is no forgiveness!

✔️ Jesus’ first message was REPENTANCE! (Matthew 4:17)
✔️ John the Baptist prepared the way with REPENTANCE! (Matthew 3:2)
✔️ The apostles preached REPENTANCE! (Acts 2:38)

❌ But today, churches preach "Just accept Jesus into your heart" WITHOUT repentance.
❌ Many people think they can believe in Jesus but continue living in sin.
❌ Many assume that because God is loving, He won’t send them to hell.

🚨 THE TRUTH: THERE IS NO SALVATION WITHOUT REPENTANCE!
✔️ Faith without repentance is false salvation.
✔️ Believing in Jesus without repentance is self-deception.
✔️ Saying "I love God" while living in sin is hypocrisy.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
You CANNOT follow Jesus and still walk in the world.
👉 If you’re still living like the world, have you truly repented?

🔥 3. REPENTANCE VS. RELIGION – DON’T BE FOOLED!
📖 Matthew 7:21 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father."
🚨 Many think they are saved, but they are just religious!

❌ Religion says: "Go to church, give tithes, and you’re saved!"
🔥 Jesus says: "Repent and follow Me!" (Luke 9:23)

❌ Religion says: "God understands if you keep sinning."
🔥 Jesus says: "Go and sin no more!" (John 8:11)

❌ Religion says: "Just say the sinner’s prayer, and you’re saved forever."
🔥 Jesus says: "If you do not repent, you will perish!" (Luke 13:5)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Going to church does not make you saved—REPENTANCE does.
👉 Are you just religious, or have you truly turned away from sin?

🔥 4. WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU DON’T REPENT?
📖 Hebrews 10:26 – "If we deliberately keep on sinning after receiving the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
🚨 Refusing to repent has eternal consequences!

❌ SIN SEPARATES YOU FROM GOD. (Isaiah 59:2)
❌ SIN ENSLAVES YOU TO THE DEVIL. (John 8:34)
❌ SIN LEADS TO ETERNAL DEATH. (Romans 6:23)
🔥 If you die in your sin without repentance, you will face the WRATH of God!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a person knows they have cancer but refuses treatment, they WILL die.
👉 If you know sin leads to hell, why are you refusing to repent?
🚨 HELL IS FULL OF PEOPLE WHO WAITED TOO LONG TO REPENT!

🔥 5. HOW TO TRULY REPENT AND BE SAVED!
📖 2 Corinthians 7:10 – "Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death."
🔥 TRUE REPENTANCE REQUIRES ACTION!

✔️ 1. CONFESS YOUR SINS TO GOD! (1 John 1:9)
✔️ 2. TURN AWAY FROM YOUR OLD LIFE! (Ephesians 4:22-24)
✔️ 3. HATE SIN AND LOVE HOLINESS! (Psalm 97:10)
✔️ 4. FOLLOW JESUS DAILY! (Luke 9:23)
✔️ 5. ASK THE HOLY SPIRIT FOR STRENGTH! (Galatians 5:16)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A person who truly repents doesn’t go back to sin—they fight against it daily!
👉 Are you still tolerating sin, or are you fighting for holiness?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: REPENT TODAY—TOMORROW IS NOT GUARANTEED!
📖 Proverbs 27:1 – "Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring."

🚨 You are NOT promised another day!
❌ Many thought they had time to repent—then they died suddenly.
❌ Many planned to change later—then they faced judgment.
🔥 JESUS IS CALLING YOU TO REPENT TODAY!
👉 WILL YOU OBEY, OR WILL YOU IGNORE HIS WARNING?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR TRUE REPENTANCE
"Lord Jesus, I repent of my sins and turn away from my old life. Forgive me for my rebellion, and make me new! Give me the strength to follow You and walk in holiness. I surrender my heart fully to You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 HOW TO BUILD A CHRIST-CENTERED FAMILY & STAY STRONG AGAINST TEMPTATION! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 HOW TO BUILD A CHRIST-CENTERED FAMILY & STAY STRONG AGAINST TEMPTATION! 🔥
📖 Joshua 24:15 – "But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, with so many divorces, cheating scandals, and premarital sex happening today, how can I make my family Christ-centered? Is there a biblical guide to building a strong home that can resist temptation?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! We live in a time where families are under spiritual attack. The world promotes lust, unfaithfulness, and broken homes, while many ignore God’s design for marriage and family.
🚨 BUT THERE IS HOPE! The Bible gives us powerful guidance on how to build a strong, Christ-centered home that can resist temptation and stand firm in faith!
Let’s dive into BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. CHRIST MUST BE THE FOUNDATION OF YOUR HOME
📖 Psalm 127:1 – "Unless the LORD builds the house, those who build it labor in vain."
🔥 The strongest families are not built on money, success, or feelings—they are built on JESUS!

✔️ Put God first in everything—decisions, parenting, finances, and relationships.
✔️ Make prayer, worship, and Bible study a priority in your home.
✔️ Lead your family to rely on God, not just traditions or emotions.
🚨 Without Christ, any family will crumble under the weight of sin and temptation!
💡 IS JESUS TRULY THE CENTER OF YOUR HOME?

🔥 2. GUARD YOUR MARRIAGE—STOP THE ENEMY BEFORE HE ATTACKS!
📖 Ephesians 5:25 – "Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her."
🔥 Satan HATES strong marriages—he will do everything to destroy them!

✔️ Husbands: Love your wife as Christ loves the Church—selflessly, faithfully, and sacrificially.
✔️ Wives: Respect and support your husband as God commands (Ephesians 5:22-24).
✔️ Communicate daily—do not let small problems grow into big issues.
✔️ Set boundaries to protect your marriage from outside temptations (NO flirting, NO secret friendships with the opposite sex).
🚨 Infidelity, divorce, and broken homes happen when couples FAIL to guard their marriage.
💡 Will you protect your marriage, or let the world destroy it?

🔥 3. TEACH YOUR CHILDREN GOD'S WAYS—NOT THE WORLD'S!
📖 Proverbs 22:6 – "Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it."
🔥 Parents, YOUR role is to raise godly children—the world will not do it for you!

✔️ Teach them to love and fear God—not just on Sundays, but every day.
✔️ Set an example—children learn more from what you DO than what you SAY.
✔️ Monitor their influences—social media, friends, TV, and music can corrupt their hearts!
✔️ Teach them to honor purity and wait until marriage (1 Corinthians 6:18-20).
🚨 If parents don’t disciple their kids, the world will!
💡 Are you leading your children toward Christ—or letting the world lead them away?

🔥 4. AVOID THE SINS THAT DESTROY FAMILIES!
📖 1 Peter 5:8 – "Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour."
🔥 Satan attacks families through temptation. Here are the biggest dangers:

❌ LUST & PREMARITAL SEX – Leads to broken relationships and spiritual bondage.
❌ ADULTERY & CHEATING – Destroys trust and brings judgment (Hebrews 13:4).
❌ DIVORCE & SEPARATION – God’s plan is for a lasting, loving marriage (Malachi 2:16).
❌ BUSYNESS & DISTRACTIONS – Many neglect family time because of work, hobbies, or social media.
❌ ANGER & UNFORGIVENESS – Fights and grudges weaken the family bond.
🚨 If you let these sins enter your home, they will DESTROY it!
💡 Which one is attacking your home? FIGHT BACK with PRAYER and GOD'S WORD!

🔥 5. PRAYER—THE POWER TO PROTECT YOUR HOME!
📖 Joshua 24:15 – "But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD."
🔥 The best weapon against temptation is PRAYER!

✔️ Pray together as a family—daily!
✔️ Husbands, pray for your wives. Wives, pray for your husbands.
✔️ Cover your children in prayer—Satan wants to destroy them!
✔️ Fast and seek God when your family is under attack!
🚨 A praying family is a STRONG family!
💡 Are you fighting your battles in prayer, or letting the enemy win?

🔥 REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – A FAMILY TRANSFORMED!
A man was on the verge of divorce because of his addiction to pornography and his neglect of his wife and children. He thought his marriage was over.
🔥 One day, he heard a sermon on Ephesians 5:25 and realized he had failed as a husband. He repented, started praying, and made Jesus the center of his marriage.
🚨 Today, he and his wife are stronger than ever, serving God together!
💡 GOD CAN RESTORE ANY FAMILY THAT SURRENDERS TO HIM!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: SATAN WANTS YOUR FAMILY DESTROYED—FIGHT BACK!
📖 John 10:10 – "The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full."
🚨 The enemy is attacking families more than ever. If you don’t fight for your home, you will lose it!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Follow the world and risk losing your family?
✔️ Follow Christ and build a STRONG, unshakable home?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE THE BATTLE FOR YOUR FAMILY IS REAL!

🙏 PRAYER FOR A CHRIST-CENTERED FAMILY
"Heavenly Father, I surrender my home to You. Forgive us for any way we have let the world influence our marriage and parenting. Make our family strong in faith, love, and purity. Help us to stand against temptation and walk in obedience to Your Word. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 IS BAPTISM NECESSARY FOR SALVATION? THE BIBLICAL TRUTH REVEALED! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 IS BAPTISM NECESSARY FOR SALVATION? THE BIBLICAL TRUTH REVEALED! 🔥
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast."
Many Christians today are confused about baptism and salvation. Some believe you MUST be baptized to be saved, while others say baptism is only symbolic.

🚨 So what does the Bible really say?
🚨 Is baptism required for salvation, or is it just an act of obedience?
🚨 What happens if someone dies without being baptized?
🔥 Let’s break it down with Scripture and expose the truth!

🔥 1. WHAT IS BAPTISM?
📖 Romans 6:4 – "We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may live a new life."

The Greek word for "baptism" is βαπτίζω (baptizó), which means:
✔️ To be immersed, submerged, or fully dipped in water.
✔️ To symbolize purification and new life.
🔥 Baptism is a public declaration of faith—it represents dying to sin and rising with Christ!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Baptism is like a wedding ring.
👉 It does NOT make you married, but it shows that you are committed!
🚨 Baptism is NOT what saves you—Jesus does!

🔥 2. ARE WE SAVED BY BAPTISM? NO! WE ARE SAVED BY FAITH ALONE!
📖 John 3:16 – "For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life."

❌ The Bible NEVER says baptism replaces faith in Jesus for salvation!
❌ The thief on the cross was NOT baptized, yet Jesus said he would be in paradise! (Luke 23:42-43)
❌ Paul said Christ sent him to preach the gospel, NOT to baptize! (1 Corinthians 1:17)
🔥 SALVATION COMES THROUGH FAITH, NOT WATER!
📖 Acts 16:31 – "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household."

🔥 3. DOESN’T MARK 16:16 SAY BAPTISM SAVES US?
📖 Mark 16:16 – "Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned."
🚨 Look carefully at what this verse says—and what it DOESN’T say!

✔️ It says, "Whoever BELIEVES and is baptized will be saved."
❌ But it does NOT say, "Whoever is NOT baptized will be condemned."
✔️ It only condemns those who do not believe.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If I say, "Whoever gets on the plane and sits down will arrive at their destination," does that mean sitting down is required to arrive?
👉 No! You just need to be ON the plane!
🔥 Belief in Jesus is what saves you—baptism follows as an act of obedience!

🔥 4. WHY DOES THE BIBLE COMMAND US TO BE BAPTIZED?
📖 Matthew 28:19 – "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit."
🔥 Baptism is NOT required for salvation, but it IS a command of Jesus!

✔️ It is an act of obedience.
✔️ It is a public declaration of faith.
✔️ It is an outward symbol of an inward change.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a king declares you his son, do you need to wear royal clothes to be his child?
👉 No! But wearing them SHOWS your identity!
🚨 If you are truly saved, why would you NOT want to obey Jesus?

🔥 5. WHAT HAPPENS IF SOMEONE DIES WITHOUT BEING BAPTIZED?
📖 Luke 23:42-43 – "Then he said, ‘Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom.’ Jesus answered him, ‘Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in paradise.’"
🔥 The thief on the cross was never baptized—yet Jesus saved him!

✔️ If baptism was REQUIRED for salvation, Jesus would have said, "Sorry, you must be baptized first!"
✔️ This proves that salvation comes by FAITH ALONE—not water!
🚨 BAPTISM IS A COMMAND, BUT IT IS NOT A REQUIREMENT FOR HEAVEN!

🔥 FINAL VERDICT: IS BAPTISM NECESSARY FOR SALVATION?
📖 Titus 3:5 – "He saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of His mercy."

🚨 THE TRUTH:
❌ Baptism does NOT save you—Jesus does!
❌ Water does NOT wash away your sins—only the blood of Jesus can!
❌ If baptism was required for salvation, the Bible would say so—but it doesn’t!

🔥 SALVATION = FAITH IN JESUS + NOTHING ELSE!
🔥 BAPTISM = OBEDIENCE, NOT A REQUIREMENT FOR HEAVEN!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a person accepts Jesus on their deathbed but cannot get baptized, are they going to hell?
👉 Of course not! Because it’s FAITH in Christ that saves, not water!
🚨 DON’T PUT YOUR FAITH IN WATER—PUT IT IN JESUS!

🔥 6. WHAT SHOULD YOU DO NOW?
📖 James 2:26 – "As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead."

✔️ If you have not been baptized, do it out of obedience!
✔️ If you think baptism saves you, repent and trust in Jesus ALONE!
✔️ If you are saved, share this truth with others!
🚨 THE QUESTION IS NOT "HAVE YOU BEEN BAPTIZED?"—IT’S "HAVE YOU BEEN BORN AGAIN?"

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR SALVATION (NOT BAPTISM!)
"Lord Jesus, I confess that You alone are my Savior. I trust in Your blood, not in my works or baptism, to save me. Forgive my sins and make me a new creation! I commit to follow You and obey Your commands. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 GREAT BATTLES ARE GIVEN TO GREAT WARRIORS—GOD IS PREPARING YOU! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 GREAT BATTLES ARE GIVEN TO GREAT WARRIORS—GOD IS PREPARING YOU! 🔥
📖 1 Peter 5:10 – "And after you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore, confirm, strengthen, and establish you."
🚨 Are you going through trials? Facing battles that seem impossible? Feeling like the weight of the world is on your shoulders?
🔥 GREAT BATTLES ARE GIVEN TO GREAT WARRIORS! 🔥
God is not punishing you—He is preparing you! Every struggle, every hardship, every pain is shaping you into the mighty warrior He has called you to be.
👉 Will you surrender to fear? Or will you rise up and trust that God is strengthening you for something greater?
Let’s dive into the BIBLICAL TRUTH about how God uses battles to prepare His strongest warriors!

🔥 1. WHY DOES GOD ALLOW GREAT BATTLES?
📖 James 1:2-4 – "Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance. Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything."
🔥 BATTLES MAKE WARRIORS!

✔️ Without battles, there is no growth.
✔️ Without struggles, there is no strength.
✔️ Without opposition, there is no victory.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A soldier does not become strong by sitting at home—he is trained through battle!
👉 God is not trying to destroy you—He is training you for something greater!
🚨 EVERY GREAT MAN OF GOD FACED GREAT BATTLES!

✔️ Moses had to stand before Pharaoh and lead millions to freedom.
✔️ David had to face Goliath before he could become king.
✔️ Joseph had to endure betrayal and prison before ruling Egypt.
✔️ Jesus had to suffer the cross before the resurrection!
🔥 NO GREAT WARRIOR WAS EVER MADE IN COMFORT!

🔥 2. THE GREATER THE BATTLE, THE GREATER THE CALLING!
📖 Romans 8:28 – "And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love Him, who have been called according to His purpose."
🔥 Every battle you are facing is for a reason.

✔️ The enemy wants to destroy you—God wants to build you!
✔️ The devil wants to break you—God wants to shape you!
✔️ What looks like a setback is actually your training ground!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A diamond is just a piece of coal until it goes through intense pressure.
👉 God is refining you like gold—so you can shine for His glory!

🚨 GOD ALLOWS BATTLES TO:
✔️ Strengthen your faith. (Isaiah 41:10)
✔️ Teach you endurance. (Hebrews 12:11)
✔️ Prepare you for a greater mission. (Jeremiah 29:11)
🔥 THE GREATER YOUR CALLING, THE GREATER YOUR TRAINING!

🔥 3. HOW TO STAND STRONG IN YOUR BATTLE!
📖 Ephesians 6:13 – "Therefore put on the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you may be able to stand your ground, and after you have done everything, to stand."
🔥 If you are in a battle, DO NOT GIVE UP!
🚨 Here’s how to STAND STRONG:

✔️ 1. PRAY LIKE A WARRIOR!
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:17 – "Pray without ceasing."
👉 Your battle is won in prayer!

✔️ 2. FIGHT WITH SCRIPTURE!
📖 Hebrews 4:12 – "For the word of God is alive and active, sharper than any double-edged sword."
👉 Use the Bible as your weapon—declare God’s promises over your life!

✔️ 3. STAY CONNECTED TO STRONG BELIEVERS!
📖 Proverbs 27:17 – "As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another."
👉 Surround yourself with warriors of faith, not people who weaken you!

✔️ 4. TRUST GOD'S PLAN EVEN WHEN YOU DON’T UNDERSTAND!
📖 Isaiah 55:8-9 – "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways," declares the Lord.
👉 What you see as a storm, God sees as your promotion!
🔥 THE ONLY WAY TO LOSE IS TO QUIT!

🔥 4. YOUR BATTLE IS YOUR TESTIMONY!
📖 Revelation 12:11 – "They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony."
🔥 Your greatest battles will become your greatest testimony!

✔️ Joseph was betrayed—but later ruled Egypt.
✔️ David was hunted—but later became king.
✔️ Job lost everything—but was restored DOUBLE.
✔️ Jesus was crucified—but then rose in victory!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If you never had a battle, how would you know that God is a deliverer?
👉 God is turning your pain into purpose!

🚨 DO NOT LET YOUR STRUGGLE BE WASTED!
✔️ Learn from it.
✔️ Grow from it.
✔️ Use it to help others.
🔥 YOU WERE BORN FOR THIS! KEEP FIGHTING!

🔥 FINAL WAR CRY: GOD IS PREPARING YOU FOR SOMETHING GREATER!
📖 Joshua 1:9 – "Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go."

🚨 THIS BATTLE IS NOT YOUR END—IT’S YOUR BEGINNING!
❌ Do not complain—PRAISE GOD!
❌ Do not quit—STAND STRONG!
❌ Do not fear—TRUST THE LORD!
🔥 Your testimony is being written through this battle!

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Stand strong and trust God?
❌ Or let the enemy win?
🚨 THE BATTLE BELONGS TO THE LORD—BUT YOU MUST STAND AND FIGHT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR STRENGTH IN THE BATTLE
"Lord Jesus, I trust that You are preparing me through this battle! Give me strength, courage, and faith to endure. I know You are working all things for my good. I will stand firm and fight in faith! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 CAN SOLDIERS AND POLICE GO TO HEAVEN EVEN IF THEY HAVE KILLED SOMEONE IN DUTY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 CAN SOLDIERS AND POLICE GO TO HEAVEN EVEN IF THEY HAVE KILLED SOMEONE IN DUTY? 🔥
📖 Romans 13:4 – "For the one in authority is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for rulers do not bear the sword for no reason. They are God’s servants, agents of wrath to bring punishment on the wrongdoer."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I’ve heard people say that soldiers and police officers who kill in the line of duty cannot go to heaven. Is this true? If they are following orders and protecting lives, does God condemn them for taking life?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many struggle with this topic because the Bible commands, "You shall not kill" (Exodus 20:13). But does this apply to law enforcement and military personnel?
🚨 Let’s go deep into Scripture and discover the truth!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES "YOU SHALL NOT KILL" REALLY MEAN?
📖 Exodus 20:13 – "You shall not murder."
🔥 The commandment in the original Hebrew does NOT mean "You shall not kill"—it means "You shall not murder."

✔️ The Hebrew word used in Exodus 20:13 is רָצַח (ratzach), which means "murder"—the unlawful taking of innocent life.
✔️ God’s law distinguishes between murder and justified killing (such as self-defense, war, and capital punishment).
✔️ The Bible never condemns soldiers or law enforcement who act in righteous defense of others.

💡 FACT: The Bible forbids murder, NOT acts of justice, war, or law enforcement.
👉 A soldier or police officer following lawful duty is NOT guilty of murder in God’s eyes!
🚨 MURDER IS A SIN—BUT RIGHTEOUS JUDGMENT IS NOT!

🔥 2. DOES GOD SUPPORT LAW ENFORCEMENT AND MILITARY?
📖 Psalm 144:1 – "Praise be to the Lord my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle."
🔥 God has always ordained warriors, soldiers, and law enforcement for the protection of His people.

✔️ Many of God’s greatest leaders were warriors, including King David, Joshua, and Gideon.
✔️ John the Baptist did not tell soldiers to leave their profession—only to act with justice and integrity (Luke 3:14).
✔️ Romans 13:1-4 teaches that governing authorities are established by God to uphold justice and punish evil.

💡 FACT: A soldier or police officer upholding righteousness is fulfilling a biblical role.
👉 God does not condemn those who defend others or fight for justice!
🚨 GOD ORDAINS PROTECTORS TO RESTRAIN EVIL!

🔥 3. CAN A SOLDIER OR POLICE OFFICER STILL GO TO HEAVEN?
📖 Matthew 8:5-10 – Jesus praised a Roman centurion’s great faith!
🔥 Yes! Many soldiers and officers are righteous men and women who serve with honor and integrity.

✔️ Jesus NEVER told soldiers to leave their positions—He praised their faith (Matthew 8:5-10).
✔️ A soldier or officer who follows Christ, repents of personal sins, and serves justly can absolutely go to heaven.
✔️ Salvation is by faith in Jesus Christ—NOT by profession or past actions (Ephesians 2:8-9).

💡 FACT: Soldiers and police officers are accountable to God for their actions, just like everyone else.
👉 If they serve with righteousness and faith in Jesus, they are saved!
🚨 HEAVEN IS FOR THOSE WHO FOLLOW CHRIST—NO MATTER THEIR PROFESSION!

🔥 4. WHEN DOES KILLING BECOME A SIN?
📖 Proverbs 6:16-17 – "The Lord hates… hands that shed innocent blood."
🔥 There is a difference between justified killing and sinful murder.

❌ Murder (taking innocent life) is always a sin.
❌ Killing for personal gain, revenge, or without cause is condemned by God.
✔️ Defending innocent lives, upholding justice, and acting under lawful authority is NOT a sin.

💡 FACT: If a soldier or officer kills unlawfully, they are guilty before God.
👉 If they act in righteous defense of others, they are NOT guilty of sin!
🚨 GOD JUDGES THE HEART—HE KNOWS WHO KILLS FOR EVIL AND WHO KILLS FOR JUSTICE!

🔥 5. HOW CAN SOLDIERS AND POLICE OFFICERS HONOR GOD IN THEIR DUTY?
📖 Micah 6:8 – "He has shown you, O man, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God."
🔥 Those in law enforcement and the military must serve with integrity, righteousness, and faith in Christ.

✔️ Seek God’s wisdom before making life-and-death decisions.
✔️ Uphold justice and protect the innocent.
✔️ Never abuse power or harm others for personal gain.
✔️ Pray for guidance and live in repentance before God.

💡 FACT: A righteous soldier or police officer is a servant of God for good.
👉 If they live by faith and follow Christ, they are saved!
🚨 GODLY WARRIORS SERVE WITH JUSTICE, HONOR, AND FAITH IN CHRIST!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: EVERYONE MUST ANSWER TO GOD!
📖 Hebrews 9:27 – "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment."

🚨 Soldiers, police officers, and civilians alike will all stand before God!
🚨 No one is saved by their profession—only by faith in Jesus Christ!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Live in fear, unsure of your salvation?
✔️ Surrender to Christ and trust Him as your Lord and Savior?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ The truth that sets you free?
❌ Or the fear that keeps you in doubt?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—YOUR ETERNAL DESTINY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR SALVATION & GUIDANCE
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my life to You. Forgive my sins, guide my steps, and help me serve with righteousness and integrity. I trust You as my Savior, and I declare that my life belongs to You! In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THE GREAT FALLING AWAY IS HAPPENING—ARE YOU STILL STANDING? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE GREAT FALLING AWAY IS HAPPENING—ARE YOU STILL STANDING? 🔥
📖 2 Thessalonians 2:3 – "Let no one deceive you in any way. For that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction."

We are living in the days of THE GREAT FALLING AWAY. Many who once claimed to follow Jesus are now turning away from the faith. Churches are compromising, pastors are watering down the gospel, and believers are growing cold.

🚨 What is happening? Why are so many people abandoning Christ?
🚨 Could YOU be in danger of falling away?
🚨 Are you still standing strong, or are you slowly slipping away?
🔥 Jesus warned us about this time—and IT IS HERE! Let’s break it down biblically so you can be spiritually prepared!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE GREAT FALLING AWAY?
📖 Matthew 24:10-12 – "At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other, and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people. Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold."
The "falling away" (Greek: ἀποστασία, apostasia) means a great rebellion, a departure from the truth.

✔️ Many will abandon the faith.
✔️ Many will compromise with the world.
✔️ Many will follow false teachers.
✔️ Many will stop believing in Jesus.
🔥 We are watching this unfold RIGHT NOW!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
🔹 Pastors who once preached repentance now promote sin to please the world.
🔹 Churches that used to stand for truth now embrace false doctrines.
🔹 Christians who were once on fire for God now mock holiness.
🚨 THE GREAT FALLING AWAY HAS BEGUN! ARE YOU A PART OF IT?

🔥 2. WHY ARE SO MANY FALLING AWAY?
📖 1 Timothy 4:1 – "Now the Spirit explicitly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and follow deceiving spirits and things taught by demons."
🔥 THREE MAIN REASONS PEOPLE ARE FALLING AWAY:

1️⃣ They want a gospel that pleases their flesh.
✔️ They don’t want to repent.
✔️ They want a "feel-good" message, not the truth.
✔️ They reject correction and holiness.

📖 2 Timothy 4:3 – "For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear."

2️⃣ They are deceived by false teachers.
✔️ Many preachers today teach "another gospel" that is NOT biblical.
✔️ They promote prosperity, self-help, and hyper-grace instead of repentance.
✔️ They twist Scripture to allow sin and rebellion.

📖 2 Peter 2:1 – "But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the sovereign Lord who bought them."

3️⃣ They are spiritually asleep.
✔️ They don’t read the Bible.
✔️ They don’t pray or seek God.
✔️ They are distracted by the world.

📖 Revelation 3:15-16 – "I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either one or the other! So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth."
🚨 WHICH ONE DESCRIBES YOU? ARE YOU FALLING INTO THESE TRAPS?

🔥 3. HOW TO STAY STRONG AND NOT FALL AWAY!
📖 Hebrews 10:23 – "Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful."
🔥 THESE 5 STEPS WILL KEEP YOU FROM FALLING AWAY:

✔️ 1. STUDY GOD’S WORD DAILY!
📖 Psalm 119:105 – "Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path."
👉 Without truth, you will fall for lies.

✔️ 2. PRAY WITHOUT CEASING!
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:17 – "Pray without ceasing."
👉 If you stop praying, your faith will die.

✔️ 3. STAY AWAY FROM FALSE TEACHERS!
📖 2 John 1:10 – "If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take them into your house or welcome them."
👉 If a preacher is not preaching repentance, RUN!

✔️ 4. GUARD YOUR HEART FROM SIN!
📖 Proverbs 4:23 – "Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it."
👉 Sin hardens your heart—REPENT DAILY!

✔️ 5. STAY CONNECTED TO TRUE BELIEVERS!
📖 Hebrews 10:25 – "Do not give up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another."
👉 You cannot fight alone—surround yourself with strong believers!

title: 🔥 CAN CHRISTIANS EAT PORK? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE REALLY SAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 CAN CHRISTIANS EAT PORK? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE REALLY SAY? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, I heard that in the Old Testament, eating pork was forbidden because it was ‘unclean.’ But today, many Christians eat pork without concern. Are we still under that law? Are there other foods or drinks that Christians should avoid?"
🚨 THIS TOPIC CAUSES MUCH CONFUSION! Some say eating pork is a sin because of Old Testament laws. Others say we are now free to eat anything. But what does the BIBLE actually say?
📖 Key Verse: "Do not call anything impure that God has made clean." (Acts 10:15)
🔥 IS EATING PORK STILL A SIN, OR DID JESUS CHANGE THE LAW? LET’S FIND OUT! 🔥

🔥 1. WHAT DID THE OLD TESTAMENT SAY ABOUT PORK?
📖 Leviticus 11:7-8 – "And the pig, though it has a divided hoof, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you. You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you."
💡 UNDER THE OLD TESTAMENT LAW, PORK WAS CONSIDERED ‘UNCLEAN.’

✔️ God gave Israel dietary laws (Leviticus 11) to separate them from pagan nations.
✔️ Certain animals (like pigs, shellfish, and certain birds) were forbidden for Israel.
✔️ Breaking these food laws was a serious offense under the Mosaic Law.
🚨 BUT HERE’S THE QUESTION: DO THESE LAWS STILL APPLY TO CHRISTIANS TODAY?

🔥 2. DID JESUS ABOLISH THE FOOD LAWS?
📖 Mark 7:18-19 – "Do you not see that whatever goes into a person from outside cannot defile him, since it enters not his heart but his stomach, and is expelled?" (In saying this, Jesus declared all foods clean.)
💡 JESUS HIMSELF DECLARED THAT FOOD DOES NOT MAKE A PERSON UNCLEAN!

✔️ Spiritual purity is about the heart, not what we eat! (Matthew 15:11)
✔️ Sin comes from within (evil thoughts, lies, adultery, etc.), not from food. (Mark 7:20-23)
✔️ Jesus fulfilled the Old Testament law—we are no longer bound by dietary restrictions! (Matthew 5:17)
🚨 THEREFORE, JESUS DECLARED ALL FOODS CLEAN!

🔥 3. THE APOSTLE PETER’S VISION—GOD CONFIRMS IT!
📖 Acts 10:13-15 – "Then a voice told him, ‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’ ‘Surely not, Lord!’ Peter replied. ‘I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.’ The voice spoke to him a second time: ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’"
💡 PETER, A JEW, REFUSED TO EAT UNCLEAN ANIMALS—BUT GOD SAID THEY ARE NOW CLEAN!

✔️ This vision was about removing barriers between Jews and Gentiles, but it also confirmed that the food laws had changed!
✔️ The New Covenant is about faith in Jesus, not following Jewish rituals. (Hebrews 8:13)
✔️ Paul later confirmed that all foods are clean! (1 Timothy 4:4-5)
🚨 GOD HIMSELF DECLARED THAT PORK AND OTHER "UNCLEAN" FOODS ARE NOW CLEAN!

🔥 4. ARE THERE STILL RESTRICTIONS ON WHAT CHRISTIANS CAN EAT OR DRINK?
📖 1 Corinthians 10:31 – "So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God."
💡 AS CHRISTIANS, OUR DIETARY CHOICES SHOULD HONOR GOD—BUT THERE ARE NO FORBIDDEN FOODS!

✔️ Drunkenness is a sin—but drinking alcohol in moderation is not condemned. (Ephesians 5:18)
✔️ Gluttony (overeating) is a sin—self-control is a fruit of the Spirit. (Proverbs 23:20-21)
✔️ If eating something causes another believer to stumble, avoid it. (Romans 14:21)
✔️ Our body is God’s temple—we should not harm it with unhealthy habits. (1 Corinthians 6:19-20)
🚨 THEREFORE, CHRISTIANS HAVE FREEDOM, BUT WE SHOULD USE WISDOM IN OUR DIETARY CHOICES!

🔥 5. WHAT IF SOMEONE STILL BELIEVES PORK IS WRONG?
📖 Romans 14:2-3 – "One person’s faith allows them to eat anything, but another, whose faith is weak, eats only vegetables. The one who eats everything must not treat with contempt the one who does not."
💡 EVERY CHRISTIAN HAS DIFFERENT CONVICTIONS—WE MUST NOT JUDGE EACH OTHER!

✔️ If someone chooses not to eat pork out of personal conviction, we should respect that.
✔️ If someone eats pork, they should not be condemned because God has made it clean.
✔️ We must not divide over food—our unity is in Christ! (Colossians 2:16)
🚨 EATING OR NOT EATING PORK DOESN’T MAKE YOU MORE HOLY—WHAT MATTERS IS YOUR HEART!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I AM FREE IN CHRIST! I WILL HONOR GOD IN ALL I DO, WHETHER I EAT OR DRINK!"

🔥 THE CHRISTIAN FREEDOM CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Live in freedom—don’t be bound by legalism!
✅ Step 2: Respect other believers’ convictions—don’t argue over food!
✅ Step 3: Use wisdom in what you eat and drink—honor God with your body!

🙏 PRAYER FOR WISDOM & FREEDOM IN CHRIST! 🙏
Heavenly Father, thank You for the truth of Your Word. Thank You for setting us free from legalism and calling us to walk in the freedom of Christ. Lord, give me wisdom to honor You in everything I do—whether I eat, drink, or any other part of my life.

Help me not to judge others based on food or religious rules but to love my brothers and sisters in Christ. Teach me to live in a way that pleases You, not by following man-made traditions, but by walking in the power of the Holy Spirit.

Jesus, I believe that You alone are my salvation. Not my diet, not my works, but Your grace alone saves me. I surrender every area of my life to You. Fill me with wisdom, discernment, and a heart that seeks only Your truth.
🔥 In Jesus' mighty name, I pray. Amen! 🔥
🔥 #CanChristiansEatPork #BiblicalTruth #FreedomInChrist #OldVsNewCovenant #ChristianDiet #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis

title: 🔥 THE ENEMY WANTS YOU WEAK—THAT’S WHY HE KEEPS YOU AWAY FROM PRAYER! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE ENEMY WANTS YOU WEAK—THAT’S WHY HE KEEPS YOU AWAY FROM PRAYER! 🔥
📖 Ephesians 6:18 – "Pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and requests. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord’s people."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I want to pray more, but I keep getting distracted or feeling too tired. Sometimes, I even forget to pray. Why is it so hard to stay consistent in prayer?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Prayer is one of the most powerful weapons a Christian has—so of course, the enemy will do everything to stop you from using it!
🚨 Satan knows that a prayerless Christian is a powerless Christian!
Let’s expose the enemy’s tactics and learn how to fight back!

🔥 1. SATAN KNOWS PRAYER CONNECTS YOU TO GOD—THAT’S WHY HE DISTRACTS YOU!
📖 James 4:8 – "Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you."
🔥 Satan will do ANYTHING to keep you from praying, because prayer keeps you connected to God!

✔️ Distractions – Suddenly, your phone, TV, or social media seem more important.
✔️ Busyness – You feel like you "don’t have time" to pray.
✔️ Laziness – You say, "I’ll pray later"—but later never comes.
✔️ Doubt – The devil whispers, "God isn’t listening anyway."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
You plan to pray before bed, but then your phone notification pops up, and before you know it, you’ve spent 30 minutes scrolling and you’re too tired to pray.
👉 That’s NOT an accident—Satan is stealing your prayer time!
🚨 DON’T LET DISTRACTIONS KEEP YOU FROM YOUR DIVINE CONNECTION!

🔥 2. THE DEVIL KNOWS PRAYER GIVES YOU SPIRITUAL STRENGTH—THAT’S WHY HE MAKES YOU FEEL WEAK!
📖 Isaiah 40:31 – "But those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength."
🔥 Satan wants you weak, discouraged, and defeated—because a weak Christian is an easy target!

✔️ Without prayer, your faith starts to fade.
✔️ Without prayer, you won’t have strength to resist temptation.
✔️ Without prayer, fear, anxiety, and doubt will overtake you.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A soldier without his weapon is defenseless in battle.
👉 A Christian without prayer is defenseless against the enemy!
🚨 PRAYER IS YOUR SPIRITUAL POWER SOURCE—DON’T LET SATAN UNPLUG YOU!

🔥 3. THE ENEMY KNOWS PRAYER BRINGS VICTORY—THAT’S WHY HE MAKES YOU GIVE UP!
📖 Luke 18:1 – "Then Jesus told His disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up."
🔥 Satan wants you to believe prayer doesn’t work—so you’ll stop praying!

✔️ You pray for something, but don’t see immediate results—so you give up.
✔️ You face a tough situation, and instead of praying, you complain.
✔️ You think your prayers are too small or unimportant for God to care.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Daniel prayed for 21 days before he got his breakthrough (Daniel 10:12-13).
👉 Sometimes, your answer is delayed—but that doesn’t mean your prayer is ignored!
🚨 THE MORE SATAN ATTACKS, THE MORE YOU SHOULD PRAY!

🔥 4. PRAYER DESTROYS DEMONIC STRONGHOLDS—THAT’S WHY SATAN HATES IT!
📖 2 Corinthians 10:4 – "The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds."
🔥 Prayer is a spiritual weapon that demolishes Satan’s kingdom!

✔️ Prayer breaks demonic oppression.
✔️ Prayer stops generational curses.
✔️ Prayer opens doors that no man can shut.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Paul and Silas were locked in prison, but when they prayed and worshiped, an earthquake shook the prison and set them free! (Acts 16:25-26)
👉 Your prayers can shake the foundations of the enemy’s strongholds!
🚨 PRAYER UNLEASHES GOD’S POWER—USE IT!

🔥 5. HOW TO STRENGTHEN YOUR PRAYER LIFE & DEFEAT SATAN!
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:17 – "Pray without ceasing."
🔥 Here’s how to stay strong in prayer and never let the enemy weaken you!

✔️ SET A DAILY PRAYER TIME – Just like you schedule meals, schedule prayer.
✔️ PRAY EVEN WHEN YOU DON’T FEEL LIKE IT – Your emotions should NOT control your prayers!
✔️ PRAY OUT LOUD – Declare God’s Word boldly against the enemy!
✔️ FAST & PRAY – Fasting strengthens your spirit and weakens the flesh!
✔️ PRAY WITH AUTHORITY – Speak in Jesus’ name and claim victory over your life!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A Christian feels weak in prayer, but decides to wake up 30 minutes earlier every day to pray.
👉 Within weeks, they feel spiritually stronger, more at peace, and more confident in God!
🚨 PRAYER IS YOUR LIFELINE—DON’T LET THE ENEMY CUT IT OFF!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: IF YOU DON’T PRAY, YOU WILL FALL!
📖 Matthew 26:41 – "Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."
🚨 A PRAYERLESS CHRISTIAN IS A POWERLESS CHRISTIAN!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Keep making excuses and let Satan keep you weak?
✔️ Take prayer seriously and walk in supernatural strength?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ A life of power, victory, and divine connection?
❌ Or a life of weakness, fear, and defeat?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—PRAYER CAN CHANGE EVERYTHING!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO REIGNITE YOUR PRAYER LIFE
"Lord Jesus, I repent for neglecting my prayer life. I rebuke every distraction and every attack that keeps me from seeking You. Fill me with Your fire, give me a hunger for prayer, and help me stand strong against the enemy. I choose to stay connected to You daily! In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"

title: 🔥 THE TRUTH ABOUT THE TRINITY—UNDERSTANDING GOD IN THREE PERSONS! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE TRUTH ABOUT THE TRINITY—UNDERSTANDING GOD IN THREE PERSONS! 🔥
💬 "Brother John, how can God be ONE, yet THREE persons? Is the Trinity biblical, or is it a man-made doctrine? Some say the Trinity is false and that Jesus is not God. What does the Bible really say?"

🚨 MANY PEOPLE STRUGGLE TO UNDERSTAND THE TRINITY! Some say it’s a Catholic invention, others say Jesus is not God, and some even claim the Holy Spirit is just a force. But the Bible clearly teaches that God is ONE, yet exists in THREE persons!
📖 Key Verse: "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit." (Matthew 28:19)
🔥 IS THE TRINITY A LIE OR A BIBLICAL TRUTH? LET’S FIND OUT! 🔥

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE TRINITY?
📖 Deuteronomy 6:4 – "Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one."
💡 THE BIBLE TEACHES THAT GOD IS ONE IN ESSENCE BUT EXISTS IN THREE PERSONS:

✔️ The Father is God (John 6:27, 1 Corinthians 8:6)
✔️ The Son is God (John 1:1, John 20:28, Colossians 2:9)
✔️ The Holy Spirit is God (Acts 5:3-4, 2 Corinthians 3:17)
🚨 THE TRINITY DOES NOT MEAN THREE GODS—IT MEANS ONE GOD IN THREE PERSONS!

🔥 2. IS THE TRINITY FOUND IN THE BIBLE?
📖 Genesis 1:26 – "Then God said, ‘Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness.’"
💡 EVEN IN THE OLD TESTAMENT, GOD SPEAKS IN PLURAL FORM!

✔️ The Hebrew word for God, ELOHIM, is plural—showing the complexity of God’s nature.
✔️ The Father, Son, and Holy Spirit are all seen at Jesus’ baptism (Matthew 3:16-17).
✔️ Jesus commanded baptism in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19).
✔️ Jesus said, "I and the Father are one!" (John 10:30)
🚨 THE TRINITY IS NOT A NEW TEACHING—IT’S IN THE BIBLE FROM BEGINNING TO END!

🔥 3. COMMON LIES ABOUT THE TRINITY (EXPOSING FALSE TEACHINGS!)
📖 2 Peter 2:1 – "There will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them."

🚨 LIE #1: "THE TRINITY WAS INVENTED BY THE CATHOLIC CHURCH."
✔️ The word "Trinity" is not in the Bible, but the concept is 100% biblical.
✔️ Early Christians, long before the Catholic Church, believed in the Trinity.

🚨 LIE #2: "JESUS IS NOT GOD—HE WAS JUST A PROPHET."
📖 John 1:1 – "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God."
✔️ Jesus accepted worship (Matthew 14:33, John 20:28).
✔️ Jesus forgave sins—something only God can do! (Mark 2:5-7).
✔️ Jesus said, "Before Abraham was, I AM!" (John 8:58) – claiming to be Yahweh!

🚨 LIE #3: "THE HOLY SPIRIT IS JUST A FORCE, NOT A PERSON."
✔️ The Holy Spirit speaks and teaches (John 14:26, Acts 13:2).
✔️ He has emotions and can be grieved (Ephesians 4:30).
✔️ He intercedes for us in prayer (Romans 8:26).
🔥 THE TRINITY IS NOT A MAN-MADE TEACHING—IT IS THE TRUE NATURE OF GOD! 🔥

🔥 4. UNDERSTANDING THE TRINITY MORE DEEPLY (GREEK & HEBREW BREAKDOWN!)
📖 Colossians 2:9 – "For in Christ all the fullness of Deity dwells in bodily form."
💡 THE BIBLE USES SPECIFIC WORDS TO TEACH THE TRINITY!

✔️ "ECHAD" (אֶחָד) – Hebrew for "one" in unity (Deuteronomy 6:4).
✔️ "LOGOS" (Λόγος) – Greek for "The Word" referring to Jesus as God (John 1:1).
✔️ "PNEUMA" (Πνεῦμα) – Greek for "Spirit", showing the Holy Spirit’s personhood (John 14:26).
🚨 THE BIBLE IS CLEAR—GOD IS ONE, YET EXISTS AS THREE PERSONS!

🔥 5. WHY DOES THIS MATTER? HOW DOES THE TRINITY AFFECT YOUR FAITH?
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."
💡 IF YOU REJECT THE TRINITY, YOU REJECT THE TRUE GOD!

✔️ SALVATION COMES FROM THE TRIUNE GOD. (John 3:16)
✔️ THE TRINITY SHOWS GOD’S LOVE AND RELATIONSHIP. (1 John 4:8)
✔️ IF JESUS IS NOT GOD, HIS SACRIFICE WAS NOT ENOUGH! (Hebrews 9:14)
🚨 ONLY THE TRUE GOD CAN SAVE YOU—AND THE TRUE GOD IS FATHER, SON, AND HOLY SPIRIT!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I BELIEVE IN THE ONE TRUE GOD—FATHER, SON, AND HOLY SPIRIT!"

🔥 THE TRUTH CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Study the Bible—know God’s nature for yourself!
✅ Step 2: Reject false teachings—don’t fall for deception!
✅ Step 3: Share this truth—help others understand who God really is!

🙏 PRAYER FOR REVELATION OF GOD’S TRUE NATURE! 🙏
Heavenly Father, I come before You in awe of Your greatness and majesty. Thank You for revealing Yourself as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit—ONE GOD in perfect unity. Lord, help me to understand and embrace Your truth, not through human reasoning, but by the guidance of Your Holy Spirit.

Jesus, I worship You as my Lord and Savior! I believe You are God in the flesh, and through You alone, I have salvation. Holy Spirit, fill me with wisdom and discernment to reject false teachings and hold firmly to Your Word.

Lord, I pray for those who are deceived about who You are. Open their eyes and remove every lie that blinds them from the truth. Let them experience the power of the Triune God in their lives! I commit my heart fully to You, Lord—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit—forever and ever!
🔥 In Jesus’ mighty name, I pray. Amen! 🔥
🔥 #TruthAboutTheTrinity #GodInThreePersons #JesusIsGod #HolySpiritIsGod #OneGodThreePersons #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis

title: 🔥 YOU CALL YOURSELF A CHRISTIAN, BUT STILL FOLLOW MAN-MADE TRADITIONS? READ THIS! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 YOU CALL YOURSELF A CHRISTIAN, BUT STILL FOLLOW MAN-MADE TRADITIONS? READ THIS! 🔥
📖 Mark 7:8 – "You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, many people say they are Christians, but they continue to follow traditions that are not in the Bible. Some even prioritize traditions over God’s Word. Is this right? What does the Bible say about it?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people claim to follow Jesus, but their actions show otherwise. Instead of obeying God’s Word, they cling to man-made traditions that have no biblical foundation. Some even say, "This is how we’ve always done it," as if tradition can override the truth!
🚨 But here’s the question: Are these traditions leading people to Christ, or are they leading them AWAY from God’s truth?
Let’s expose the lies and stand on BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. TRUE CHRISTIANITY VS. MAN-MADE TRADITIONS
📖 Matthew 15:3 – "Jesus replied, ‘And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?’"
🔥 A true Christian follows Jesus, NOT religious traditions.

✔️ Christianity is about a relationship with God, not rituals.
✔️ Jesus NEVER told us to follow human traditions—He told us to follow HIM.
✔️ Man-made traditions often lead people away from God’s truth!
🚨 The Pharisees in Jesus’ time were religious, but they rejected Him because they valued traditions more than truth. Many today are doing the same!
💡 Are you following Jesus, or just following what people have told you?

🔥 2. COMMON MAN-MADE TRADITIONS THAT MANY CHRISTIANS FOLLOW (BUT AREN’T BIBLICAL!)
📖 Colossians 2:8 – "See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than on Christ."
🔥 Many people follow traditions that are NOT in the Bible! Let’s expose them!

❌ TRADITION: "Praying to saints and Mary as mediators."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Jesus is the ONLY mediator between God and man (1 Timothy 2:5).

❌ TRADITION: "Repeating memorized prayers over and over (rosary, novenas, etc.)."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Jesus warned against repetitive prayers (Matthew 6:7).

❌ TRADITION: "Celebrating religious festivals that are not found in Scripture."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: God never commanded Christians to celebrate these man-made events (Mark 7:13).

❌ TRADITION: "Believing that good works or church rituals can save you."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Salvation is by grace through faith alone (Ephesians 2:8-9).

❌ TRADITION: "Bowing before statues, relics, or religious images."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: This is IDOLATRY, and God strictly forbids it! (Exodus 20:4-5).
🚨 MANY PEOPLE TODAY FOLLOW RELIGION, NOT JESUS!
💡 Are you following Christ or just doing what has been passed down to you?

🔥 3. JESUS WARNED US ABOUT TRADITIONS THAT REPLACE GOD'S COMMANDS!
📖 Mark 7:9 – "You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!"
🔥 Jesus constantly rebuked religious leaders who prioritized human traditions over God's truth!

✔️ The Pharisees were obsessed with rituals, but their hearts were far from God.
✔️ Many today claim to love Jesus but refuse to let go of religious traditions.
✔️ True faith is not about customs—it’s about knowing and obeying God's Word!
🚨 Religion without true obedience to Christ is EMPTY!
💡 Ask yourself: Do I follow traditions that contradict the Bible? If yes, it's time to choose between TRUTH and TRADITION!

🔥 4. THE DANGER OF FOLLOWING MAN-MADE TRADITIONS
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father."
🔥 Many THINK they are Christians, but they are actually following a FALSE, TRADITION-BASED Christianity!

❌ They trust in rituals instead of in Christ.
❌ They follow what their church says instead of what the Bible says.
❌ They ignore biblical warnings and hold onto tradition out of fear or pride.
🚨 Jesus made it clear: Only those who obey GOD'S WORD will be saved!
💡 What matters is not how religious you are, but whether you are following Jesus in spirit and truth!

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – FREED FROM TRADITIONS!
A woman grew up in a church that taught her to pray to saints, bow before statues, and perform religious rituals. She believed these traditions were necessary for salvation.
🔥 One day, she read Exodus 20:4-5 and realized that the Bible strictly forbids idolatry!
🚨 She repented, threw away her religious images, and started worshiping Jesus alone. Now, she has a real, personal relationship with God—not just empty traditions.
💡 THIS is what true Christianity is—following CHRIST, not man-made customs!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: TRADITION WILL NOT SAVE YOU!
📖 Matthew 15:8-9 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. They worship Me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules."
🚨 Many will stand before Jesus on Judgment Day thinking they were saved, only to hear, "I NEVER KNEW YOU!"

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Continue following man-made traditions that contradict the Bible?
✔️ Surrender to Jesus, obey His Word, and reject false teachings?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE YOUR ETERNITY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 PRAYER FOR DELIVERANCE FROM RELIGIOUS TRADITIONS
"Heavenly Father, open my eyes to Your truth. If I have followed traditions that are not from You, I repent. Teach me to worship You in spirit and truth. Help me to obey Your Word alone and not the rules of men. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
