title: 🔥 SOUL VS. SPIRIT – WHAT’S THE DIFFERENCE AND WHY DOES IT MATTER? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 SOUL VS. SPIRIT – WHAT’S THE DIFFERENCE AND WHY DOES IT MATTER? 🔥
📖 Hebrews 4:12 – "For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it penetrates even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart."
Many people use the terms "soul" and "spirit" interchangeably, but the Bible makes a clear distinction between them.

🚨 Understanding the difference is crucial for your faith!
❌ If you don’t understand it, you can be spiritually weak without realizing it.
❌ If you confuse them, you might be living in the flesh instead of the Spirit!
❌ If you ignore it, you might not fully grasp God’s purpose for your life!
🔥 WHAT’S THE DIFFERENCE? WHY DOES IT MATTER? LET’S BREAK IT DOWN!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE SOUL?
📖 Genesis 2:7 – "Then the Lord God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living soul."
The soul (Hebrew: ‘Nephesh’ / Greek: ‘Psyche’) is the seat of our emotions, thoughts, and will.

✔️ The soul is what makes you YOU—your personality, desires, and choices.
✔️ It includes your mind (thoughts), emotions (feelings), and will (decisions).
✔️ Animals have souls too—but they don’t have spirits!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Think of your soul as the driver of a car. It decides where to go, how to react, and how fast to move.
👉 But just like a driver needs a GPS, your soul needs your spirit to guide it!

🔥 2. WHAT IS THE SPIRIT?
📖 Job 32:8 – "But it is the spirit in a person, the breath of the Almighty, that gives them understanding."
The spirit (Hebrew: ‘Ruach’ / Greek: ‘Pneuma’) is the part of us that connects with God.

✔️ The spirit is what makes humans different from animals.
✔️ It is the breath of God in us—the eternal part that lives forever.
✔️ It is where we have spiritual understanding, discernment, and communication with God.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Think of your spirit as the Wi-Fi signal that connects you to God.
👉 If your spirit is weak, your connection to God is weak!

🔥 3. SOUL VS. SPIRIT – WHAT’S THE DIFFERENCE?
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:23 – "May your whole spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ."

🚀 The soul controls your thoughts and emotions.
🚀 The spirit connects you directly to God.

✔️ If your soul is leading, you will live by emotions, logic, and personal desires.
✔️ If your spirit is leading, you will walk in faith, wisdom, and the Holy Spirit’s guidance.
🔥 BIG QUESTION: WHICH ONE CONTROLS YOUR LIFE?

🔥 4. WHY DOES THIS MATTER?
📖 Romans 8:6 – "The mind governed by the flesh is death, but the mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace."
👉 If you don’t understand the difference between soul and spirit, you might think you’re "spiritual" when you’re really just emotional.
🔥 EXAMPLES OF SOUL-LED CHRISTIANS VS. SPIRIT-LED CHRISTIANS

❌ SOUL-LED CHRISTIANS:
• Base decisions on feelings instead of God’s Word.
• Worship only when the music feels good instead of in Spirit and truth.
• Get easily offended, bitter, and discouraged.
• Read the Bible but don’t apply it.
• Stay stuck in sinful habits because their spirit is weak.

✔️ SPIRIT-LED CHRISTIANS:
• Make choices based on faith, not emotions.
• Worship even when they don’t feel like it.
• Forgive easily and walk in peace.
• Read the Bible and live it out.
• Overcome sin because they are spiritually strong.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A soul-led Christian prays only when they feel like it.
A spirit-led Christian prays because they know they need God—no matter what.
👉 Which one are you?

🔥 5. HOW TO STRENGTHEN YOUR SPIRIT AND MASTER YOUR SOUL!
📖 Galatians 5:16 – "Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh."
🚀 Steps to strengthen your spirit and rule over your soul:

✔️ 1. Feed your spirit daily with God’s Word! (Matthew 4:4)
✔️ 2. Pray in the Spirit, not just with emotions! (Ephesians 6:18)
✔️ 3. Worship God in Spirit and truth! (John 4:24)
✔️ 4. Fast and deny the flesh to sharpen your spirit! (Matthew 6:16-18)
✔️ 5. Surround yourself with strong believers who walk in the Spirit! (Proverbs 27:17)
✔️ 6. Stop letting emotions control you—live by faith! (2 Corinthians 5:7)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A bodybuilder doesn’t get strong by eating junk food and sitting on the couch.
👉 If you want a strong spirit, you must feed it with prayer, fasting, and God’s Word daily!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DON’T LET YOUR SOUL CONTROL YOU—LIVE BY THE SPIRIT!
📖 Galatians 2:20 – "I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me."

🚨 If your soul (emotions) controls you, your life will be full of struggles, confusion, and spiritual weakness.
🚀 If your spirit (God’s presence) controls you, you will walk in wisdom, peace, and victory!
🔥 DON’T BE A SOUL-LED CHRISTIAN—BE A SPIRIT-LED WARRIOR!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO LIVE BY THE SPIRIT
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want to be controlled by my emotions and flesh! Strengthen my spirit so I can walk in Your power daily. I surrender my soul to You—lead me by Your Spirit! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 RELIGION TEACHES RULES—JESUS GIVES LIFE! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 RELIGION TEACHES RULES—JESUS GIVES LIFE! 🔥
📖 Matthew 15:9 – "They worship Me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules."
Millions of people think they are following God when in reality, they are just following a system of religious traditions, rules, and rituals that have nothing to do with Jesus.

🚨 Going to church does NOT automatically mean you have a relationship with Christ!
❌ You can follow religious traditions and still be far from God.
❌ You can memorize prayers and still not know Jesus personally.
❌ You can be a church member but still be spiritually dead.
🔥 RELIGION CAN’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN!
👉 Are you following Jesus, or just following a religious system?

🔥 1. RELIGION FOCUSES ON OUTWARD APPEARANCE—JESUS LOOKS AT THE HEART!
📖 1 Samuel 16:7 – "The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."
🔥 Religion teaches you to focus on rituals—Jesus wants a changed heart!

❌ RELIGION SAYS:
• Go to church every Sunday, and you’re good.
• Say a few prayers, and God will be pleased.
• Follow all the rules, and you’ll be saved.

✔️ JESUS SAYS:
• "Love the Lord your God with all your heart" (Matthew 22:37).
• "Deny yourself, take up your cross, and follow Me" (Luke 9:23).
• "You must be born again" (John 3:3).

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man gives flowers to his wife every day but never actually loves her or spends time with her.
👉 Does the routine of giving flowers make the relationship real? NO!
Likewise, practicing religious rituals without a real love for Jesus is EMPTY!
👉 God is looking for true worshipers, not religious robots!

🔥 2. RELIGION ADDS MAN-MADE RULES—JESUS GIVES FREEDOM!
📖 Mark 7:8 – "You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions."
🔥 Many religious people care more about church rules than about what Jesus actually said!

❌ RELIGION TEACHES:
• You must follow traditions to be saved.
• You need a priest or pastor to connect with God.
• If you don’t do everything perfectly, God will reject you.

✔️ JESUS TEACHES:
• "Come to Me, all you who are weary, and I will give you rest" (Matthew 11:28).
• "There is one Mediator between God and men—the man Christ Jesus" (1 Timothy 2:5).
• "It is finished!" (John 19:30) — Salvation is already paid for!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A prisoner is released, but instead of walking free, he stays inside the prison because he feels safer there.
👉 This is how many religious people live—they are still enslaved by rules instead of walking in the freedom Jesus gives!
👉 Jesus didn’t come to start a religion—He came to set you FREE!

🔥 3. RELIGIOUS PEOPLE WILL BE SHOCKED ON JUDGMENT DAY!
📖 Matthew 7:22-23 – "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name and perform many miracles?’ Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Depart from Me!’"

🔥 This is one of the most terrifying verses in the Bible!
👉 Why will Jesus reject them?

❌ Because they were religious, but they never truly KNEW Him.
❌ Because they focused on rules, but never had a relationship.
❌ Because they followed man’s traditions, but never surrendered to Jesus.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
You can know facts about a celebrity, but that doesn’t mean you have a personal relationship with them.
Likewise, knowing ABOUT Jesus is not the same as KNOWING HIM personally.
👉 Are you truly following Jesus, or are you just following a religious routine?

🔥 4. TRUE CHRISTIANITY IS NOT ABOUT RELIGION—IT’S ABOUT A RELATIONSHIP!
📖 John 10:27 – "My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me."
🔥 Jesus is calling you into a real, living relationship with Him!

❌ RELIGION SAYS:
• "Do these things, follow these rules, and maybe you’ll make it to heaven."
✔️ JESUS SAYS:
• "Come to Me and I will give you eternal life!" (John 10:28).

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A father doesn’t love his child because the child follows rules. He loves his child because they have a relationship.
Likewise, God doesn’t want religious slaves—He wants sons and daughters!
👉 Jesus didn’t die so you could have more rules—He died so you could have ETERNAL LIFE!

🔥 5. STOP FOLLOWING RELIGION—FOLLOW JESUS!
📖 John 8:36 – "If the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed."

🚨 Religion without Jesus is DEAD.
✔️ Church won’t save you.
✔️ Rituals won’t save you.
✔️ Good works won’t save you.

🔥 ONLY JESUS CAN SAVE YOU!
✔️ Have a personal relationship with Christ.
✔️ Trust in His finished work on the cross.
✔️ Live by faith, not by religious traditions.
📖 Acts 4:12 – "Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ A system of religion?
❌ Or a true relationship with Jesus?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO FOLLOW JESUS, NOT RELIGION
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want dead religion—I want YOU! I surrender my life completely to You. I trust in You alone for my salvation. Teach me to walk with You daily and to follow You with all my heart. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THE TRUTH & LIES ABOUT PRAYING AIDS – DO WE NEED THEM TO CONNECT WITH GOD? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE TRUTH & LIES ABOUT PRAYING AIDS – DO WE NEED THEM TO CONNECT WITH GOD? 🔥
📖 John 4:24 – "God is spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I’ve seen people use prayer beads, candles, statues, and even certain cloths or oils when they pray. Some say these ‘praying aids’ help them get closer to God. But is this biblical? Do we need these things for God to hear our prayers?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many Christians today unknowingly use praying aids that have no biblical basis. Some churches even encourage their use, while others warn against them.
🚨 Are praying aids helpful, or are they dangerous distractions? Let’s expose the lies and stand on BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. WHAT ARE PRAYING AIDS?
📖 Matthew 6:7 – "And when you pray, do not heap up empty phrases as the Gentiles do, for they think that they will be heard for their many words."
🔥 Praying aids are physical objects people use in prayer, believing they bring them closer to God or make their prayers more effective. These include:

✔️ Prayer Beads (Rosary, etc.) – Used to count prayers repetitively.
✔️ Statues & Images – Some bow before them, thinking they represent God.
✔️ Candles & Incense – Used in prayers for guidance or blessings.
✔️ Holy Water & Anointing Oil – Some believe it has power beyond its symbolic meaning.
✔️ Prayer Cloths & Relics – Objects people think carry divine power.
🚨 But do we need these things to communicate with God?
💡 The Bible tells us that prayer is DIRECT communication with God—without the need for objects!

🔥 2. WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY ABOUT PRAYING AIDS?
📖 1 Timothy 2:5 – "For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus."
🔥 Nowhere in Scripture does God require physical objects for prayer!

✔️ Jesus never used prayer beads, candles, or images when praying.
✔️ The apostles and early church prayed directly to God—without aids.
✔️ The Bible warns against repetitive prayers and idol worship.
🚨 Some claim these aids "help them focus," but does God need objects to hear us? No!
💡 Prayer is about the heart, not the objects around us!

🔥 3. THE BIGGEST LIES ABOUT PRAYING AIDS – DEBUNKED!
📖 Isaiah 42:8 – "I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not give My glory to another or My praise to idols."
🔥 Many have been deceived into thinking prayer requires objects. Let’s expose these lies!

❌ LIE #1: "Prayer Beads Help You Connect with God."
✔️ TRUTH: Jesus said to avoid repetitive prayers (Matthew 6:7). True prayer is from the heart, not memorized words.

❌ LIE #2: "Statues & Images Are Just Symbols, Not Idols."
✔️ TRUTH: Exodus 20:4-5 forbids the making and bowing before carved images. If you kneel before an image, that is worship, which belongs to God alone!

❌ LIE #3: "Candles and Incense Make Prayers More Powerful."
✔️ TRUTH: Prayer is powerful because of FAITH, not physical objects (Mark 11:24). God does not require candles for Him to listen!

❌ LIE #4: "Anointing Oil & Holy Water Have Supernatural Power."
✔️ TRUTH: Anointing oil is symbolic in Scripture (James 5:14). The power is not in the oil, but in God Himself!
🚨 Satan wants people to focus on objects instead of Jesus!

🔥 4. WHAT DID JESUS TEACH ABOUT PRAYER?
📖 Matthew 6:6 – "But when you pray, go into your room, close the door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you."
🔥 Jesus gave us a perfect model for prayer:

✔️ No beads, candles, or images—just a direct relationship with the Father.
✔️ Pray with faith, not with objects.
✔️ Worship in Spirit and Truth (John 4:24).
💡 If Jesus, the Son of God, didn’t need praying aids, why should we?

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – DELIVERED FROM IDOLATRY!
A man once relied on prayer beads, candles, and images in his prayers. He believed these objects connected him to God. But he never felt truly close to God.
🔥 One day, he read Matthew 6:7 and realized Jesus warned against vain repetition. He repented, threw away his praying aids, and started praying directly to God.
🚨 Immediately, he felt God’s presence like never before! He no longer needed objects—just faith.
💡 This is the power of TRUTH—when you remove distractions, you truly connect with God!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: SATAN WANTS YOU TO DEPEND ON OBJECTS, NOT GOD!
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 – "And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light."
🚨 Satan deceives people into thinking they need objects to reach God. He uses religion to keep people trapped in rituals instead of a real relationship with Jesus.

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Keep using objects that God never commanded?
✔️ Pray directly to God, through Jesus, with faith?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 PRAYER FOR DELIVERANCE FROM RELIGIOUS TRADITIONS
"Heavenly Father, forgive me for any times I have trusted in objects instead of You. I surrender all religious traditions that do not align with Your Word. I want to worship You in Spirit and Truth. Teach me to pray with a sincere heart. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 RELIGION WON’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 RELIGION WON’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN! 🔥
📖 Matthew 15:8 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me."
Millions of people are trapped in religion, thinking they are saved just because they belong to a church, follow traditions, or do religious activities.

🚨 But here’s the hard truth—RELIGION DOESN’T SAVE ANYONE!
❌ Attending church won’t save you.
❌ Following rituals won’t save you.
❌ Even calling yourself a Christian won’t save you.
🔥 ONLY JESUS SAVES!
👉 Are you truly following Jesus, or are you just following a system?

🔥 1. RELIGION CAN’T SAVE YOU—ONLY A RELATIONSHIP WITH JESUS CAN!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."
🔥 Many people know about Jesus—but do they KNOW Him personally?

❌ A religious person:
• Thinks good works, traditions, or rituals will get them to heaven.
• Follows a church system but doesn’t have a true connection with Jesus.
• Trusts in their church, pastor, or denomination instead of Christ alone.

✔️ A true disciple of Jesus:
• Knows they are saved by faith in Jesus, not by religion.
• Has a personal relationship with Christ, not just church membership.
• Lives every day for Jesus, not just on Sundays.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a man who wears a wedding ring and says he’s married but never talks to his wife, never loves her, and doesn’t even know her heart. Is that a real marriage?
Likewise, calling yourself a Christian doesn’t mean anything if you don’t have a real relationship with Jesus!
👉 Jesus is not looking for religious people—He is looking for true disciples!

🔥 2. RELIGIOUS TRADITIONS WITHOUT JESUS ARE EMPTY
📖 Mark 7:8 – "You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions."
🔥 Many churches today are more focused on rules, rituals, and traditions than on Jesus Himself.

❌ Religious traditions that don’t save:
• Repeating prayers without meaning them.
• Relying on sacraments, saints, or religious leaders for salvation.
• Thinking church membership guarantees heaven.

✔️ What truly matters:
• A heart that genuinely loves and obeys Jesus.
• A life transformed by the Holy Spirit.
• A personal walk with God, not just religious activities.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A person can sit inside a church every Sunday for years and still be lost.
Going to church doesn’t make you a Christian—knowing Jesus does!
👉 True Christianity is not about religion—it’s about a real relationship with Christ.

🔥 3. MANY RELIGIOUS PEOPLE WILL BE SHOCKED ON JUDGMENT DAY!
📖 Matthew 7:22-23 – "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name? ... Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Depart from Me!’"

🔥 This is one of the most terrifying verses in the Bible.
👉 Many people THINK they are saved, but Jesus will reject them. Why?

❌ Because they trusted in religion, not in Jesus.
❌ Because they followed rituals instead of truly knowing Christ.
❌ Because they had religion but NO real relationship with God.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
You can know facts about a celebrity, but that doesn’t mean you have a personal relationship with them.
Likewise, knowing ABOUT Jesus is not the same as knowing Him personally.
👉 Are you just going through religious motions, or do you truly KNOW Jesus?

🔥 4. SALVATION IS NOT ABOUT RELIGION—IT’S ABOUT GRACE!
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast."
🔥 Many churches teach that salvation comes through religious acts, but the Bible says salvation is a FREE GIFT through faith in Jesus!

❌ Religion says: "Do these things, follow these rules, and maybe you’ll be saved."
✔️ Jesus says: "Come to Me, and I will give you eternal life!" (John 10:28)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If someone gives you a free gift, but you insist on paying for it, you insult the giver.
Salvation is a free gift—stop trying to earn what Jesus already paid for!
👉 Are you relying on Jesus ALONE, or are you trusting in religion?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: STOP TRUSTING IN RELIGION—TRUST IN CHRIST!
📖 John 8:36 – "So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed."

🚨 Religion without Jesus is DEAD.
✔️ Baptism won’t save you.
✔️ Church attendance won’t save you.
✔️ Traditions won’t save you.
✔️ Good works won’t save you.

🔥 ONLY JESUS CAN SAVE YOU!
✔️ Have a personal relationship with Christ.
✔️ Trust in His finished work on the cross.
✔️ Live by faith, not by religious routines.
📖 Acts 4:12 – "Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ A system of religion?
❌ Or a true relationship with Jesus?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO FOLLOW JESUS, NOT RELIGION
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want dead religion—I want You! I surrender my life to You completely. I trust in You alone for my salvation. Teach me to walk with You daily and to follow You with all my heart. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 GOD DOES CALL THE QUALIFIED—HE QUALIFIES THE CALLED! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 GOD DOES CALL THE QUALIFIED—HE QUALIFIES THE CALLED! 🔥
📖 1 Corinthians 1:27 – "But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I feel like I’m not good enough to serve God. I see preachers, worship leaders, and strong Christians, and I think, ‘I don’t have the knowledge, the skills, or the confidence to do what they do.’ Does God really call someone like me?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people feel unworthy, unqualified, or too broken to be used by God. But here’s the TRUTH:
🚨 GOD DOESN’T CHOOSE PERFECT PEOPLE—HE TRANSFORMS ORDINARY, WEAK, AND UNLIKELY PEOPLE INTO MIGHTY WARRIORS FOR HIS KINGDOM!
If you’ve ever felt too weak, too sinful, or too inexperienced, this message is for YOU!

🔥 1. GOD USES THE UNLIKELY!
📖 Exodus 4:10 – "Moses said to the LORD, ‘Pardon your servant, Lord. I have never been eloquent... I am slow of speech and tongue.’"
🔥 Look at the people God used in the Bible:

✔️ MOSES – A stuttering man, afraid to speak, yet God used him to confront Pharaoh and lead an entire nation to freedom.
✔️ GIDEON – A fearful man hiding from his enemies, yet God called him a "mighty warrior" (Judges 6:12).
✔️ DAVID – A young shepherd boy, overlooked by his own family, yet he was chosen to be king of Israel.
✔️ PETER – A fisherman who constantly failed, denied Jesus three times, yet became the bold leader of the early Church.
✔️ PAUL – A persecutor of Christians, yet God transformed him into one of the greatest apostles.
🚨 GOD DOESN’T LOOK AT YOUR PAST—HE LOOKS AT YOUR WILLINGNESS TO OBEY HIM!
💡 Are you willing to say YES, even if you feel unqualified?

🔥 2. GOD EQUIPS THOSE HE CALLS!
📖 2 Corinthians 12:9 – "My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness."
🔥 You don’t need to be strong—GOD is strong!

✔️ GOD GIVES WISDOM – If you lack knowledge, He will teach you (James 1:5).
✔️ GOD GIVES BOLDNESS – If you’re afraid, He will fill you with courage (Acts 4:13).
✔️ GOD GIVES STRENGTH – If you feel weak, He will strengthen you (Isaiah 40:29).
✔️ GOD GIVES THE RIGHT WORDS – If you don’t know what to say, He will speak through you (Luke 12:12).
🚨 STOP FOCUSING ON WHAT YOU CAN’T DO AND START TRUSTING WHAT GOD CAN DO THROUGH YOU!
💡 Are you willing to let God equip you for His calling?

🔥 3. THE BIGGEST LIES THAT KEEP PEOPLE FROM SERVING GOD – EXPOSED!
📖 Jeremiah 1:6-7 – "‘Alas, Sovereign LORD,’ I said, ‘I do not know how to speak; I am too young.’ But the LORD said to me, ‘Do not say, "I am too young." You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.’"
🔥 Satan wants to keep you from fulfilling God’s purpose. Let’s expose his lies!

❌ LIE #1: "I’m not smart enough."
✔️ TRUTH: God gives wisdom to those who seek Him (Proverbs 2:6).

❌ LIE #2: "I’ve sinned too much—God can’t use me."
✔️ TRUTH: God forgave Paul, Peter, and David. He will forgive and use you too (1 John 1:9).

❌ LIE #3: "I’m too young / too old."
✔️ TRUTH: Jeremiah was young (Jeremiah 1:7), Abraham was old (Genesis 17:17)—God used them both!

❌ LIE #4: "I’m not a preacher or pastor—I have no title."
✔️ TRUTH: You don’t need a title to serve—just a willing heart (Colossians 3:23).
🚨 STOP LISTENING TO SATAN’S LIES AND START WALKING IN GOD’S CALLING!
💡 Will you allow excuses to stop you, or will you step out in faith?

🔥 4. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – FROM NOBODY TO GOD’S SERVANT!
A young woman felt unqualified to share the gospel. She thought, "I don’t have a Bible degree, I’m not a pastor, I don’t even know all the verses."

🔥 One day, she realized that all God wanted was her obedience. She started reading the Bible, praying for wisdom, and sharing Jesus with others. Now, she leads Bible studies and has helped many come to Christ!
🚨 SHE DIDN’T START QUALIFIED—GOD QUALIFIED HER AS SHE OBEYED!
💡 WILL YOU LET GOD DO THE SAME WITH YOU?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: GOD IS CALLING YOU—WILL YOU ANSWER?
📖 Isaiah 6:8 – "Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, ‘Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?’ And I said, ‘Here am I. Send me!’"
🚨 God is calling YOU to serve Him. Will you say YES or will you make excuses?

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Keep doubting yourself and miss your calling?
✔️ Step out in faith and let God use you mightily?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE GOD IS WAITING FOR YOUR YES!

🙏 PRAYER TO SURRENDER TO GOD’S CALLING
"Lord, I surrender my fears, my doubts, and my weaknesses to You. I know that You don’t call the qualified, but You qualify those You call. Use me for Your glory. Strengthen me, guide me, and equip me to serve You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 STOP SAYING "GOD KNOWS MY HEART" TO JUSTIFY SIN! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 STOP SAYING "GOD KNOWS MY HEART" TO JUSTIFY SIN! 🔥
📖 Jeremiah 17:9 – "The heart is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked."

How many times have you heard someone say:
🔹 "God knows my heart, so it’s okay!"
🔹 "I may not be perfect, but God understands!"
🔹 "At least I believe in God—that’s what really matters, right?"
🚨 BE WARNED: USING GOD’S GRACE AS AN EXCUSE TO STAY IN SIN IS EXTREMELY DANGEROUS!
🔥 YES, GOD KNOWS YOUR HEART—AND THAT SHOULD SCARE YOU!
👉 Are you using God’s grace as a license to keep sinning?

🔥 1. THE HEART IS NOT PURE—IT IS DECEITFUL AND WICKED!
📖 Jeremiah 17:9 – "The heart is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked. Who can understand it?"
🔥 Many people think their heart is naturally good—but GOD SAYS IT IS NOT!

❌ WRONG BELIEF: "I don’t need to change—God knows my heart."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: "Your heart is naturally sinful and needs to be transformed by Jesus!"

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A person commits a crime and tells the judge, "But my heart is good!"
👉 Will the judge let them go free? NO! They must face justice!
👉 God is not fooled by our words—He sees what is truly in our hearts!

🔥 2. GOD WILL NOT IGNORE UNREPENTANT SIN!
📖 Romans 6:1-2 – "Shall we go on sinning so that grace may increase? By no means! We are those who have died to sin; how can we live in it any longer?"
🔥 God’s grace is NOT a free pass to keep living in sin!

❌ WRONG BELIEF: "As long as I believe in God, my sins don’t matter."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: "True faith leads to repentance and change!"

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A husband tells his wife he loves her but constantly cheats on her.
👉 Would she believe him? NO! Love without action is empty!
👉 If we truly love God, our lives will show it!

🔥 3. A CHANGED HEART PRODUCES A CHANGED LIFE!
📖 Ezekiel 36:26 – "I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you."
🔥 If you are truly saved, your heart will change—and so will your actions!

❌ A FALSE CHRISTIAN:
• Lives in sin but says, "God knows my heart."
• Never repents or seeks change.
• Ignores God’s commands but expects His blessings.

✔️ A TRUE CHRISTIAN:
• Strives to obey God and live righteously.
• Repents when they fall into sin.
• Desires to grow in faith and holiness.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A tree is known by its fruit.
👉 If an apple tree never produces apples, is it really an apple tree?
Likewise, if someone claims to be a Christian but their life never changes, are they really saved?
👉 A true Christian doesn’t just talk about God—they live for Him!

🔥 4. DON’T BE DECEIVED—LIP SERVICE WON’T FOOL GOD!
📖 Matthew 7:21 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven."
🔥 Many people will be SHOCKED on Judgment Day when Jesus rejects them!

❌ They called Him ‘Lord’ but never obeyed Him!
❌ They went to church but never truly repented!
❌ They relied on religion but never surrendered to Jesus!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A student who never studies but expects to pass the exam is deceiving himself.
Likewise, a person who lives in sin but expects heaven is fooling themselves!
👉 Faith without obedience is a LIE!

🔥 5. STOP MAKING EXCUSES—REPENT AND LIVE FOR JESUS!
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out."
🔥 GOD WANTS TO TRANSFORM YOU—BUT YOU MUST SURRENDER TO HIM!

❌ STOP SAYING:
• "Nobody’s perfect!"
• "God knows my heart!"
• "At least I believe in Him!"

✔️ START SAYING:
• "Lord, change my heart!"
• "I surrender my life to You!"
• "Help me live in obedience!"

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A sick person refuses medicine because they believe they "feel fine."
👉 Will they be healed? NO! They are rejecting the cure!
Likewise, when people refuse to repent, they reject the only cure for sin—JESUS!
👉 God knows your heart—NOW LET HIM CHANGE IT!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DON’T ABUSE GOD’S GRACE!
📖 Hebrews 10:26 – "If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
🚨 God’s mercy is great, but His justice is real. DO NOT TEST HIM!

✔️ True faith produces obedience.
✔️ True grace leads to transformation.
✔️ True love for God means turning away from sin.
📖 Luke 6:46 – "Why do you call Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?"

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ A life of excuses and sin?
❌ Or full surrender to Jesus?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SURRENDER FULLY TO JESUS
"Lord Jesus, forgive me for using Your grace as an excuse to stay in sin. I surrender my life completely to You! Transform my heart and help me live in obedience. I choose to follow You fully, with no more excuses. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"

title: 🔥 BORN AGAIN OR BURN AGAIN? – THE MOST IMPORTANT DECISION OF YOUR LIFE! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 BORN AGAIN OR BURN AGAIN? – THE MOST IMPORTANT DECISION OF YOUR LIFE! 🔥
📖 John 3:3 – "Jesus replied, 'Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again.'"

🚨 There are only two options for every person on earth:
✔️ Be BORN AGAIN in Christ and receive eternal life.
❌ Or BURN AGAIN in the lake of fire for rejecting Jesus.
🔥 There is no middle ground! No second chance after death! No "I’m a good person" excuse!

Jesus didn’t say, "Try your best."
He didn’t say, "Just go to church."
He said, "YOU MUST BE BORN AGAIN!"
👉 So what does it mean to be born again? Why is it the ONLY way to heaven? And what happens if you refuse?
Let’s uncover the BIBLICAL TRUTH before it’s too late!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO BE BORN AGAIN?
📖 John 3:5-7 – "Jesus answered, 'Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit. Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit. You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’"
🔥 Being born again is NOT about physical birth—it’s a SPIRITUAL REBIRTH!

✔️ You were born in sin through Adam. (Romans 5:12)
✔️ You need a new birth through Christ. (2 Corinthians 5:17)
✔️ This happens when the Holy Spirit transforms you from the inside out! (Titus 3:5)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A caterpillar doesn’t stay the same—it goes through a radical transformation into a butterfly.
👉 When you are born again, you don’t just "improve"—you become a NEW CREATION!
🚨 If you are not born again, you will NOT see heaven!

🔥 2. WHY MUST YOU BE BORN AGAIN?
📖 Romans 3:23 – "For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God."
🚨 SIN has corrupted every person from birth.

❌ Good works CANNOT erase your sin. (Ephesians 2:8-9)
❌ Religion CANNOT save you. (Mark 7:7-8)
❌ Church attendance CANNOT make you right with God. (Matthew 7:21-23)
🔥 ONLY JESUS CAN SAVE YOU!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A person drowning in the ocean doesn’t need swimming lessons—they need a Savior!
👉 Jesus didn’t come to improve your life—He came to RESCUE YOU from eternal death!
🚨 Without being born again, you WILL burn again!

🔥 3. WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU REFUSE TO BE BORN AGAIN?
📖 Revelation 20:15 – "Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire."
🚨 Hell is NOT a metaphor. It is real, eternal, and unavoidable for those who reject Jesus!

✔️ HELL IS A PLACE OF ETERNAL TORMENT! (Mark 9:43-48)
✔️ THERE IS NO ESCAPE AFTER DEATH! (Hebrews 9:27)
✔️ GOD DOESN’T SEND PEOPLE TO HELL—THEY CHOOSE IT BY REJECTING JESUS!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a person refuses a parachute before jumping out of a plane, whose fault is it when they hit the ground?
👉 Jesus is offering you a way out—will you take it?
🔥 YOU MUST CHOOSE: BORN AGAIN OR BURN AGAIN!

🔥 4. HOW TO BE BORN AGAIN AND ESCAPE ETERNAL FIRE!
📖 Acts 2:38 – "Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit."
🔥 5 STEPS TO BE TRULY BORN AGAIN:

✔️ 1. ADMIT YOU ARE A SINNER WHO NEEDS A SAVIOR. (Romans 3:23)
✔️ 2. BELIEVE THAT JESUS DIED FOR YOUR SINS AND ROSE AGAIN. (Romans 10:9)
✔️ 3. REPENT AND TURN AWAY FROM YOUR OLD LIFE. (Luke 13:3)
✔️ 4. SURRENDER TO JESUS AS YOUR LORD AND SAVIOR. (Romans 10:13)
✔️ 5. RECEIVE THE HOLY SPIRIT AND WALK IN OBEDIENCE. (Galatians 5:16)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
You don’t just "believe" in parachutes—you PUT IT ON!
👉 You don’t just "believe" in Jesus—you SURRENDER to Him completely!
🚨 TODAY is the day of salvation—DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: HEAVEN OR HELL—WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
📖 2 Corinthians 6:2 – "Now is the time of God’s favor, now is the day of salvation!"

🚨 YOU CANNOT AVOID THIS DECISION!
❌ If you are not born again, you are still DEAD in sin.
❌ If you reject Jesus, you will burn in eternal fire.
❌ If you wait too long, it will be TOO LATE!
🔥 BUT JESUS IS CALLING YOU RIGHT NOW! WILL YOU ANSWER?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ BORN AGAIN – Eternal Life with Jesus?
❌ BURN AGAIN – Eternal Separation in Hell?
🚨 THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT DECISION OF YOUR LIFE!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO BE BORN AGAIN
"Lord Jesus, I confess that I am a sinner and I need You to save me. I believe You died and rose again for me. I repent of my sins and surrender my life to You. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and make me a new creation. I am now born again in You! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 WHY DO PRIESTS CALL THEMSELVES ‘FATHER’? – THE TRUTH REVEALED! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 WHY DO PRIESTS CALL THEMSELVES ‘FATHER’? – THE TRUTH REVEALED! 🔥
📖 Matthew 23:9 – "And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and He is in heaven."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I always hear Catholic priests being called ‘Father,’ but Jesus clearly said, ‘Call no man father.’ Is this practice biblical, or is it a man-made tradition?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people blindly accept religious traditions without ever asking, "Is this in the Bible?"
🚨 Today, we will expose the truth—what Jesus REALLY meant and whether priests should be called "Father."
Let’s dive into BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. WHAT DID JESUS MEAN BY ‘CALL NO MAN FATHER’?
📖 Matthew 23:8-10 – "But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers. And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and He is in heaven. Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah."
🔥 Jesus was NOT talking about biological fathers (because the Bible commands us to honor them). Instead, He was warning about spiritual pride and religious leaders who exalt themselves above others.
🚨 In Matthew 23, Jesus was rebuking the Pharisees—the corrupt religious leaders who loved titles, power, and control over people.

✔️ They loved to be honored and worshiped.
✔️ They made themselves spiritual authorities above others.
✔️ They added traditions that were not from God.
💡 Does this sound familiar? Many religious leaders today demand honor, titles, and obedience—just like the Pharisees!
🚨 Jesus warned us: DO NOT follow their example!

🔥 2. IS IT BIBLICAL TO CALL A PRIEST ‘FATHER’?
🔥 NO! This practice is NOT found in the Bible—it is a man-made religious tradition.
📖 Mark 7:8 – "You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions."

The Roman Catholic Church justifies calling priests "Father," saying it is a term of respect. But the real danger is that many people see priests as having divine authority, placing them between God and man.
🚨 This is unbiblical! There is only ONE mediator between God and man—JESUS CHRIST!
📖 1 Timothy 2:5 – "For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus."
🔥 No priest, pope, or pastor has the power to stand between you and God!
💡 Are you following Jesus, or religious traditions?

🔥 3. PRIESTS CLAIM TO FORGIVE SINS—BUT ONLY GOD CAN!
📖 Luke 5:21 – "Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
🔥 Catholic priests not only call themselves "Father," but they also claim to have the power to forgive sins.
🚨 This is a dangerous deception! The Bible is clear: ONLY GOD CAN FORGIVE SINS!
📖 1 John 1:9 – "If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness."

❌ Confessing sins to a priest is NOT biblical.
✔️ The Bible commands us to confess directly to God!
🚨 If you are trusting in a priest for forgiveness, you are putting your faith in man, NOT in Jesus!
💡 Who do you trust for your salvation—Jesus, or a religious system?

🔥 4. RELIGIOUS LEADERS EXALTING THEMSELVES = A DANGEROUS SIGN!
📖 Matthew 23:12 – "For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."
🔥 Jesus never gave His disciples titles like "Father," "Pope," or "Priest." Instead, He told them to be humble servants.

✔️ Jesus washed His disciples’ feet (John 13:14-15).
✔️ The apostles never took special titles—they called themselves "servants of Christ" (Romans 1:1).
✔️ Peter, whom Catholics claim was the "first pope," rejected worship (Acts 10:25-26).
🚨 But today, many priests, popes, and religious leaders demand honor, power, and recognition.
💡 Are you following humble servants of Christ, or prideful men who seek their own glory?

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – ESCAPING RELIGIOUS DECEPTION!
A Catholic man once believed that only priests could forgive sins and that the pope was the "Holy Father."
🔥 One day, he read Matthew 23:9 and realized that Jesus forbids calling religious leaders ‘Father.’
🚨 He searched the Bible and found that salvation is through Jesus ALONE—not through priests, popes, or the Catholic Church.
🔥 He left man-made religion and gave his life fully to Christ!
💡 Are you following Jesus, or just following religious traditions?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: RELIGIOUS TITLES WILL NOT SAVE YOU!
📖 Galatians 1:8 – "But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let them be under God’s curse!"
🚨 Millions are being deceived into following religious systems instead of following Jesus!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Blindly follow religious traditions that go against the Bible?
✔️ Follow Jesus Christ, who is the ONLY way to salvation?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE YOUR ETERNITY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 PRAYER TO FOLLOW JESUS, NOT RELIGION
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to see the truth. I want to follow YOU, not man-made traditions. I surrender my life to You alone. Teach me Your ways, and help me walk in truth. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TWO DEBTORS – DO YOU UNDERSTAND GOD’S FORGIVENESS? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TWO DEBTORS – DO YOU UNDERSTAND GOD’S FORGIVENESS? 🔥
📖 Luke 7:41-42 – "Two people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty. Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what does the Parable of the Two Debtors really mean? Is Jesus teaching about money, or is there a deeper lesson?"
🔥 GREAT QUESTION! This parable is not just about debt—it’s about SIN, FORGIVENESS, and TRUE LOVE FOR GOD!
🚨 If you don’t realize how much you’ve been forgiven, you’ll never truly love Jesus!
⚠️ WARNING: Those who think they are "good people" don’t see their need for salvation!
Let’s dive into this powerful parable and see what Jesus was teaching!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE TWO DEBTORS?
📖 Luke 7:41-42 – "Two people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty. Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"
🔥 JESUS TELLS THIS PARABLE TO TEACH ABOUT FORGIVENESS!

✔️ The moneylender represents God.
✔️ The two debtors represent sinners (ALL OF US!).
✔️ The forgiveness of debt represents God’s mercy in forgiving sin.
💡 The one who was forgiven more, loved more!
🚨 DO YOU REALIZE HOW MUCH GOD HAS FORGIVEN YOU?

🔥 2. THE CONTEXT – WHY DID JESUS TELL THIS PARABLE?
📖 Luke 7:36-39 – "A woman who had lived a sinful life brought an alabaster jar of perfume, stood behind Jesus at His feet weeping, and began to wash His feet with her tears."
🔥 THE STORY BEHIND THE PARABLE:

✔️ Jesus was eating at the house of a Pharisee named Simon.
✔️ A sinful woman (likely a prostitute) entered and wept at Jesus’ feet.
✔️ She poured expensive perfume on His feet, showing her deep love for Him.
✔️ The Pharisee judged her, thinking, "If Jesus were a prophet, He would know what kind of woman this is!"
🚨 RELIGIOUS PEOPLE THINK THEY ARE BETTER THAN OTHERS—BUT THEY DON’T REALIZE THEIR OWN SIN!
💡 DO YOU SEE YOURSELF AS "GOOD" OR AS A SINNER WHO NEEDS GOD’S GRACE?

🔥 3. WHO LOVES MORE? THE ONE WHO IS FORGIVEN MORE!
📖 Luke 7:43 – "Simon replied, ‘I suppose the one who had the bigger debt forgiven.’ ‘You have judged correctly,’ Jesus said."
🔥 THE LESSON:

✔️ The Pharisee thought he was righteous because he followed religious rules.
✔️ The sinful woman KNEW she was broken and needed Jesus’ mercy.
✔️ Jesus was teaching that those who recognize their deep sin will love God more!
🚨 THE MORE YOU UNDERSTAND GOD’S FORGIVENESS, THE MORE YOU WILL LOVE HIM!
💡 DO YOU TRULY APPRECIATE WHAT JESUS HAS DONE FOR YOU?

🔥 4. THE DANGER OF SELF-RIGHTEOUSNESS!
📖 Luke 7:44-46 – "Then He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, ‘Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give Me any water for My feet, but she wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.’"
🔥 SIMON THE PHARISEE REPRESENTS MANY RELIGIOUS PEOPLE TODAY:

❌ He INVITED Jesus into his house, but not into his heart.
❌ He thought he was BETTER than the sinful woman.
❌ He didn’t show LOVE or HUMILITY toward Jesus.
🚨 RELIGION CAN MAKE YOU BLIND TO YOUR OWN SINS!
💡 ARE YOU HUMBLE LIKE THE WOMAN OR PROUD LIKE SIMON?

🔥 5. TRUE FAITH LEADS TO FORGIVENESS AND LOVE!
📖 Luke 7:47-50 – "Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven—as her great love has shown. But whoever has been forgiven little loves little. Then Jesus said to her, ‘Your sins are forgiven.’"
🔥 KEY LESSONS FROM JESUS:

✔️ FORGIVENESS IS AVAILABLE TO ALL, NO MATTER HOW GREAT THE SIN! (Isaiah 1:18)
✔️ LOVE FOR GOD GROWS WHEN YOU UNDERSTAND HIS MERCY! (Romans 5:8)
✔️ RELIGION WITHOUT LOVE IS EMPTY! (1 Corinthians 13:1-3)
🚨 IF YOU THINK YOU DON’T NEED MUCH FORGIVENESS, YOU WILL NEVER TRULY LOVE GOD!
💡 HAVE YOU FULLY RECEIVED GOD’S FORGIVENESS?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: HAVE YOU TRULY REPENTED?
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Be like Simon—self-righteous and blind to your own sin?
✔️ Be like the woman—humble, repentant, and fully surrendered to Jesus?
🚨 JESUS IS READY TO FORGIVE YOU—BUT YOU MUST REPENT!
💡 DO YOU TRULY UNDERSTAND HOW MUCH YOU HAVE BEEN FORGIVEN?

🙏 PRAYER FOR FORGIVENESS AND LOVE FOR JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I acknowledge that I am a sinner in need of Your grace. Forgive me for every sin I have committed. Thank You for dying on the cross for me. Fill my heart with love for You, just like the woman in this story. Help me to never take Your mercy for granted. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 "BROTHER JOHN, WHY DO YOU HATE CATHOLICS? WHY CAN’T YOU JUST RESPECT THEIR BELIEFS?" 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 "BROTHER JOHN, WHY DO YOU HATE CATHOLICS? WHY CAN’T YOU JUST RESPECT THEIR BELIEFS?" 🔥
📖 John 8:32 – "Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, why do you always expose false teachings? Why can’t you just respect the Catholic faith? Are you against Catholics?"
🔥 THIS IS A POWERFUL QUESTION! And let me make this clear right away: I DO NOT HATE CATHOLICS. I LOVE THEM, JUST AS GOD LOVES THEM!
🚨 WHAT I HATE IS DECEPTION, LIES, AND FALSE DOCTRINES THAT LEAD PEOPLE AWAY FROM THE TRUE JESUS!
⚠️ WARNING: Many people mistake exposing falsehoods as "hatred," but Jesus Himself warned against FALSE RELIGION.
Let’s dive into this topic with love, truth, and biblical clarity.

🔥 1. GOD LOVES CATHOLICS—BUT JESUS DESPISES LIES AND FALSE DOCTRINE!
📖 Matthew 15:8-9 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. They worship Me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules."
🔥 JESUS WARNED US ABOUT FALSE TEACHINGS:

✔️ He rebuked religious leaders for misleading people. (Matthew 23:13-15)
✔️ He called out traditions that replaced God’s commands. (Mark 7:6-9)
✔️ He said the truth will set us free, not religion. (John 8:32)
🚨 RELIGION DOESN’T SAVE ANYONE—ONLY JESUS CAN!
💡 LOVING SOMEONE MEANS WARNING THEM IF THEY ARE BEING DECEIVED!

🔥 2. I EXPOSE FALSE TEACHINGS BECAUSE I DON’T WANT ANYONE TO GO TO HELL!
📖 2 Peter 3:9 – "The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise, as some understand slowness. Instead, He is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance."
🔥 IF YOU LOVE SOMEONE, YOU TELL THEM THE TRUTH!

❌ If a doctor knew you had cancer but didn’t tell you, is that love? NO!
❌ If a fireman saw your house burning but didn’t wake you up, is that love? NO!
❌ If a pastor sees people heading to hell but stays silent, is that love? NO!
🚨 THE GREATEST FORM OF HATE IS TO KNOW THE TRUTH AND NOT SHARE IT!
💡 I PREACH THIS BECAUSE I WANT PEOPLE TO BE SAVED—NOT BECAUSE I HATE THEM!

🔥 3. WHAT FALSE TEACHINGS DOES CATHOLICISM TEACH?
📖 Colossians 2:8 – "See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than on Christ."
🔥 HERE ARE SOME MAJOR FALSE CATHOLIC TEACHINGS THAT CONTRADICT THE BIBLE:

❌ Praying to Mary & Saints – The Bible says we must pray to God ALONE (1 Timothy 2:5).
❌ Purgatory – There is no purgatory in Scripture. We either go to Heaven or Hell (Hebrews 9:27).
❌ Salvation by Works – The Bible teaches we are saved by grace through faith, not by works (Ephesians 2:8-9).
❌ The Pope as "Holy Father" – Jesus said we should call no man "Father" in a spiritual sense (Matthew 23:9).
🚨 JESUS DIDN’T COME TO START A RELIGION—HE CAME TO SET US FREE FROM RELIGION!
💡 DO YOU FOLLOW TRADITION OR DO YOU FOLLOW CHRIST?

🔥 4. SHOULD WE "JUST RESPECT" FALSE BELIEFS?
📖 Ephesians 5:11 – "Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them."
🔥 JESUS NEVER SAID TO "RESPECT" LIES—HE SAID TO EXPOSE THEM!

❌ Did Jesus respect the Pharisees’ false teachings? NO! He rebuked them! (Matthew 23:13-15)
❌ Did the apostles respect idol worship? NO! They preached against it! (Acts 17:22-23)
❌ Did Paul respect false gospels? NO! He called them accursed! (Galatians 1:8-9)
🚨 TOLERATING FALSE TEACHINGS IS NOT LOVE—IT’S COWARDICE!
💡 IF YOU KNOW THE TRUTH, YOU HAVE A DUTY TO SHARE IT!

🔥 5. JESUS LOVES YOU—BUT HE CALLS YOU TO LEAVE FALSEHOOD BEHIND!
📖 Revelation 18:4 – "Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins."
🔥 IF YOU ARE IN A FALSE RELIGION, JESUS IS CALLING YOU OUT!

✔️ Jesus didn’t tell the Pharisees, "Stay in your false beliefs, and I respect that." He called them to REPENT!
✔️ Jesus didn’t say, "Follow traditions if they make you feel good." He said, "Follow ME!" (Matthew 16:24)
🚨 TRUE LOVE IS CALLING PEOPLE OUT OF DARKNESS AND INTO THE LIGHT!
💡 ARE YOU WILLING TO FOLLOW THE TRUTH, EVEN IF IT MEANS LEAVING RELIGION BEHIND?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: RELIGION CAN’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay comfortable in man-made traditions that lead to destruction?
✔️ Follow JESUS ALONE and let the truth set you free?
🚨 RELIGION LEADS TO BONDAGE—JESUS LEADS TO FREEDOM!
💡 Will you follow Jesus or follow tradition?

🙏 PRAYER TO LEAVE RELIGION AND FOLLOW JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I want to follow You, not man-made traditions. Open my eyes to the truth. If I have been deceived, show me Your way. I surrender to You alone as my Lord and Savior. Save me, guide me, and fill me with Your Spirit. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 DID CONSTANTINE CHANGE THE SABBATH TO SUNDAY? SHOULD WE WORSHIP ON SATURDAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 DID CONSTANTINE CHANGE THE SABBATH TO SUNDAY? SHOULD WE WORSHIP ON SATURDAY? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, I heard that Constantine changed the Sabbath from Saturday to Sunday to honor a pagan sun god. Does this mean Christians should go back to worshiping on Saturday? What does the Bible really say about the Sabbath?"

🚨 MANY CHRISTIANS ARE CONFUSED ABOUT THE SABBATH! Some say worshiping on Sunday is a pagan practice, while others believe we are still under the Old Testament Law. But what does Jesus actually teach? Should we worship only on Saturday, or is every day meant for God?
📖 Key Verse: "So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31)
🔥 THE TRUTH WILL SHOCK YOU! LET’S EXPOSE THE HISTORY AND THE SCRIPTURES! 🔥

🔥 1. DID CONSTANTINE CHANGE THE SABBATH? YES—BUT NOT FOR BIBLICAL REASONS!
📖 Exodus 20:8 – "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy."

💡 ORIGINALLY, THE SABBATH (REST DAY) WAS ON SATURDAY!
✔️ The Jews observed the Sabbath on Saturday because it was the 7th day when God rested (Genesis 2:2-3).
✔️ Jesus and His disciples attended the synagogue on the Sabbath (Luke 4:16).
✔️ The early Christians gathered on different days, including the first day of the week (Sunday).

🚨 THEN CAME CONSTANTINE!
In 321 AD, Emperor Constantine officially declared Sunday as the Roman day of rest, NOT because of Jesus, but because of his devotion to the pagan sun god, Sol Invictus!

📜 HISTORICAL PROOF:
✔️ Constantine was a former sun-worshiper who still honored pagan traditions.
✔️ He wanted to unite Christians and pagans under one empire.
✔️ He merged Christian beliefs with Roman sun-worship, making Sunday the official day of rest.
📖 Historical Record: "On the venerable Day of the Sun, let the magistrates and people residing in cities rest." (Constantine’s Edict of 321 AD)
🚨 CONSTANTINE’S SUNDAY LAW WAS NOT A COMMAND FROM GOD—IT WAS A POLITICAL MOVE!

🔥 2. DOES THE NEW TESTAMENT COMMAND US TO WORSHIP ON SATURDAY?
📖 Romans 14:5 – "One person considers one day more sacred than another; another considers every day alike. Each of them should be fully convinced in their own mind."
💡 THE EARLY CHURCH WORSHIPED DAILY—NOT JUST ON SATURDAY!

✔️ The first Christians gathered EVERY DAY (Acts 2:46-47).
✔️ Jesus never commanded a specific day for worship—He taught us to worship in spirit and truth (John 4:23-24).
✔️ Paul said we are not judged by Sabbath days! (Colossians 2:16)
📖 Acts 20:7 – "On the first day of the week (Sunday), we came together to break bread."
🚨 TRUE WORSHIP IS NOT ABOUT A SPECIFIC DAY—IT’S ABOUT A LIFESTYLE!

🔥 3. JESUS TAUGHT US TO WORSHIP EVERY DAY!
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:16-18 – "Rejoice always, pray without ceasing, give thanks in all circumstances."
💡 IF YOU ONLY WORSHIP GOD ON ONE DAY, YOU ARE MISSING THE POINT!

✔️ Jesus said we must pray without ceasing—day and night! (Luke 18:1)
✔️ Paul said EVERYTHING we do should glorify God! (1 Corinthians 10:31)
✔️ True worship is not limited to one day—it is every moment of our lives!
🚨 THE BIGGEST LIE IS THAT WORSHIP IS LIMITED TO A SINGLE DAY!

🔥 4. DOES IT MATTER IF WE WORSHIP ON SATURDAY OR SUNDAY?
📖 Colossians 2:16-17 – "Do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a religious festival, a New Moon celebration, or a Sabbath day. These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ."
💡 IN CHRIST, THE SABBATH IS NOT A DAY—IT IS A PERSON!

✔️ The Old Testament Sabbath was a foreshadowing of Jesus, who gives us true rest! (Hebrews 4:9-11)
✔️ Every day belongs to the Lord—not just one day!
✔️ It is not about WHICH day we worship, but WHO we worship!
🚨 TRUE SABBATH REST IS FOUND IN JESUS—NOT IN A CALENDAR DAY!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I WILL WORSHIP GOD EVERY DAY—NOT JUST ONE DAY A WEEK!"

🔥 THE TRUE WORSHIP CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Don’t limit your worship to one day—glorify God DAILY!
✅ Step 2: Share this truth—help others break free from religious traditions!
✅ Step 3: Live in the freedom and rest that Jesus provides!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TRUE WORSHIP & FREEDOM IN CHRIST! 🙏
Heavenly Father, thank You for the truth of Your Word. Help me to understand that true worship is not about a specific day, but about honoring You in everything I do.

Lord Jesus, You are my true rest and my eternal Sabbath. I reject the lies of legalism and religious traditions that keep people in bondage. Fill me with the Holy Spirit, so that I may worship You in spirit and in truth—every day of my life!
Help me to break free from man-made doctrines and walk in the freedom of Christ! Let my heart burn with passion to glorify You every moment of my life.
🔥 In Jesus’ mighty name, I pray. Amen! 🔥
🔥 #SabbathTruth #JesusIsOurRest #WorshipDaily #BiblicalTruth #FaithOverTradition #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE WISE AND FOOLISH BUILDERS – IS YOUR LIFE BUILT ON THE ROCK? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE WISE AND FOOLISH BUILDERS – IS YOUR LIFE BUILT ON THE ROCK? 🔥
📖 Matthew 7:24-27 – "Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock. The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock. But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand. The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell with a great crash."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what did Jesus mean in the Parable of the Wise and Foolish Builders? What is the ‘rock’ and how do I know if my life is built on it?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people call themselves Christians, but when trials come, their faith collapses. Why? Because they were never built on the ROCK!
🚨 Today, we will uncover the powerful meaning of this parable and why your entire eternity depends on what foundation you are standing on!
⚠️ WARNING: If your life is built on the wrong foundation, disaster is coming!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES THE PARABLE MEAN?
📖 Luke 6:47-48 – "As for everyone who comes to Me and hears My words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like. They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built."
🔥 JESUS COMPARES TWO TYPES OF PEOPLE:

✔️ THE WISE BUILDER – Hears the Word of God and OBEYS it.
✔️ THE FOOLISH BUILDER – Hears the Word but IGNORES it.
💡 The FOUNDATION represents what you build your life on.
🚨 If you are not built on the right foundation, you will collapse in times of trouble!
💡 Are you a wise or a foolish builder?

🔥 2. WHAT DOES THE "ROCK" REPRESENT?
📖 1 Corinthians 3:11 – "For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ."
🔥 THE ROCK REPRESENTS:

✔️ JESUS CHRIST! (Psalm 18:2, 1 Corinthians 10:4)
✔️ OBEDIENCE TO GOD’S WORD! (James 1:22-25)
✔️ A STRONG, UNMOVABLE FAITH! (Matthew 16:18)
💡 A life built on Jesus and obedience to His Word will NEVER fall!
🚀 BUT IF YOU BUILD ON ANYTHING ELSE—YOU ARE HEADED FOR DISASTER!

🔥 3. WHAT DOES THE "SAND" REPRESENT?
📖 Proverbs 14:12 – "There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end, it leads to death."
🔥 THE SAND REPRESENTS:

❌ Worldly success and riches. (Mark 8:36)
❌ False teachings and man-made religion. (Colossians 2:8)
❌ Feelings-based Christianity. (Jeremiah 17:9)
❌ A life of sin and compromise. (Galatians 5:19-21)
🚨 If your foundation is weak, when the storms of life hit, your faith will CRUMBLE!
💡 Are you standing on the Rock, or sinking in the sand?

🔥 4. STORMS WILL COME – WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO YOUR HOUSE?
📖 John 16:33 – "In this world, you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world."
🔥 THE STORMS REPRESENT:

✔️ Trials and suffering. (James 1:2-4)
✔️ Persecution for your faith. (2 Timothy 3:12)
✔️ Spiritual attacks from the enemy. (Ephesians 6:12)
🚨 If your faith is weak, these storms will WIPE YOU OUT!
🔥 BUT IF YOU ARE BUILT ON CHRIST, YOU WILL STAND STRONG!
💡 WHAT FOUNDATION WILL YOU STAND ON WHEN THE STORM COMES?

🔥 5. HOW TO BUILD YOUR LIFE ON THE ROCK!
📖 James 1:22 – "Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says."
🔥 STEPS TO BUILD ON THE ROCK:

✔️ SURRENDER TO JESUS CHRIST AS LORD! (Romans 10:9-10)
✔️ READ AND OBEY GOD’S WORD DAILY! (Psalm 119:105)
✔️ LIVE IN HOLINESS AND REPENTANCE! (2 Corinthians 7:1)
✔️ PRAY AND SEEK GOD CONTINUALLY! (1 Thessalonians 5:16-18)
✔️ STAND FIRM IN TRIALS! (1 Peter 5:8-10)
🚨 DON’T JUST HEAR THE WORD—OBEY IT!
💡 ARE YOU BUILDING YOUR LIFE ON THE ROCK OR ON THE SAND?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: CHOOSE YOUR FOUNDATION WISELY!
📖 Deuteronomy 30:19 – "I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ A weak foundation that will crumble in the storm?
✔️ A strong foundation built on Jesus Christ that will NEVER fail?
🚨 THE TIME TO CHOOSE IS NOW—TOMORROW IS NOT GUARANTEED!
💡 WILL YOU STAND STRONG, OR WILL YOU FALL?

🙏 PRAYER TO BUILD YOUR LIFE ON JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I want to build my life on You, the solid Rock. Forgive me for trusting in worldly things. Teach me to obey Your Word and follow You completely. Strengthen my faith so I can stand firm in every storm. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TEN VIRGINS—ARE YOU READY FOR THE RETURN OF JESUS? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TEN VIRGINS—ARE YOU READY FOR THE RETURN OF JESUS? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, what does the Parable of the Ten Virgins mean? Is it just about a wedding, or is Jesus warning us about something bigger?"

🚨 MANY PEOPLE THINK THEY ARE READY FOR JESUS—BUT ARE THEY REALLY PREPARED? The Parable of the Ten Virgins is one of the most serious warnings Jesus gave about the End Times, and most Christians today are ignoring it!
📖 Key Verse: "Therefore, keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour." (Matthew 25:13)
🔥 ARE YOU A WISE VIRGIN OR A FOOLISH ONE? 🔥

🔥 1. THE PARABLE OF THE TEN VIRGINS (MATTHEW 25:1-13)
📖 "At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Five of them were foolish, and five were wise. The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them. The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps. The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep. At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’"
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS PARABLE MEAN?

✔️ The Virgins = Those who claim to follow Jesus.
✔️ The Bridegroom = Jesus Christ.
✔️ The Wedding Feast = The Kingdom of Heaven.
✔️ The Oil = The Holy Spirit & true faith.
✔️ The Closed Door = Judgment—too late to enter!
🔥 THIS IS A WARNING: MANY WILL BE LEFT OUTSIDE WHEN JESUS RETURNS!

🔥 2. WHY WERE THE FIVE VIRGINS CALLED FOOLISH?
📖 Matthew 25:3 – "The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them."
💡 THEY LOOKED READY, BUT THEY WEREN’T PREPARED!

❌ They had lamps but no oil – They had religion, but not the Holy Spirit.
❌ They waited but were not prepared – They thought they had time to fix things later.
❌ They asked for oil at the last minute – You cannot borrow someone else’s salvation!
❌ The door was SHUT on them – They were locked out of God’s Kingdom FOREVER.
🚨 HOW MANY "CHRISTIANS" TODAY ARE JUST LIKE THE FOOLISH VIRGINS?

✔️ They go to church but don’t have a real relationship with Jesus.
✔️ They say they believe but live like the world.
✔️ They think they have time to get serious about God "later."
✔️ They don’t read the Bible, don’t pray, don’t evangelize.
🔥 DO NOT WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE! THE DOOR WILL BE SHUT! 🔥

🔥 3. WHAT MADE THE WISE VIRGINS DIFFERENT?
📖 Matthew 25:4 – "The wise ones took oil in jars along with their lamps."
💡 THEY WERE PREPARED—THEY LIVED EVERY DAY READY FOR JESUS!

✔️ THEY HAD OIL – They were filled with the Holy Spirit and walked in obedience.
✔️ THEY KEPT THEIR LAMPS BURNING – They stayed faithful, prayerful, and watchful.
✔️ THEY DIDN’T RELY ON OTHERS’ FAITH – They had a personal relationship with Jesus.
✔️ THEY WERE ALERT AND READY – They knew Jesus could return at any moment!
🚨 IF JESUS CAME BACK TONIGHT, WOULD YOU BE A WISE OR A FOOLISH VIRGIN?

🔥 4. THE DOOR WILL BE SHUT—NO SECOND CHANCES!
📖 Matthew 25:10 – "And the door was shut."
💡 WHEN JESUS RETURNS, THERE WILL BE NO LAST-MINUTE EXCUSES!

❌ The foolish virgins begged, "Lord, Lord, open the door!"
❌ Jesus answered, "Truly, I tell you, I do not know you!" (Matthew 25:12)
🚨 THIS IS A TERRIFYING WARNING! Many people think they are saved, but they will hear Jesus say, "I NEVER KNEW YOU!" (Matthew 7:21-23)
🔥 DO NOT GAMBLE WITH YOUR ETERNITY! BE READY EVERY DAY! 🔥

🔥 5. HOW TO BE A WISE VIRGIN—HOW TO PREPARE FOR JESUS’ RETURN!
📖 Revelation 16:15 – "Behold, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his garments on, so that he may not go about naked and be seen exposed!"
💡 THE TIME IS NOW—THIS IS HOW TO BE READY!

✔️ SURRENDER TO JESUS – Make Him Lord over every part of your life! (Romans 10:9)
✔️ BE FILLED WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT – You need His power to endure! (Acts 1:8)
✔️ LIVE IN HOLINESS – No more compromise with sin! (1 Peter 1:16)
✔️ READ & OBEY THE BIBLE DAILY – God’s Word must guide your life! (Psalm 119:105)
✔️ EVANGELIZE & MAKE DISCIPLES – Your purpose is to spread the Gospel! (Matthew 28:19-20)
✔️ STAY FAITHFUL UNTIL THE END – Don’t give up, Jesus is coming! (Revelation 3:11)
🚨 DON’T WAIT UNTIL THE LAST MINUTE—THE DOOR WILL BE SHUT!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I WILL NOT BE A FOOLISH VIRGIN! I CHOOSE TO BE READY FOR JESUS EVERY DAY!"

🔥 THE FINAL PREPARATION CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly ready for Jesus?
✅ Step 3: Stay watchful—live each day like it’s your last!
🔥 #WiseOrFoolish #BeReadyForJesus #EndTimesWarning #SpiritualPreparation #FinalJudgment #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis

title: 🔥 SHOCKING BIBLE VERSES THAT MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 SHOCKING BIBLE VERSES THAT MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE! 🔥
💬 "Brother John, are there Bible verses that most Christians choose to ignore? Are there hard truths in Scripture that people avoid because they’re too convicting?"

🚨 MANY CHRISTIANS LOVE ‘FEEL-GOOD’ VERSES, BUT IGNORE THE HARSH TRUTHS!
Most churches today preach love, blessings, and prosperity, but skip the harder verses about judgment, obedience, holiness, and sacrifice!

📖 Key Verse: "For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear." (2 Timothy 4:3)
🔥 ARE YOU IGNORING THE TOUGH PARTS OF THE BIBLE? LET’S UNCOVER THE SHOCKING TRUTHS! 🔥

🔥 1. "MANY WILL THINK THEY’RE SAVED—BUT JESUS WILL REJECT THEM!"
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven. Many will say to me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name and in your name drive out demons and in your name perform many miracles?’ Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Away from me, you evildoers!’"
💡 THIS VERSE SHOCKS MANY PEOPLE!

✔️ Just because someone calls Jesus ‘Lord’ doesn’t mean they’re truly saved.
✔️ Many will be shocked on Judgment Day when Jesus rejects them.
✔️ Only those who truly follow Christ and obey His commands will be saved.
🚨 DOES JESUS KNOW YOU, OR ARE YOU JUST RELIGIOUS?

🔥 2. "IF YOU LOVE THE WORLD, YOU ARE GOD’S ENEMY!"
📖 James 4:4 – "You adulterous people, don’t you know that friendship with the world means enmity against God? Therefore, anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God."
💡 MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE THIS VERSE!

✔️ You CANNOT love God and love the sinful world at the same time.
✔️ Many Christians try to blend in with the world instead of standing for Christ.
✔️ God calls compromise with the world SPIRITUAL ADULTERY!
🚨 ARE YOU A FRIEND OF GOD OR A FRIEND OF THE WORLD?

🔥 3. "IF YOU KEEP SINNING, YOU BELONG TO SATAN!"
📖 1 John 3:8 – "The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil’s work."
💡 THIS VERSE DESTROYS THE ‘ONCE SAVED, ALWAYS SAVED’ LIE!

✔️ If you continue living in sin without repentance, you are under Satan’s control!
✔️ True believers fight against sin and seek to live holy lives.
✔️ Jesus came to destroy sin, not let us live in it!
🚨 ARE YOU STILL A SLAVE TO SIN, OR HAVE YOU TRULY REPENTED?

🔥 4. "GOD WILL REJECT THOSE WHO ARE ASHAMED OF HIM!"
📖 Mark 8:38 – "If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels."
💡 MANY CHRISTIANS HIDE THEIR FAITH BECAUSE THEY’RE AFRAID OF PERSECUTION!

✔️ Being silent about Jesus is dangerous!
✔️ Are you afraid to talk about Christ at work, school, or online?
✔️ If you deny Jesus before men, He will deny you before the Father! (Matthew 10:33)
🚨 ARE YOU A BOLD CHRISTIAN, OR ARE YOU ASHAMED OF JESUS?

🔥 5. "YOU MUST FORGIVE OTHERS—OR GOD WON’T FORGIVE YOU!"
📖 Matthew 6:14-15 – "For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins."
💡 THIS VERSE IS HARD FOR MANY PEOPLE TO ACCEPT!

✔️ Holding grudges is a serious sin!
✔️ If you refuse to forgive others, God will not forgive you.
✔️ Bitterness, hatred, and unforgiveness destroy your soul.
🚨 ARE YOU HOLDING UNFORGIVENESS IN YOUR HEART?

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I CHOOSE TO OBEY THE WHOLE BIBLE, NOT JUST THE EASY PARTS!"

🔥 THE BIBLICAL TRUTH CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Read these shocking verses again—don’t ignore them!
✅ Step 3: Commit to living out the WHOLE Word of God!

🙏 PRAYER FOR OBEDIENCE TO GOD’S WORD! 🙏
Heavenly Father, I come before You with an open heart. Forgive me for the times I have ignored the hard truths in Your Word. Lord, give me the courage to obey ALL of Your commands, not just the easy ones.
Jesus, I want to know You, not just in words, but in my actions. Remove every form of compromise from my life. Let me walk in boldness, holiness, and true faithfulness to Your teachings.
Holy Spirit, convict me when I am tempted to ignore or twist Scripture to fit my desires. I surrender to the FULL truth of Your Word!
🔥 In Jesus’ mighty name, I pray. Amen! 🔥
🔥 #ShockingBibleVerses #BiblicalTruth #WakeUpChurch #JesusIsLord #EndTimesWarning #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis

title: OLD WINESKINS – YOU CAN’T FIT GOD’S NEW WORK INTO YOUR OLD LIFE! 🔥
paragraphs:
OLD WINESKINS – YOU CAN’T FIT GOD’S NEW WORK INTO YOUR OLD LIFE! 🔥
📖 Luke 5:37-38 – "And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined. No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what did Jesus mean when He talked about new wine and old wineskins? How does this apply to my walk with Christ?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people try to fit their new life in Christ into their old habits, traditions, and mindset. But Jesus made it clear—THE OLD AND THE NEW CANNOT MIX!
🚨 If you are holding on to the past, you are resisting what God wants to do in your life!
⚠️ WARNING: If you try to put new wine into old wineskins, YOU WILL BURST!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE NEW WINE IN OLD WINESKINS?
📖 Mark 2:22 – "And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins."
🔥 JESUS IS TEACHING:

✔️ The "new wine" represents His new covenant, new life, and new work.
✔️ The "old wineskins" represent old religious traditions, old mindsets, and the old sinful life.
✔️ If you try to mix the new with the old, it will destroy BOTH!
💡 JESUS DID NOT COME TO PATCH UP THE OLD SYSTEM—HE CAME TO BRING A COMPLETELY NEW LIFE!
🚨 Are you still trying to mix your past life with your new faith in Christ?

🔥 2. WHY CAN’T THE OLD AND NEW MIX?
📖 2 Corinthians 5:17 – "Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come."
🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?

❌ You can’t mix GRACE with LEGALISM. (Galatians 2:16)
❌ You can’t mix FAITH with DEAD RELIGION. (James 2:26)
❌ You can’t mix HOLINESS with a SINFUL LIFESTYLE. (1 Peter 1:16)
❌ You can’t mix GOD’S PLAN with YOUR OWN DESIRES. (Luke 9:23)
🚨 If you try to live a "half-Christian" life, you will end up BURSTING—completely unstable, confused, and spiritually lost!
💡 ARE YOU STILL TRYING TO LIVE WITH ONE FOOT IN THE WORLD AND ONE FOOT IN GOD’S KINGDOM?

🔥 3. WHY DID JESUS USE WINESKINS AS AN EXAMPLE?
📖 Matthew 9:17 – "Neither do people pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined."
🔥 WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU POUR NEW WINE INTO OLD WINESKINS?

✔️ Old wineskins are stiff and can’t expand. (Like religious people stuck in tradition!)
✔️ New wine expands as it ferments. (Like the Holy Spirit transforming a believer!)
✔️ If you put new wine in an old wineskin, it will BURST! (Just like how religious leaders rejected Jesus!)
🚨 THIS IS WHY JESUS CLASHED WITH THE PHARISEES!

❌ They wanted to keep their old religious system. (Matthew 23:13-15)
❌ They rejected the new life Jesus was bringing. (John 5:39-40)
❌ They couldn’t accept that salvation was through faith, not works. (Ephesians 2:8-9)
💡 HAVE YOU TRULY EMBRACED THE NEW LIFE IN CHRIST, OR ARE YOU STILL CLINGING TO OLD RELIGIOUS HABITS?

🔥 4. HOW TO BECOME A "NEW WINESKIN" FOR GOD?
📖 Ezekiel 36:26 – "I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh."
🔥 STEPS TO BECOMING A NEW WINESKIN:

✔️ SURRENDER FULLY TO JESUS – Let Him make you new! (Romans 12:1-2)
✔️ BREAK FREE FROM RELIGIOUS LEGALISM – It’s about relationship, not rituals! (Galatians 5:1)
✔️ LET GO OF YOUR OLD LIFE – True repentance means complete transformation! (Luke 5:32)
✔️ ALLOW THE HOLY SPIRIT TO EXPAND YOU – Be flexible to God’s new work! (John 3:8)
🚨 IF YOU REFUSE TO CHANGE, YOU WILL MISS WHAT GOD IS DOING!
💡 ARE YOU WILLING TO BECOME A NEW WINESKIN FOR CHRIST?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: YOU MUST CHOOSE – OLD LIFE OR NEW LIFE?
📖 Hebrews 10:39 – "But we do not belong to those who shrink back and are destroyed, but to those who have faith and are saved."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay stuck in old traditions, dead religion, and a weak faith?
✔️ Step into the NEW, transforming work of Jesus Christ?
🚨 JESUS WILL NOT POUR NEW WINE INTO OLD WINESKINS—YOU MUST BECOME NEW!
💡 Will you allow Jesus to fully transform you today?

🙏 PRAYER TO BECOME A NEW WINESKIN FOR GOD!
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want to mix my old ways with Your new work. Transform my heart, renew my mind, and make me a new creation. Fill me with Your Spirit and help me to fully embrace the new life You have for me. I surrender completely to You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
