title: 🔥 HOW TO BECOME A WARRIOR FOR JESUS – FIGHTING THE GOOD FIGHT OF FAITH! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 HOW TO BECOME A WARRIOR FOR JESUS – FIGHTING THE GOOD FIGHT OF FAITH! 🔥
📖 2 Timothy 2:3-4 – "Endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus. No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in civilian affairs, but rather tries to please his commanding officer."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I want to serve God boldly, but I feel weak and afraid. How can I become a true warrior for Jesus?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many Christians live passively, afraid to take a stand for truth. But God never called us to be weak or silent—He called us to be WARRIORS!
🚨 Are you ready to fight for Jesus? Here’s how to become a true SOLDIER OF CHRIST!

🔥 1. COMMIT TO JESUS AS YOUR COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF
📖 Matthew 16:24 – "Whoever wants to be My disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow Me."
🔥 A true warrior follows orders—and our orders come from JESUS!

✔️ No soldier fights without first submitting to their commander.
✔️ Jesus must be the absolute authority over your life.
✔️ No more divided loyalty—surrender FULLY to Christ!

💡 FACT: You cannot be a warrior for Jesus if you are still living for yourself.
👉 A soldier of Christ must be 100% committed to His mission!
🚨 A DIVIDED HEART CANNOT WIN THE WAR FOR CHRIST!

🔥 2. PUT ON THE FULL ARMOR OF GOD
📖 Ephesians 6:11 – "Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes."
🔥 No warrior goes into battle without armor—and spiritual battles require SPIRITUAL ARMOR!

✔️ The Belt of Truth – Stand on God’s Word, not the lies of the world.
✔️ The Breastplate of Righteousness – Live a holy life, rejecting sin.
✔️ The Shoes of the Gospel – Be ready to spread the Good News.
✔️ The Shield of Faith – Defend against Satan’s attacks.
✔️ The Helmet of Salvation – Guard your mind against deception.
✔️ The Sword of the Spirit – Fight using the power of Scripture!

💡 FACT: A warrior without armor is already defeated.
👉 You must be FULLY EQUIPPED to stand against the enemy!
🚨 IF YOU ARE NOT ARMORED UP, YOU WILL BE TAKEN DOWN!

🔥 3. TRAIN DAILY IN PRAYER AND SCRIPTURE
📖 Joshua 1:8 – "Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night."
🔥 No soldier wins a battle without constant training!

✔️ Pray DAILY—this is how you receive orders from God.
✔️ Read Scripture DAILY—this is your weapon against the enemy.
✔️ Worship DAILY—this keeps your heart connected to Christ.

💡 FACT: You cannot be strong in battle if you are weak in the Word.
👉 A warrior must stay in CONSTANT communication with their Commander!
🚨 PRAYERLESS WARRIORS ARE POWERLESS WARRIORS!

🔥 4. FIGHT WITH FAITH—NEVER RETREAT!
📖 1 Timothy 6:12 – "Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called."
🔥 A warrior NEVER runs from battle—they stand and fight!

✔️ Speak the truth, even when the world rejects it.
✔️ Stand firm in trials, knowing God is your strength.
✔️ Resist temptation, knowing that victory is in Christ.

💡 FACT: The battle is not easy, but the victory is already WON through Jesus!
👉 A true warrior NEVER backs down from the fight of faith!
🚨 COWARDS WILL FALL—ONLY THE BRAVE WILL STAND FOR JESUS!

🔥 5. NEVER FIGHT ALONE—JOIN GOD’S ARMY!
📖 Ecclesiastes 4:9-10 – "Two are better than one… If either of them falls down, one can help the other up."
🔥 A warrior fights with an army—YOU CANNOT WIN ALONE!

✔️ Surround yourself with strong believers.
✔️ Be part of a church that preaches truth, not entertainment.
✔️ Encourage and uplift your fellow warriors.

💡 FACT: Lone soldiers are easy targets for the enemy.
👉 A strong warrior is one who fights with their brothers and sisters in Christ!
🚨 SATAN WANTS TO ISOLATE YOU—DON’T LET HIM!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: THE WAR IS REAL—ARE YOU READY?
📖 Revelation 3:16 – "Because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of My mouth."

🚨 Too many so-called "Christians" are weak, passive, and silent. But Jesus is raising up an army!
🚨 The battle is raging—Satan is attacking—ARE YOU PREPARED?

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Stay weak, silent, and afraid?
✔️ Rise up as a warrior for Christ?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Victory through Jesus?
❌ Or defeat through fear and compromise?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—YOUR ETERNAL DESTINY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO BECOME A WARRIOR FOR CHRIST
"Lord Jesus, I surrender to You completely. Train me, equip me, and make me a warrior for Your kingdom. Fill me with boldness, strength, and faith to stand against the enemy. I choose to fight the good fight of faith and serve You with all my heart. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 GOD LOVES THE SINNER, BUT HE HATES THE SIN! – THE TRUTH EXPLAINED 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 GOD LOVES THE SINNER, BUT HE HATES THE SIN! – THE TRUTH EXPLAINED 🔥
📖 Romans 5:8 – "But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I often hear people say, ‘God loves me just as I am,’ but I also hear others say, ‘God hates sin and will judge sinners.’ Which one is true? Does God love the sinner but hate the sin?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people today either abuse God’s love or misunderstand His holiness. Some believe they can continue living in sin because "God loves them," while others think God only wants to punish sinners.
🚨 It’s time to expose the lies and stand on BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. YES, GOD LOVES THE SINNER!
📖 John 3:16 – "For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life."
🔥 God’s love is unconditional—but that doesn’t mean He approves of sin!

✔️ Jesus came to save sinners, not condemn them (Luke 19:10).
✔️ God’s love reaches the worst of sinners—no one is too far gone (1 Timothy 1:15).
✔️ Salvation is a gift, not something we earn (Ephesians 2:8-9).
💡 No matter how deep someone is in sin, God’s love is still calling them to repentance.
🚨 But here’s what most people ignore—God’s love does NOT mean He will tolerate sin!

🔥 2. BUT GOD HATES SIN – HE CANNOT IGNORE IT!
📖 Psalm 5:4 – "For You are not a God who is pleased with wickedness; with You, evil people are not welcome."
🔥 God’s love does NOT cancel His holiness. He cannot accept sin!

✔️ God’s holiness demands justice (Habakkuk 1:13).
✔️ Sin separates us from God (Isaiah 59:2).
✔️ Unrepented sin leads to eternal destruction (Romans 6:23).
💡 God’s love offers salvation, but His justice demands judgment.
🚨 Many people today twist God’s love to justify their sin. Let’s expose these lies!

🔥 3. THE BIGGEST LIES ABOUT GOD'S LOVE – DEBUNKED!
📖 Isaiah 5:20 – "Woe to those who call evil good and good evil!"
🔥 Many false teachings have spread about God's love. Let’s expose them!

❌ LIE #1: "God loves me, so He won’t judge me."
✔️ TRUTH: God’s love provided a way of escape, but judgment still comes for those who reject Him (Hebrews 9:27).

❌ LIE #2: "Jesus loves everyone, so it doesn’t matter how we live."
✔️ TRUTH: Jesus told sinners to "go and sin no more" (John 8:11). True love leads to repentance!

❌ LIE #3: "We’re all sinners, so God understands if we continue in sin."
✔️ TRUTH: Yes, we all sin, but a true believer will not live in willful rebellion (1 John 3:9).
🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU TO BELIEVE IN A FALSE ‘LOVE’ THAT HAS NO HOLINESS!

🔥 4. TRUE LOVE CALLS FOR REPENTANCE!
📖 Romans 2:4 – "Do you not realize that God’s kindness is intended to lead you to repentance?"
🔥 God’s love does NOT leave us in sin—it calls us out of sin!

✔️ Jesus dined with sinners, but He never condoned their sin.
✔️ True love warns people about sin’s consequences.
✔️ If you truly love God, you will turn away from sin (John 14:15).
💡 Imagine a doctor who tells a dying patient, ‘You’re fine, don’t worry!’ That’s NOT love. True love warns of danger and provides a cure—this is what Jesus did!
🚨 If a "Christian" never speaks against sin, they are preaching a FALSE GOSPEL!

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – FROM SIN TO FREEDOM!
A young man lived a life of sin, thinking, "God loves me, so I can do whatever I want." He attended church, but his heart was unchanged.
🔥 One day, he read Hebrews 10:26 – "If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
🚨 He realized that he was deceived—he was abusing God’s grace! He repented, turned from his sinful lifestyle, and is now living for Jesus!
💡 TRUE LOVE leads to transformation, not complacency!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DO NOT ABUSE GOD’S LOVE!
📖 Galatians 6:7 – "Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows."
🚨 Many will miss heaven because they believed a FALSE version of God’s love!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Believe in a soft, powerless "love" that tolerates sin?
✔️ Embrace TRUE love that calls for repentance and holiness?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE YOUR ETERNITY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 PRAYER OF TRUE REPENTANCE
"Heavenly Father, thank You for loving me even in my sin. I repent and turn away from anything that separates me from You. Help me to live in obedience and walk in true love—not a love that tolerates sin, but a love that transforms! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 DOES FAITH NEED WORKS TO BE SAVED? EXPOSING THE MISUNDERSTOOD VERSE IN JAMES 2:14! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 DOES FAITH NEED WORKS TO BE SAVED? EXPOSING THE MISUNDERSTOOD VERSE IN JAMES 2:14! 🔥
📖 James 2:14 – "What good is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone claims to have faith but has no deeds? Can such faith save them?"
Many people struggle with this question: "If we are saved by grace through faith, why does James say that faith without works is dead?"
Some churches wrongly teach that you must "work out" your salvation, meaning faith is not enough—you must add good works to be saved. But is that what the Bible really says?
🚨 If salvation is by grace alone (Ephesians 2:8-9), why does James mention works? Are we saved by faith PLUS works?
👉 KEEP READING—THE TRUTH MAY SHOCK YOU!

🔥 1. SALVATION IS BY FAITH ALONE—NOT BY WORKS!
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast."
🔥 This is the foundation of the Gospel—salvation is a GIFT from God!

❌ WRONG BELIEF: "I must do good works to earn salvation."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: "I do good works because I am already saved."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A father adopts a child into his family. The child did nothing to earn that love—it was given freely. But because the child is now part of the family, he begins to live in a way that honors his father.
👉 Good works are the RESULT of salvation, NOT the requirement for it.

🔥 2. WHAT DOES ‘FAITH WITHOUT WORKS IS DEAD’ REALLY MEAN?
📖 James 2:17 – "Faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead."
🔥 James is not saying that works save you—he is saying that TRUE faith produces good works!

❌ James is NOT contradicting Paul.
✔️ He is teaching that real faith leads to action!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If someone claims to be a doctor but never helps a sick person, is he really a doctor?
Likewise, if someone claims to have faith but never follows God, is that real faith?
👉 Works do not create faith—but true faith will naturally produce good works!

🔥 3. PAUL AND JAMES AGREE: FAITH COMES FIRST, THEN WORKS FOLLOW
📖 Galatians 5:6 – "For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love."
🔥 Faith is the root—good works are the fruit!

✔️ Paul teaches that we are justified by faith (Romans 3:28).
✔️ James teaches that genuine faith will be seen in action (James 2:18).
✔️ Both agree that salvation is by faith, but faith is never passive!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A tree is not alive because it has fruit. It produces fruit because it is alive!
Likewise, we don’t do good works to become saved—we do good works because we are already saved.
👉 A faith that doesn’t produce action is fake faith.

🔥 4. SALVATION IS A GIFT—BUT WE WORK IT OUT IN OUR DAILY LIFE
📖 Philippians 2:12-13 – "Work out your salvation with fear and trembling, for it is God who works in you to will and to act in order to fulfill His good purpose."
🔥 "Work out" does NOT mean "work FOR."

❌ WRONG BELIEF: "I must work to keep my salvation."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: "I live out my salvation because God is working in me."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Going to the gym does not make you a human being. You go to the gym because you already have a body that needs to grow stronger.
Likewise, we don’t do good works to become saved—we do good works because we are saved and growing in Christ.
👉 We don’t work FOR salvation—we work BECAUSE of salvation!

🔥 5. FINAL WARNING: DON’T FALL INTO THE TRAP OF WORKS-BASED SALVATION!
📖 Romans 11:6 – "And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace."
🚨 Many false teachings mix grace with works—this is a dangerous lie!

🔥 THE TRUTH:
✔️ We are saved by faith alone.
✔️ True faith will always produce good works.
✔️ Good works are the evidence, not the requirement, of salvation.
📖 Titus 3:5 – "He saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of His mercy."

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Will you trust in Christ’s finished work?
❌ Or will you try to earn what God already gave for free?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO FULLY TRUST IN JESUS
"Lord Jesus, I believe that I am saved by Your grace alone. I know that good works do not save me, but I want my life to reflect true faith. Teach me to walk in obedience, not to earn salvation, but to honor You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE LAMP UNDER A BOWL – ARE YOU HIDING YOUR LIGHT? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE LAMP UNDER A BOWL – ARE YOU HIDING YOUR LIGHT? 🔥
📖 Matthew 5:14-16 – "You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden. Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead, they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house. In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what did Jesus mean when He said not to put a lamp under a bowl? How does this apply to Christians today?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many Christians claim to follow Jesus but hide their faith when facing opposition.
🚨 Today, we will break down this powerful parable, explore its biblical and historical meaning, and reveal what it means for YOU as a follower of Christ!
⚠️ WARNING: If you are hiding your faith, you may already be falling into Satan’s trap!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES THE LAMP SYMBOLIZE?
📖 John 8:12 – "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."
🔥 A LAMP REPRESENTS:

✔️ Jesus Himself – He is the true Light of the world! (John 1:4-5)
✔️ The Gospel Message – It brings truth into a dark world. (2 Corinthians 4:6)
✔️ Every Believer – We are called to reflect Christ’s light! (Ephesians 5:8)
💡 If you are a Christian, YOU are a lamp in this dark world!
🚨 But are you letting your light shine—or are you hiding it?

🔥 2. WHY DO PEOPLE HIDE THEIR LIGHT?
📖 Luke 11:33 – "No one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead, they put it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light."
🔥 REASONS PEOPLE HIDE THEIR FAITH:

❌ FEAR OF REJECTION – Afraid of what others will think. (John 12:42-43)
❌ FEAR OF PERSECUTION – Scared to suffer for their faith. (Matthew 10:33)
❌ COMPROMISE WITH THE WORLD – More focused on fitting in. (James 4:4)
❌ SPIRITUAL LAZINESS – Don’t want the responsibility. (Revelation 3:16)
💡 WHEN YOU HIDE YOUR LIGHT, DARKNESS TAKES OVER!
🚨 Jesus warned that a hidden light is WORTHLESS!

🔥 3. WHY YOU MUST LET YOUR LIGHT SHINE!
📖 Philippians 2:15 – "Then you will shine among them like stars in the sky as you hold firmly to the word of life."
🔥 YOU ARE CALLED TO BE A LIGHT IN THIS DARK WORLD!

✔️ Light exposes darkness – Evil is afraid of truth. (John 3:19-20)
✔️ Light gives direction – People need guidance to Christ. (Psalm 119:105)
✔️ Light brings hope – The world needs Jesus! (Isaiah 60:1-2)
🚀 CHALLENGE: Will you shine for Christ, or will you stay hidden?
💡 ARE YOU BOLDLY LIVING FOR JESUS, OR HIDING IN THE SHADOWS?

🔥 4. WARNING: HIDING YOUR LIGHT HAS CONSEQUENCES!
📖 Matthew 10:32-33 – "Whoever acknowledges Me before others, I will also acknowledge before My Father in heaven. But whoever disowns Me before others, I will disown before My Father in heaven."

🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU TO HIDE YOUR FAITH!
❌ He wants you to be ashamed of the Gospel. (Romans 1:16)
❌ He wants you to stay silent while the world celebrates sin. (Isaiah 5:20)
❌ He wants you to be a lukewarm Christian. (Revelation 3:16)
🔥 BUT JESUS CALLS YOU TO BE A LIGHT!
💡 What will you choose—bold faith or silent fear?

🔥 5. HOW TO SHINE YOUR LIGHT FOR CHRIST!
📖 Ephesians 5:8 – "For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light."
🔥 WAYS TO LET YOUR LIGHT SHINE:

✔️ Be bold about your faith! (2 Timothy 1:7)
✔️ Speak truth, even when it’s unpopular! (Galatians 1:10)
✔️ Live in holiness! (1 Peter 1:15-16)
✔️ Share the Gospel with others! (Matthew 28:19-20)
🚨 THE WORLD NEEDS MORE CHRISTIANS WHO REFUSE TO HIDE!
💡 WILL YOU BE ONE OF THEM?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: CHOOSE TODAY!
📖 Joshua 24:15 – "Choose this day whom you will serve… but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay silent, blend in, and deny Christ?
✔️ Stand boldly for Jesus, no matter the cost?
🚨 THE TIME FOR HIDING IS OVER—THE WORLD NEEDS YOUR LIGHT!
💡 Will you shine for Christ, or will you stay hidden?

🙏 PRAYER FOR BOLDNESS & STRENGTH!
"Lord Jesus, help me to be a light in this dark world. Give me courage to stand for truth and never hide my faith. Let my life reflect Your love and power. Use me to bring others to You. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE GOOD SAMARITAN – ARE YOU IGNORING THE HURTING? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE GOOD SAMARITAN – ARE YOU IGNORING THE HURTING? 🔥
📖 Luke 10:25-37 – "Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?" The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what does the Parable of the Good Samaritan really mean? Is it just about being kind, or is there a deeper message?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people think this parable is just about helping others, but it’s actually a powerful challenge from Jesus about TRUE LOVE, COMPASSION, and breaking religious hypocrisy!
🚨 If you ignore this message, you might be missing the heart of God!
⚠️ WARNING: If your faith doesn’t move you to action, you might not truly love God!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE GOOD SAMARITAN?
📖 Luke 10:30 – "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he was attacked by robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead."
🔥 JESUS TELLS A STORY ABOUT A MAN WHO:

✔️ Was traveling from Jerusalem to Jericho (a dangerous road full of thieves).
✔️ Was attacked, robbed, and left to die on the side of the road.
✔️ Needed urgent help, but was ignored by religious leaders.
💡 THE QUESTION: WHO WILL HELP HIM?
🚨 WHAT WOULD YOU DO IF YOU SAW SOMEONE BROKEN, LOST, AND HURTING?

🔥 2. THE RELIGIOUS HYPOCRITES – WHY DID THEY IGNORE HIM?
📖 Luke 10:31-32 – "A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side. So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side."
🔥 THE PRIEST AND THE LEVITE DID NOTHING! WHY?

❌ They valued religion over compassion. (Matthew 23:23)
❌ They were too busy with their own lives. (Philippians 2:4)
❌ They didn’t want to get "unclean" by touching a wounded man. (Mark 7:6-8)
❌ They saw, but they DIDN’T CARE ENOUGH TO ACT.
🚨 HOW MANY "CHRISTIANS" TODAY IGNORE THE SUFFERING AROUND THEM?
💡 IF YOUR FAITH DOESN’T MOVE YOU TO LOVE OTHERS, IS IT REAL FAITH?

🔥 3. THE GOOD SAMARITAN – THE ONE WHO SHOWED TRUE LOVE!
📖 Luke 10:33-34 – "But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him. He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, brought him to an inn and took care of him."
🔥 WHAT DID THE SAMARITAN DO?

✔️ He SAW the man and had COMPASSION. (Mark 6:34)
✔️ He STOPPED what he was doing and HELPED. (James 2:15-16)
✔️ He SACRIFICED his time, effort, and money to care for a stranger. (Proverbs 19:17)
🚨 TRUE LOVE IS MORE THAN WORDS—IT TAKES ACTION!
💡 ARE YOU A SPECTATOR IN PEOPLE’S PAIN, OR ARE YOU A HELPER?

🔥 4. WHY DID JESUS USE A SAMARITAN?
📖 John 4:9 – "Jews do not associate with Samaritans."
🔥 IN JESUS' TIME:

✔️ Jews and Samaritans HATED each other.
✔️ Jews considered Samaritans "unclean" and rejected them.
✔️ Jesus SHOCKED everyone by making the Samaritan the hero!
🚨 JESUS IS SAYING: LOVE HAS NO BOUNDARIES!
💡 DO YOU ONLY LOVE PEOPLE WHO LOOK, THINK, AND ACT LIKE YOU?

🔥 5. WHO IS YOUR NEIGHBOR?
📖 Luke 10:36-37 – "Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?" The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."
🔥 JESUS’ MESSAGE IS CLEAR:

✔️ Your "neighbor" is ANYONE in need. (Galatians 6:10)
✔️ True faith is shown by how you love others. (1 John 3:18)
✔️ Love has no room for racism, pride, or selfishness. (James 2:1-4)
🚨 IF YOU CLAIM TO LOVE GOD, YOU MUST LOVE PEOPLE!
💡 WHO AROUND YOU NEEDS YOUR COMPASSION TODAY?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: LOVE WITHOUT ACTION IS DEAD!
📖 James 2:17 – "Faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Walk past hurting people like the priest and the Levite?
✔️ Stop, help, and love like the Good Samaritan?
🚨 REAL CHRISTIANS LOVE PEOPLE—NOT JUST IN WORDS, BUT IN ACTION!
💡 WILL YOU SHOW THE LOVE OF JESUS TO OTHERS?

🙏 PRAYER TO LOVE OTHERS LIKE JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, give me Your heart of compassion. Forgive me for ignoring those in need. Teach me to love others selflessly, without excuses. Help me to be like the Good Samaritan and reflect Your love in my daily life. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 IS HELL REAL—OR JUST A SCARE TACTIC? WHAT REALLY HAPPENS IN HELL? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 IS HELL REAL—OR JUST A SCARE TACTIC? WHAT REALLY HAPPENS IN HELL? 🔥
📖 Luke 16:23 – "In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is hell real? Or is it just something preachers use to scare people into following religion?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people today claim that hell is just a metaphor or an outdated scare tactic used by the Church. But what does the BIBLE say?
🚨 Today, we will uncover the truth about hell—what it is, who goes there, and what actually happens to those who reject Jesus!
⚠️ WARNING: The truth is more terrifying than any horror movie.

🔥 1. DID JESUS BELIEVE IN HELL?
📖 Matthew 10:28 – "Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather, be afraid of the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell."
🔥 YES! JESUS SPOKE ABOUT HELL MORE THAN HEAVEN!

✔️ Jesus described hell as a place of torment, fire, and eternal separation from God. (Mark 9:43-48, Luke 16:23-24)
✔️ He warned that those who reject God would be thrown into "outer darkness" where there is "weeping and gnashing of teeth." (Matthew 8:12, Matthew 13:50)
✔️ He compared hell to a blazing furnace, where people are in unending pain. (Matthew 13:42)
💡 If hell isn’t real, why did Jesus warn about it so many times?
🚨 HELL IS NOT A MYTH—IT IS A REAL PLACE CREATED FOR SATAN AND HIS DEMONS! (Matthew 25:41)

🔥 2. WHAT HAPPENS IN HELL?
📖 Revelation 14:11 – "The smoke of their torment will rise forever and ever. There will be no rest day or night."
🔥 HELL IS A PLACE OF:

❌ ETERNAL SUFFERING – There is NO escape. NO second chance. (Luke 16:26)
❌ FIRE AND TORMENT – The pain never ends. (Revelation 20:10, Mark 9:43-48)

title: 🔥 LGBTQ+ & THE BIBLE: WHAT DOES GOD REALLY SAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 LGBTQ+ & THE BIBLE: WHAT DOES GOD REALLY SAY? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, does the Bible really speak about LGBTQ+ lifestyles? If God is love, why can’t people love whoever they want? Aren’t we supposed to accept everyone?"

✔️ Sexual sin is serious! The Bible warns against ALL forms of immorality—including adultery, fornication, and homosexuality (1 Corinthians 6:9-10).

💡 JESUS CLEARLY DEFINED MARRIAGE AS BETWEEN A MAN AND A WOMAN!

✔️ Jesus affirmed that God created two genders—male and female.
✔️ Jesus described marriage as only between a man and a woman.
✔️ Jesus condemned all sexual immorality, not just homosexuality!
🚨 IF JESUS DIDN’T APPROVE IT, WHY SHOULD WE?

🔥 3. "BUT LOVE IS LOVE! GOD ACCEPTS EVERYONE!"
📖 1 Corinthians 6:9-11 – "Do not be deceived: neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who practice homosexuality... will inherit the kingdom of God. And such WERE some of you. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God."
💡 GOD LOVES EVERYONE—BUT HE DOESN’T ACCEPT SIN!

✔️ Love is not tolerance. Jesus called sinners to repentance, not acceptance (Luke 5:32).
✔️ True love speaks the truth. Ignoring sin leads people to hell (Ezekiel 3:18).

🚨 REAL LOVE WARNS—IT DOESN’T AFFIRM DECEPTION!

🔥 4. CAN A CHRISTIAN SUPPORT LGBTQ+ MOVEMENTS?
📖 Romans 12:2 – "Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind."
💡 THE WORLD PUSHES LGBTQ+ AGENDA, BUT CHRISTIANS MUST NOT COMPROMISE!

✔️ Christians are called to holiness, not worldly trends!
✔️ If the world supports it, question it! Satan controls world systems (1 John 5:19).
✔️ Many churches are compromising—but Jesus warned about false teachers (2 Timothy 4:3-4).
🚨 IF YOU STAND WITH THE WORLD, YOU STAND AGAINST GOD!

🔥 5. CAN LGBTQ+ PEOPLE BE SAVED?
📖 1 Corinthians 6:11 – "And such WERE some of you. But you were washed, sanctified, and justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ."
💡 YES! JESUS CAN SAVE ANYONE WHO REPENTS!

✔️ Former LGBTQ+ members have been transformed by Jesus!
✔️ No sin is greater than God’s grace—but repentance is required!
✔️ Jesus offers healing, deliverance, and a new identity in Him!
🚨 JESUS SAVES, BUT YOU MUST CHOOSE HIM OVER SIN!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I CHOOSE TO STAND WITH GOD’S TRUTH, NOT THE WORLD’S LIES!"

🔥 THE TRUTH CHALLENGE!

title: 🔥 FALLING IN LOVE WITH THE WRONG PERSON—HOW TO AVOID HEARTBREAK! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 FALLING IN LOVE WITH THE WRONG PERSON—HOW TO AVOID HEARTBREAK! 🔥
📖 2 Corinthians 6:14 – "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?"

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I’m in love with someone, but deep down, I know they’re not leading me closer to God. What should I do?"
🔥 POWERFUL QUESTION! Many people fall in love based on emotions, not realizing that the wrong relationship can pull them away from God, bring pain, and delay their purpose!
🚨 SATAN LOVES TO USE RELATIONSHIPS TO DISTRACT, WEAKEN, AND DESTROY BELIEVERS!
⚠️ WARNING: Not every person you love is from God. Not everyone who says they love you is meant to be with you.
💡 TODAY, YOU WILL LEARN HOW TO AVOID HEARTBREAK AND CHOOSE GOD’S BEST!

🔥 1. WHY DO PEOPLE FALL FOR THE WRONG PERSON?
📖 Proverbs 4:23 – "Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it."
🔥 HERE’S WHY MANY FALL INTO BAD RELATIONSHIPS:

1️⃣ LONELINESS – They choose someone just to "feel loved."
2️⃣ LUST & EMOTIONS – Physical attraction blinds them to the person’s true character.
3️⃣ IGNORING RED FLAGS – They see warning signs but hope the person will change.
4️⃣ WORLDLY THINKING – They think love is just about feelings, not God’s design.
5️⃣ PRESSURE FROM OTHERS – Friends and family push them into relationships.
🚨 ARE YOU IN A RELATIONSHIP BECAUSE IT’S GOD’S PLAN OR BECAUSE OF YOUR FEELINGS?
💡 DON’T LET YOUR EMOTIONS LEAD YOU INTO A TRAP!

🔥 2. SIGNS YOU’RE IN LOVE WITH THE WRONG PERSON!
📖 Matthew 7:16 – "You will recognize them by their fruits."
🔥 IF YOUR RELATIONSHIP HAS THESE SIGNS, IT’S TIME TO PRAY AND RECONSIDER:

1️⃣ THEY PULL YOU AWAY FROM GOD – Instead of encouraging your faith, they distract you.
2️⃣ THEY DON’T SHARE YOUR VALUES – They don’t care about purity, marriage, or biblical principles.
3️⃣ THE RELATIONSHIP IS BUILT ON LUST, NOT LOVE – Passion is strong, but there’s no spiritual foundation.
4️⃣ YOU FEEL CONSTANT DOUBT AND CONFLICT – There’s no peace—only stress and emotional rollercoasters.
5️⃣ THEY REFUSE TO GROW IN CHRIST – They reject accountability and spiritual maturity.
🚨 GOD WILL NEVER SEND SOMEONE WHO PULLS YOU AWAY FROM HIM!
💡 LOVE SHOULD DRAW YOU CLOSER TO GOD, NOT AWAY!

🔥 3. HOW TO AVOID A HEARTBREAKING RELATIONSHIP
📖 Proverbs 3:5-6 – "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to Him, and He will make your paths straight."
🔥 HERE’S HOW TO PROTECT YOUR HEART:

✔️ PRAY BEFORE ENTERING A RELATIONSHIP – Ask God for wisdom and clarity.
✔️ LOOK FOR FRUIT, NOT JUST FEELINGS – Do they truly follow Jesus, or just pretend?
✔️ SET STRONG BOUNDARIES – Don’t compromise on purity and biblical values.
✔️ SEEK GODLY COUNSEL – Talk to strong believers for advice and wisdom.
✔️ BE WILLING TO WALK AWAY – If God says "NO," obey Him!
🚨 A RELATIONSHIP OUTSIDE GOD’S WILL LEADS TO PAIN—DON’T IGNORE HIS WARNING SIGNS!
💡 GOD’S PLAN FOR LOVE IS ALWAYS BETTER THAN YOURS!

🔥 4. WHY WAIT FOR GOD’S BEST?
📖 Psalm 37:4 – "Take delight in the Lord, and He will give you the desires of your heart."
🔥 WHEN YOU WAIT ON GOD, YOU RECEIVE:

✔️ A PARTNER WHO LOVES GOD FIRST – Someone who truly follows Christ.
✔️ A RELATIONSHIP BUILT ON FAITH, NOT LUST – True love, not just emotions.
✔️ A MARRIAGE THAT GLORIFIES GOD – A relationship that lasts.
✔️ PEACE INSTEAD OF HEARTBREAK – No regrets, only blessings.
🚨 STOP SETTLING FOR LESS THAN GOD’S BEST!
💡 TRUE LOVE FROM GOD IS WORTH THE WAIT!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DON’T CHOOSE LOVE BASED ON EMOTIONS—CHOOSE IT BASED ON GOD’S WILL!
📖 Jeremiah 29:11 – "For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord, "plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay in a relationship that weakens your faith?
❌ Ignore red flags and risk future heartbreak?
✔️ Trust God and wait for His perfect plan?
🚨 WHEN GOD CLOSES A DOOR, DON’T FORCE IT OPEN—HE HAS SOMETHING BETTER!
💡 DO YOU TRUST GOD ENOUGH TO WAIT FOR HIS BEST?

🙏 PRAYER TO WAIT FOR GOD’S BEST!
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my love life to You. I don’t want to follow my emotions—I want to follow Your will. Protect me from relationships that are not from You, and help me wait for the person You have prepared for me. Give me wisdom, patience, and faith to trust in Your perfect plan. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE SHEEP AND THE GOATS – WILL YOU BE ACCEPTED OR REJECTED? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE SHEEP AND THE GOATS – WILL YOU BE ACCEPTED OR REJECTED? 🔥
📖 Matthew 25:31-33 – "When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne. All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats. He will put the sheep on His right and the goats on His left."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I heard about the parable of the Sheep and the Goats, but I don’t fully understand it. What does it mean? How do I know if I am a sheep or a goat?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! This parable is a prophecy about Judgment Day. Many believe they are saved, but on that day, Jesus will separate the true believers (sheep) from the false ones (goats).
🚨 The terrifying reality? Many churchgoers will be SHOCKED to hear Jesus say, "I never knew you!" (Matthew 7:23).
Are you truly saved, or just religious? Let’s break this down BIBLICALLY!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES THE PARABLE MEAN?
📖 Matthew 25:34 – "Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.’"
🔥 In this parable, Jesus describes what will happen when He returns:

✔️ He will sit on His throne as King and Judge.
✔️ All nations will be gathered before Him.
✔️ He will separate people into two groups: the sheep (His true followers) and the goats (the false believers).
🚨 This is the FINAL SEPARATION! No more chances, no more excuses.
💡 The question is—where will YOU stand?

🔥 2. WHO ARE THE SHEEP? (THE TRUE FOLLOWERS OF CHRIST)
📖 John 10:27 – "My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me."
🔥 The Sheep represent the TRUE Christians who:

✔️ Obey Jesus and live according to His teachings.
✔️ Have a genuine love for others, especially the poor and needy.
✔️ Serve Christ by serving others (Matthew 25:35-36).
💡 These are the ones Jesus will WELCOME into His kingdom!
🚨 But what about the goats? This is where many get deceived…

🔥 3. WHO ARE THE GOATS? (THE FALSE BELIEVERS)
📖 Matthew 25:41 – "Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.’"
🔥 The Goats represent FAKE Christians who:

❌ Claim to follow Jesus but ignore His commands.
❌ Have no real love for others, especially the poor and suffering.
❌ Think that attending church or doing religious acts is enough.
❌ Reject opportunities to serve Christ through others.
🚨 Jesus will REJECT THEM on Judgment Day, because they NEVER truly followed Him!
💡 Going to church doesn’t make you a sheep—OBEDIENCE TO CHRIST DOES!

🔥 4. WHAT SEPARATES SHEEP FROM GOATS? (OBEDIENCE VS. DISOBEDIENCE)
📖 1 John 3:18 – "Let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth."
🔥 The difference between Sheep and Goats is not what they SAY, but what they DO!

✔️ Sheep live out their faith by loving and serving others.
✔️ Goats talk about faith, but their lives show no real change.
🚨 Faith without works is DEAD! (James 2:26)
💡 Are you just TALKING about Jesus, or are you LIVING for Him?

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – A "GOAT" WHO BECAME A SHEEP!
A man spent years in church but lived a sinful life outside of it. He never helped the poor, never cared about the suffering, and only prayed when he needed something.
🔥 One day, he read Matthew 25 and realized he was a "goat"—a fake believer. He repented, surrendered fully to Christ, and started living out his faith by serving others.
🚨 Now, he is not just a churchgoer—he is a TRUE disciple of Christ!
💡 Will YOU be a sheep or a goat on Judgment Day?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: SHEEP ENTER HEAVEN, GOATS GO TO HELL!
📖 Matthew 25:46 – "Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life."
🚨 This is the FINAL SEPARATION. No appeals. No second chances.

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Continue living a selfish, religious life?
✔️ Surrender fully to Christ and start walking in obedience?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE JUDGMENT DAY IS COMING!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TRUE SALVATION
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my life to You completely. I don’t want to just be religious—I want to truly follow You! Transform me from a ‘goat’ into one of Your sheep. Fill me with Your Spirit and lead me in obedience. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"

paragraphs:

❌ Settle out of loneliness?
❌ Rush ahead of God’s plan?
✔️ Trust God and wait for His best?
🚨 GOD WON’T WITHHOLD WHAT IS GOOD FOR YOU—TRUST HIM!

title: 🔥 SPIRITUAL WARFARE IS REAL—ARE YOU ARMED AND READY? 🔥
paragraphs:

⚠️ WARNING: Too many Christians are losing the battle because they are unarmed, unprepared, and unaware of the enemy’s tactics!

✔️ GOD’S KINGDOM vs. SATAN’S KINGDOM
✔️ LIGHT vs. DARKNESS
✔️ TRUTH vs. LIES
✔️ HOLINESS vs. SIN

2️⃣ DECEPTION – He twists the truth to confuse you. (2 Corinthians 11:14)

5️⃣ DOUBT – He makes you question God’s love and promises. (Genesis 3:1)
🚨 DO YOU SEE THESE ATTACKS IN YOUR LIFE? IT’S TIME TO FIGHT BACK!
💡 THE DEVIL IS A LIAR—DON’T LET HIM WIN!

🔥 3. THE ARMOR OF GOD – YOUR WEAPONS TO WIN THE WAR!
📖 Ephesians 6:11 – "Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes."

title: 🔥 THE TRUTH AND LIES ABOUT MARTIN LUTHER: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE TRUTH AND LIES ABOUT MARTIN LUTHER: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW! 🔥
📖 John 8:32 – "Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I've heard many things about Martin Luther. Some say he was a hero of the faith; others claim he was a heretic. What's the real story?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Martin Luther is a figure shrouded in both admiration and controversy. To understand his true impact, we must separate FACT from FICTION.

🔥 1. WHO WAS MARTIN LUTHER?
📖 Romans 1:17 – "For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed—a righteousness that is by faith from first to last."
🔥 Martin Luther (1483–1546) was a German theologian and monk who became a central figure in the Protestant Reformation.

✔️ Born in Eisleben, Germany, Luther pursued religious studies and became an Augustinian monk. ✔️ He was deeply troubled by certain practices of the Roman Catholic Church, especially the sale of indulgences. ✔️ In 1517, he wrote the "95 Theses," challenging these practices and sparking widespread debate.
💡 FACT: Luther's actions were pivotal in reshaping Christianity, leading to the emergence of Protestant denominations.

🔥 2. TRUTHS ABOUT MARTIN LUTHER
📖 Ephesians 2:8–9 – "For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast."
🔥 Luther's contributions to Christianity are significant:

✔️ SALVATION BY FAITH ALONE: He emphasized that salvation is a gift from God, received through faith, not earned by works. ✔️ SCRIPTURE AS THE ULTIMATE AUTHORITY: Luther taught that the Bible, not church traditions or leaders, is the supreme authority for Christians. ✔️ TRANSLATION OF THE BIBLE: He translated the Bible into German, making it accessible to the common people.
💡 FACT: These principles became foundational for many Protestant denominations.

🔥 3. COMMON MYTHS AND MISCONCEPTIONS
📖 Proverbs 18:13 – "To answer before listening—that is folly and shame."
🔥 Several myths have arisen about Luther:
❌ MYTH: Luther was the first to translate the Bible into German.

TRUTH: While Luther's translation was influential, there were earlier German translations. However, his version became the most widely used.
❌ MYTH: He nailed the "95 Theses" to the church door.

TRUTH: The story of Luther nailing his theses is widely accepted, but some historians debate its accuracy, suggesting he may have sent them to church authorities instead.
❌ MYTH: Luther sought to create a new church.

TRUTH: Luther's initial goal was to reform the existing church, not to establish a separate denomination.
💡 FACT: Understanding these nuances provides a clearer picture of Luther's intentions and actions.

🔥 4. CONTROVERSIES SURROUNDING LUTHER
📖 James 3:8 – "But no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison."
🔥 Luther's legacy is not without controversy:
❌ ANTI-JEWISH WRITINGS: Later in life, Luther wrote harsh critiques against Jewish people, which have been used to justify anti-Semitism.
❌ OPPOSITION TO PEASANT REVOLTS: He condemned the Peasants' War, siding with authorities against the revolting peasants.
💡 FACT: These actions have led to ongoing debates about his character and the impact of his teachings.

🔥 5. LUTHER'S LASTING IMPACT
📖 Galatians 5:1 – "It is for freedom that Christ has set us free."
🔥 Despite controversies, Luther's influence is undeniable:

✔️ PROTESTANT REFORMATION: His challenges to church practices led to a major movement, reshaping Christianity. ✔️ EMPHASIS ON PERSONAL FAITH: Luther encouraged individuals to read the Bible and develop a personal relationship with God. ✔️ CHURCH REFORMS: His critiques led to significant changes within the Catholic Church, including the Counter-Reformation.
💡 FACT: Luther's legacy continues to shape Christian thought and practice today.

🔥 FINAL THOUGHT:
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:21 – "Test all things; hold fast what is good."
🔥 Martin Luther was a complex figure whose actions had profound effects on Christianity.
✔️ It's essential to approach his legacy with discernment, acknowledging both his contributions and his flaws.
🚨 REMEMBER: Always seek the truth, test all teachings against Scripture, and hold fast to what aligns with God's Word.

🙏 PRAYER FOR DISCERNMENT
"Lord Jesus, grant me wisdom to discern truth from falsehood. Help me to honor the contributions of those who have advanced Your kingdom while recognizing their humanity. Guide me to follow Your Word above all else. In Your holy name, AMEN."

title: 🔥 CALVINISM VS. ARMINIANISM—WHO’S RIGHT? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 CALVINISM VS. ARMINIANISM—WHO’S RIGHT? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, I keep hearing about Calvinism and Arminianism. Some say we have no free will and God chooses who goes to heaven or hell. Others say we have a choice. What does the Bible actually say?"

🚨 THIS DEBATE HAS DIVIDED CHRISTIANS FOR CENTURIES! Calvinists believe God predestines everything, even who gets saved. Arminians believe humans have free will to accept or reject salvation. But what does the BIBLE really teach?
📖 Key Verse: "Choose this day whom you will serve." (Joshua 24:15)
🔥 DO YOU HAVE FREE WILL, OR IS EVERYTHING PRE-DECIDED? LET’S FIND OUT! 🔥

🔥 1. WHAT IS CALVINISM? THE FIVE-POINT SYSTEM (T.U.L.I.P.)
📖 Ephesians 1:4-5 – "He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world."
💡 CALVINISM TEACHES THAT GOD PREDESTINES EVERYTHING, INCLUDING SALVATION.

✅ T – TOTAL DEPRAVITY → Man is so sinful, he cannot even choose God.
✅ U – UNCONDITIONAL ELECTION → God chooses who will be saved & who will go to hell.
✅ L – LIMITED ATONEMENT → Jesus only died for the elect (those chosen by God).
✅ I – IRRESISTIBLE GRACE → If God chooses you, you cannot resist salvation.
✅ P – PERSEVERANCE OF THE SAINTS → If you’re saved, you cannot lose salvation.
🚨 THE PROBLEM? This removes human free will and makes God the author of sin and damnation!

🔥 2. WHAT IS ARMINIANISM? THE FIVE COUNTERPOINTS
📖 1 Timothy 2:4 – "God desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth."
💡 ARMINIANISM TEACHES THAT GOD GAVE HUMANS FREE WILL TO CHOOSE SALVATION.

✅ 1. FREE WILL → Man is sinful but still able to choose or reject God.
✅ 2. CONDITIONAL ELECTION → God foreknows who will believe, but does not force them.
✅ 3. UNLIMITED ATONEMENT → Jesus died for everyone, not just the elect.
✅ 4. RESISTIBLE GRACE → You can reject God’s salvation.
✅ 5. CONDITIONAL SECURITY → You can fall away if you reject Christ later.
🚨 THE PROBLEM? If salvation is fully up to man’s choice, where does God’s sovereignty fit in?

🔥 3. WHAT DOES THE BIBLE ACTUALLY SAY?
📖 2 Peter 3:9 – "The Lord is not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance."
💡 THE TRUTH IS IN THE MIDDLE! GOD IS SOVEREIGN, BUT HE GIVES US FREE WILL!

✔️ GOD DESIRES ALL TO BE SAVED – He does not pick and choose who goes to hell. (1 Timothy 2:4)
✔️ JESUS DIED FOR EVERYONE, NOT JUST A FEW! (John 3:16)
✔️ SALVATION IS A CHOICE – We must repent and believe. (Acts 17:30)
✔️ GOD FOREKNOWS WHO WILL CHOOSE HIM – But He does not force them. (Romans 8:29)
✔️ SALVATION CAN BE REJECTED – You can resist the Holy Spirit. (Acts 7:51)
🚨 THE BIBLE NEVER TEACHES THAT GOD FORCES PEOPLE TO HEAVEN OR HELL!

🔥 4. IF WE HAVE FREE WILL, DOES THAT MEAN GOD ISN’T IN CONTROL?
📖 Proverbs 16:9 – "The heart of man plans his way, but the Lord establishes his steps."
💡 GOD IS 100% IN CONTROL—BUT HE ALLOWS CHOICES!

✔️ GOD CONTROLS HISTORY, PROPHECY, AND THE FUTURE.
✔️ GOD ALLOWS FREE WILL BECAUSE LOVE MUST BE A CHOICE.
✔️ GOD’S PLAN WILL BE FULFILLED, BUT HUMANS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR ACTIONS.
🚨 GOD DOESN’T WANT ROBOTS—HE WANTS REAL, WILLING LOVE!

🔥 5. CAN YOU LOSE YOUR SALVATION? OR IS IT GUARANTEED FOREVER?
📖 Hebrews 6:4-6 – "It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened... if they fall away, to be brought back to repentance."
💡 THE BIBLE TEACHES THAT TRUE SALVATION IS SECURE—BUT A PERSON CAN STILL FALL AWAY!

✔️ SALVATION IS SECURE IN CHRIST – No one can take us out of God’s hand. (John 10:28)
✔️ BUT FAITH MUST ENDURE UNTIL THE END! – "He who endures to the end will be saved." (Matthew 24:13)
✔️ SOME WILL ABANDON THE FAITH – They were once saved but later rejected Christ. (1 Timothy 4:1)
🚨 ETERNAL SECURITY IS REAL, BUT IT REQUIRES CONTINUED FAITH IN JESUS!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I BELIEVE IN GOD’S SOVEREIGNTY AND THE FREE WILL HE GAVE ME! I CHOOSE TO FOLLOW JESUS DAILY!"

🔥 THE BIBLICAL TRUTH CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Read the Bible yourself—don’t just follow human theology!
✅ Step 2: Pray for wisdom—ask God for His understanding!

paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE RICH FOOL—ARE YOU LIVING FOR ETERNITY OR JUST FOR TODAY? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, is it wrong to be rich? Does the Bible say we shouldn’t build wealth? What did Jesus mean in the Parable of the Rich Fool?"
🚨 MANY PEOPLE ARE CHASING WEALTH, BUT ARE THEY CHASING GOD? Today’s world glorifies money, success, and possessions. But Jesus warned us about the danger of wealth without God.
📖 Key Verse: "For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?" (Mark 8:36)
🔥 ARE YOU LIVING FOR GOD—OR JUST LIVING FOR YOURSELF? 🔥

🔥 1. THE PARABLE OF THE RICH FOOL (LUKE 12:16-21)
📖 "The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest. He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’ Then he said, ‘This is what I’ll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store my surplus grain. And I’ll say to myself, ‘You have plenty of grain laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink, and be merry.’ But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?’"

💡 WHAT WAS THE RICH FOOL’S MISTAKE?
✔️ He was not condemned for being rich—but for living only for himself!
✔️ He forgot God and focused only on his material wealth.
✔️ He thought he had years to enjoy life, but he didn’t know he would die that night.
✔️ He was spiritually bankrupt—rich in possessions but poor in his soul!
🚨 JESUS IS ASKING US: ARE YOU BUILDING TEMPORARY WEALTH OR ETERNAL TREASURE?

🔥 2. IS MONEY EVIL? OR IS IT HOW WE USE IT?
📖 1 Timothy 6:10 – "For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil."
💡 MONEY ITSELF IS NOT EVIL—BUT LOVING MONEY MORE THAN GOD IS!

✔️ ABRAHAM was wealthy, yet he honored God. (Genesis 13:2)
✔️ JOSEPH was placed in high power, yet he served God faithfully. (Genesis 41:41-43)
✔️ KING SOLOMON was the richest man in history, but wealth led to his downfall. (1 Kings 11:1-6)
🚨 MONEY IS A TOOL—IT CAN BE USED FOR GOOD OR FOR EVIL! The problem comes when money controls you instead of God!

🔥 3. SIGNS YOU ARE LIVING LIKE THE RICH FOOL!
📖 Matthew 6:19-20 – "Do not lay up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal, but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven."
💡 ARE YOU BUILDING YOUR LIFE ON TEMPORARY WEALTH OR ETERNAL TREASURE?

❌ You prioritize your career and money over your relationship with God.
❌ You are always worried about finances instead of trusting God.
❌ You don’t give to others but only focus on your own comfort.
❌ You work hard for success but neglect your spiritual life.
❌ You think you have "plenty of time" to seek God later.
🚨 WARNING: JUST LIKE THE RICH FOOL, YOU DON’T KNOW WHEN YOUR TIME WILL END!

🔥 4. HOW TO STORE TREASURE IN HEAVEN!
📖 Matthew 6:33 – "Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you."
💡 TRUE RICHES COME FROM SERVING GOD! HERE’S HOW TO BUILD ETERNAL TREASURE:

✔️ PUT GOD FIRST – Make Jesus your greatest treasure. (Luke 10:27)
✔️ BE GENEROUS – Give to those in need and help spread the Gospel. (2 Corinthians 9:7)
✔️ LIVE HOLY – No amount of money can replace a heart fully surrendered to God. (Romans 12:1-2)
✔️ WIN SOULS FOR JESUS – The only thing you can take to heaven is souls! (Proverbs 11:30)
✔️ TRUST GOD, NOT YOUR WEALTH – Riches can disappear, but God remains forever! (Hebrews 13:5)
🚨 TRUE WEALTH IS NOT FOUND IN YOUR BANK ACCOUNT—IT’S FOUND IN YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I CHOOSE TO STORE TREASURES IN HEAVEN! I will not be deceived by material wealth but will live for God’s eternal kingdom!"

🔥 THE KINGDOM CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you living for God or for temporary success?
✅ Step 2: Be generous! Use your blessings to serve God and help others!
✅ Step 3: Share this truth and help wake up others from worldly deception!
🔥 #EternalTreasure #RichFool #ChooseGodNotGold #FaithOverFortune #KingdomWealth #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 YOU CANNOT SERVE TWO MASTERS—WHO TRULY RULES YOUR LIFE? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 YOU CANNOT SERVE TWO MASTERS—WHO TRULY RULES YOUR LIFE? 🔥
📖 Matthew 6:24 – "No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I’m struggling with my faith because I feel torn between my love for God and my love for the things of this world. Can I serve both?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people think they can love Jesus and still chase after worldly pleasures, but Jesus Himself made it clear: YOU CANNOT SERVE TWO MASTERS!
🚨 You must CHOOSE—will you live for God or live for the world?

🔥 1. WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO HAVE "TWO MASTERS"?
📖 James 4:4 – "You adulterous people, don’t you know that friendship with the world means enmity against God? Therefore, anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God."
🔥 Having two masters means trying to live for God while still holding onto sin and worldly desires.

✔️ You say you love Jesus, but you also love money, pleasure, and comfort.
✔️ You go to church on Sundays, but live like the world the rest of the week.
✔️ You claim to follow Christ, but you still prioritize success, popularity, or sin.
💡 FACT: Jesus does not accept divided loyalty. If He is not Lord of ALL, then He is not Lord AT ALL!
🚨 YOU MUST CHOOSE—JESUS OR THE WORLD!

🔥 2. THE LIES SATAN WANTS YOU TO BELIEVE!
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 – "And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light."
🔥 Satan doesn’t need to pull you into full rebellion—he just needs you COMPROMISED!

🚨 LIE #1: "I can follow Jesus AND chase after success, pleasure, or sin."
👉 TRUTH: You must deny yourself and take up your cross daily (Luke 9:23).

🚨 LIE #2: "God understands my struggles—it’s okay if I keep one foot in the world."
👉 TRUTH: God commands us to be HOLY and separate from the world (1 Peter 1:16).

🚨 LIE #3: "I go to church and pray—that means I’m serving God."
👉 TRUTH: Serving God is about total surrender, not just religious habits (Romans 12:1).
💡 FACT: Satan wants you lukewarm—because a lukewarm Christian is NO THREAT to his kingdom!
🚨 IF JESUS IS NOT LORD OF YOUR LIFE, THEN SATAN ALREADY CONTROLS YOU!

🔥 3. HOW TO CHOOSE GOD AND LET GO OF THE WORLD!
📖 1 John 2:15-17 – "Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them."
🔥 It’s time to FULLY SURRENDER to Jesus! Here’s how:

✔️ REPENT & TURN AWAY FROM WORLDLY LIVING (Acts 3:19)
✔️ STOP COMPROMISING WITH SIN (Romans 6:1-2)
✔️ SEEK GOD DAILY IN PRAYER & HIS WORD (Matthew 6:33)
✔️ SEPARATE FROM PEOPLE & THINGS THAT PULL YOU FROM GOD (2 Corinthians 6:17)
✔️ LIVE FOR ETERNITY, NOT FOR TEMPORARY PLEASURES (Colossians 3:2)

💡 FACT: You CANNOT have a foot in God’s Kingdom and a foot in the world.
👉 You must CHOOSE—who will be the LORD of your life?
🚨 YOU CANNOT WALK WITH JESUS AND HOLD HANDS WITH THE DEVIL!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: YOUR CHOICE DETERMINES YOUR DESTINY!
📖 Matthew 7:21 – "Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven."

🚨 Many THINK they are saved, but they are still serving two masters!
🚨 If Jesus returned TODAY, would He find you fully surrendered—or still holding onto the world?

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Keep living a double life?
✔️ Choose to serve Jesus with ALL your heart?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ A life fully surrendered to Christ?
❌ Or a life that pleases the world but leads to destruction?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—YOUR ETERNAL DESTINY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SURRENDER TO JESUS
"Lord Jesus, I choose You over the world. I surrender my heart, my desires, and my life completely to You. Forgive me for compromising. Fill me with Your Spirit and help me live only for You. I declare that You alone are my Master! In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 ONLY ONE LOVE STORY SAVES—THE LOVE OF JESUS CHRIST! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 ONLY ONE LOVE STORY SAVES—THE LOVE OF JESUS CHRIST! 🔥
📖 John 3:16 – "For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, on Valentine’s Day, everyone talks about romance, but I feel empty and alone. What does real love look like?"
🔥 POWERFUL QUESTION! The world makes you believe that love is found in relationships, flowers, chocolates, and romance—but TRUE LOVE is found only in Jesus Christ!
🚨 THE WORLD CELEBRATES TEMPORARY LOVE—BUT GOD OFFERS ETERNAL LOVE!
💡 TODAY, YOU WILL DISCOVER THE GREATEST LOVE STORY OF ALL TIME!

🔥 1. THE LOVE OF JESUS IS UNLIKE ANY OTHER LOVE!
📖 Romans 5:8 – "But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us."
🔥 WORLDLY LOVE IS CONDITIONAL—BUT GOD’S LOVE IS UNCONDITIONAL!

❌ The world says, "I’ll love you IF you meet my expectations."
✔️ Jesus says, "I love you, even at your worst."

❌ The world’s love is temporary—it fades, disappoints, and breaks hearts.
✔️ Jesus’ love is eternal—it never fails, never changes, and never abandons.
🚨 HUMAN LOVE CAN FAIL YOU—JESUS NEVER WILL!
💡 ARE YOU CHASING WORLDLY LOVE, OR HAVE YOU FOUND GOD’S LOVE?

🔥 2. THE ULTIMATE LOVE STORY – JESUS GAVE HIS LIFE FOR YOU!
📖 1 John 4:9-10 – "This is how God showed His love among us: He sent His one and only Son into the world that we might live through Him. This is love: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins."
🔥 THE CROSS IS THE GREATEST LOVE STORY EVER TOLD!

✔️ TRUE LOVE IS SACRIFICIAL! – Jesus took YOUR punishment so you could have life.
✔️ TRUE LOVE IS UNDESERVED! – He loved you even before you loved Him.
✔️ TRUE LOVE IS FOREVER! – His love is not based on emotions but on a promise.
🚨 JESUS DIDN’T JUST SAY HE LOVES YOU—HE PROVED IT ON THE CROSS!
💡 IS YOUR LIFE BUILT ON HIS LOVE, OR ARE YOU STILL SEARCHING?

🔥 3. NO EARTHLY LOVE CAN COMPARE TO THE LOVE OF JESUS!
📖 Psalm 136:26 – "Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever."
🔥 HUMAN LOVE VS. GOD’S LOVE:

❌ Human love can leave you—God’s love is faithful. (Hebrews 13:5)
❌ Human love can be selfish—God’s love is sacrificial. (Philippians 2:8)
❌ Human love can hurt you—God’s love heals you. (Psalm 147:3)
❌ Human love depends on feelings—God’s love depends on His promise!
🚨 NO BOYFRIEND, NO GIRLFRIEND, NO SPOUSE WILL EVER LOVE YOU LIKE JESUS!
💡 WHY CHASE AFTER LESS, WHEN YOU CAN HAVE THE GREATEST LOVE OF ALL?

🔥 4. WILL YOU ACCEPT THE LOVE OF JESUS TODAY?
📖 Revelation 3:20 – "Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me."
🔥 JESUS IS CALLING YOU TO EXPERIENCE HIS LOVE RIGHT NOW!

✔️ IF YOU ARE SINGLE, REMEMBER: – You are already loved by Christ!
✔️ IF YOU ARE IN A RELATIONSHIP, REMEMBER: – Only Jesus can complete you!
✔️ IF YOU FEEL UNLOVED, REMEMBER: – God’s love is the only love that never fails!
🚨 THE LOVE YOU’VE BEEN SEARCHING FOR IS FOUND IN JESUS!
💡 WILL YOU RECEIVE HIS LOVE TODAY?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DON’T SETTLE FOR TEMPORARY LOVE—CHOOSE ETERNAL LOVE!
📖 Romans 8:38-39 – "Nothing can separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Worldly love that fades?
❌ Human relationships that can disappoint?
✔️ The love of Jesus that never fails?
🚨 TRUE LOVE IS NOT FOUND IN A PERSON—IT’S FOUND IN CHRIST!
💡 WILL YOU SURRENDER TO HIS LOVE TODAY?

🙏 PRAYER TO RECEIVE THE LOVE OF JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I confess that I have been searching for love in the wrong places. I now realize that Your love is the only love that satisfies. Thank You for dying on the cross for me. I accept Your love, and I surrender my life to You. Fill my heart with Your presence and lead me in Your ways. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"

title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE SALT OF THE EARTH – ARE YOU LOSING YOUR FLAVOR? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE SALT OF THE EARTH – ARE YOU LOSING YOUR FLAVOR? 🔥
📖 Matthew 5:13 – "You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what did Jesus mean when He called us the ‘Salt of the Earth’? How does this apply to us today?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people read this verse but don’t understand the full depth of its meaning.
🚨 Today, we will break down this powerful parable, explore its biblical and historical context, and reveal what it means for YOU as a follower of Christ!
⚠️ WARNING: If you are not living as salt, you may already be losing your purpose!

🔥 1. WHAT DID JESUS MEAN BY "SALT OF THE EARTH"?
📖 Mark 9:50 – "Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other."
🔥 SALT IN BIBLICAL TIMES HAD 3 MAIN PURPOSES:

✔️ Preservation – In ancient times, salt was used to preserve food and prevent decay.
✔️ Flavor – Salt enhances taste and brings out the best in food.
✔️ Purification – Salt was used in rituals for cleansing and purification.

💡 JESUS WAS SAYING THAT BELIEVERS SHOULD BE:
✔️ A PRESERVING FORCE against moral decay in the world.
✔️ ADDING GODLY FLAVOR by living righteously.
✔️ PURE AND HOLY in their walk with God.
🚨 If salt loses these qualities, it becomes useless.
💡 Are you truly acting as the Salt of the Earth?

🔥 2. WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO "LOSE YOUR SALTINESS"?
📖 Luke 14:34-35 – "Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, it is useless, neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out."

🔥 WHEN A CHRISTIAN LOSES THEIR "SALTINESS," IT MEANS THEY HAVE:
❌ Compromised with sin and become like the world.
❌ Lost their boldness in sharing the Gospel.
❌ Stopped standing for truth in a corrupt culture.
❌ Become spiritually dull and no longer make an impact.
💡 IF YOU BLEND IN WITH THE WORLD, YOU ARE LOSING YOUR FLAVOR!
🚨 Jesus warns that when salt becomes useless, it is thrown out!
💡 Are you influencing the world, or is the world influencing you?

🔥 3. HOW TO REMAIN SALTY – STAY STRONG IN FAITH!
📖 Colossians 4:6 – "Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone."
🔥 TO REMAIN "SALTY," YOU MUST:

✔️ Stay in the Word of God! (Psalm 119:105)
✔️ Be bold in sharing your faith! (Romans 1:16)
✔️ Stand against sin and compromise! (James 4:4)
✔️ Live a life that glorifies Jesus! (Matthew 5:16)
✔️ Stay connected to the Holy Spirit! (Galatians 5:16)
🚀 CHALLENGE: Will you stay salty for Christ, or will you let the world dilute your faith?

🔥 4. WARNING: THE DANGER OF BEING A LUKEWARM CHRISTIAN!
📖 Revelation 3:16 – "Because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth."

🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU TO LOSE YOUR SALTINESS!
❌ He wants you to stay quiet about your faith.
❌ He wants you to blend in and fear standing for truth.
❌ He wants you to be spiritually dead!
🔥 BUT JESUS CALLS YOU TO BE A LIGHT IN THE DARKNESS!
💡 Are you boldly living for Christ, or are you hiding your faith?

🔥 5. FINAL WARNING – WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
📖 Joshua 24:15 – "Choose this day whom you will serve… but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay silent, compromise, and be cast aside?
✔️ Stand boldly for Jesus, no matter the cost?
🚨 THE WORLD NEEDS CHRISTIANS WHO REFUSE TO LOSE THEIR FLAVOR!
💡 WILL YOU BE ONE OF THEM?

🙏 PRAYER TO REMAIN STRONG IN FAITH!
"Lord Jesus, help me to be the Salt of the Earth. Strengthen my faith so I do not compromise with the world. Give me boldness to stand for truth and live in holiness. Use me to impact others for Your Kingdom. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"

title: 🔥 HOW CAN WE GLORIFY GOD? DOES GIVING MONEY PLEASE HIM? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 HOW CAN WE GLORIFY GOD? DOES GIVING MONEY PLEASE HIM? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, I faithfully pay my tithes every month and even give extra. Does this mean I’m glorifying God? Can we glorify Him with money?"
🚨 MANY THINK GIVING MONEY = GLORIFYING GOD! But is this really true? Can financial giving alone bring glory to God? Or is there something deeper that God desires from us?
📖 Key Verse: "So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31)

🔥 1. WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO GLORIFY GOD?
📖 Psalm 29:2 – "Give unto the Lord the glory due to His name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness."
To glorify God means to honor, magnify, and reflect His greatness in our lives. It is not just about what we give, but how we live!

✔️ Glorifying God is not about money—it’s about the heart.
✔️ It means living in obedience, worship, and surrender to His will.
✔️ It is about reflecting Christ in everything we do.
🚨 If money alone glorified God, then the richest people on earth would be the holiest! But that is not the case.

🔥 2. CAN WE GLORIFY GOD WITH MONEY? YES, BUT…
📖 Proverbs 3:9 – "Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce."
Yes, money CAN be used to glorify God, but it is not about the amount—it is about the heart behind it!

✔️ GOD LOOKS AT OUR MOTIVES, NOT JUST OUR GIVING.
✔️ GOD WANTS US TO BE GENEROUS, NOT JUST RELIGIOUS.
✔️ MONEY SHOULD NEVER REPLACE OBEDIENCE AND HOLINESS.

🚨 EXAMPLE: The Pharisees gave large amounts of money, yet Jesus rebuked them because their hearts were far from God (Mark 7:6). Meanwhile, a poor widow gave only two small coins, and Jesus said she gave more than the rich! (Luke 21:1-4)

🔥 3. WAYS TO GLORIFY GOD BEYOND MONEY!
📖 Romans 12:1 – "Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship."
💡 MONEY IS JUST ONE WAY TO HONOR GOD. HERE ARE OTHER WAYS TO GLORIFY HIM!

✔️ OBEDIENCE TO HIS WORD (John 14:15) – Living in holiness brings more glory than any amount of money.
✔️ LOVING OTHERS (John 13:35) – Treating others with kindness, forgiveness, and humility.
✔️ SHARING THE GOSPEL (Matthew 28:19-20) – Leading people to Jesus glorifies Him more than tithes ever could!
✔️ USING YOUR TALENTS FOR GOD (Colossians 3:23) – Serving God with your gifts, whether in music, teaching, or helping others.
✔️ LIVING A LIFE OF THANKSGIVING (1 Thessalonians 5:18) – A heart of gratitude glorifies God.
✔️ FIGHTING SIN DAILY (Galatians 5:16) – Overcoming temptation shows we truly love Him.
🚨 MONEY CAN NEVER REPLACE OBEDIENCE, HOLINESS, AND TRUE WORSHIP!

🔥 4. WHAT IF SOMEONE GIVES MONEY BUT LIVES IN SIN?
📖 Isaiah 1:13-15 – "Stop bringing meaningless offerings! Your incense is detestable to me… When you spread out your hands in prayer, I hide my eyes from you."
💡 MANY THINK GIVING MONEY COVERS THEIR SIN—BUT GOD DOESN’T WORK THAT WAY!

❌ Someone who tithes but cheats on their spouse is NOT glorifying God.
❌ Someone who donates to church but gossips, lies, or lives in lust is NOT glorifying God.
❌ Someone who pays tithes but refuses to forgive others is NOT glorifying God.
🚨 God is not impressed by money—He is looking for true worshipers! (John 4:23-24)

🔥 5. WHAT KIND OF GIVING DOES GOD LOVE?
📖 2 Corinthians 9:7 – "God loves a cheerful giver."
💡 GOD BLESSES GIVING THAT COMES FROM A PURE HEART!

✔️ Give with JOY, not guilt.
✔️ Give out of LOVE, not obligation.
✔️ Give with THANKSGIVING, not to buy favor from God.
🚨 GOD DOES NOT NEED YOUR MONEY—HE WANTS YOUR HEART!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I will glorify God in everything I do—not just with money, but with my entire life! My obedience, worship, and love for Jesus will be my highest offering!"

🔥 THE GLORY CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you glorifying God beyond your giving?
✅ Step 3: Live to please God, not just in church, but in everything you do!
🔥 #GlorifyGod #WorshipInSpiritAndTruth #FaithOverMoney #JesusAtTheCenter #BiblicalTruth #GospelWarrior #johnxasis

title: 🔥 WHO GAVE YOU AUTHORITY TO PREACH? DO YOU HAVE A CHURCH? ARE YOU A PASTOR OR A PRIEST? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 WHO GAVE YOU AUTHORITY TO PREACH? DO YOU HAVE A CHURCH? ARE YOU A PASTOR OR A PRIEST? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, who are you to teach us? Are you a pastor or a priest? Why do you call yourself 'brother'? Who gave you the authority to preach? Why are you preaching here on Facebook—don’t you have a church?"
🚨 THESE QUESTIONS ARE COMMON, BUT THE ANSWER IS SIMPLE—THE BIBLE GIVES EVERY BELIEVER THE AUTHORITY TO SHARE THE GOSPEL!
📖 Key Verse: "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation." (Mark 16:15)
🔥 THE REAL QUESTION IS NOT "WHO CALLED ME?" BUT "WHY AREN’T YOU PREACHING TOO?" 🔥

🔥 1. DO YOU NEED TO BE A PASTOR OR PRIEST TO PREACH THE GOSPEL?
📖 Matthew 28:19-20 – "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you."
💡 JESUS GAVE THE COMMAND TO EVERY DISCIPLE—NOT JUST PASTORS!

✔️ The disciples were not priests—they were fishermen, tax collectors, and common men! (Acts 4:13)
✔️ The early church was filled with ordinary believers preaching everywhere! (Acts 8:4)
✔️ The Great Commission is for every follower of Christ, not just religious leaders! (Matthew 28:19)
🚨 IF YOU BELIEVE IN JESUS, YOU HAVE THE RESPONSIBILITY TO SHARE THE GOSPEL!

🔥 2. WHO GAVE ME AUTHORITY TO PREACH?
📖 Acts 1:8 – "But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."
💡 MY AUTHORITY COMES FROM JESUS CHRIST AND THE HOLY SPIRIT!

✔️ God calls His servants—Not a church organization! (Galatians 1:11-12)
✔️ Jesus Himself appoints His messengers! (John 15:16)
✔️ The Holy Spirit gives power and wisdom to preach! (Acts 1:8)
🚨 MY CALLING COMES FROM GOD, NOT MAN! IF GOD SAYS "PREACH," I WILL PREACH!

🔥 3. WHY DO I PREACH ON FACEBOOK? DON’T I HAVE A CHURCH?
📖 Romans 10:14 – "How can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?"
💡 THE GOSPEL MUST BE PREACHED EVERYWHERE—INCLUDING SOCIAL MEDIA!

✔️ The early disciples preached in streets, houses, marketplaces—not in buildings! (Acts 5:42)
✔️ The church is not a building—the church is the people! (1 Corinthians 3:16)
✔️ Jesus Himself preached outside in public places! (Luke 5:1-3)
🚨 IF SOCIAL MEDIA REACHES MILLIONS, WHY WOULD I STAY SILENT?

🔥 4. WHY DO I CALL MYSELF "BROTHER" AND NOT "PASTOR" OR "PRIEST"?
📖 Matthew 23:8-10 – "But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers. And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and He is in heaven."
💡 TITLES DO NOT GIVE SPIRITUAL AUTHORITY—OBEDIENCE TO GOD DOES!

✔️ Jesus told us to be humble and not seek religious titles! (Matthew 23:8)
✔️ The apostles called each other "brothers" because they were all equal in Christ! (Romans 1:13)
✔️ God cares about FAITHFULNESS, not titles! (1 Corinthians 4:1-2)
🚨 I AM A SERVANT OF GOD, AND THAT IS ENOUGH!

🔥 5. WHAT IF YOU THINK I HAVE NO RIGHT TO PREACH?
📖 1 Corinthians 1:27 – "But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong."
💡 GOD USES ORDINARY PEOPLE TO DO EXTRAORDINARY THINGS!

✔️ MOSES had no confidence, but God used him to deliver Israel! (Exodus 4:10-12)

title: 🔥 GODLY MARRIAGE VS. WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS—WHICH ONE DO YOU HAVE? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 GODLY MARRIAGE VS. WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS—WHICH ONE DO YOU HAVE? 🔥
📖 Ephesians 5:25 – "Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her."

🚨 IT'S VALENTINE’S DAY—BUT LET ME ASK YOU A SERIOUS QUESTION:
💡 Is your relationship built on God, or just emotions?
💔 Are you in a godly marriage, or are you trapped in a worldly relationship?
The world has twisted love into something temporary, selfish, and full of compromise. But God designed love and marriage to be sacred, selfless, and eternal!
🔥 TODAY, YOU WILL DISCOVER THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN GODLY LOVE & WORLDLY LOVE!

🔥 1. THE FOUNDATION OF TRUE LOVE—WHAT IS IT BUILT ON?
📖 Matthew 7:24-27 – "A wise man builds his house on the rock… but a foolish man builds his house on the sand."

✔️ GODLY MARRIAGE is built on CHRIST—the rock that never fails.
❌ WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS are built on EMOTIONS, MONEY, or LUST—things that fade!
🚨 IF YOUR RELATIONSHIP IS NOT BUILT ON GOD, IT WILL NOT LAST!
💡 QUESTION: Is your relationship growing in Christ, or just surviving on emotions?

🔥 2. WORLDLY LOVE IS SELFISH—GODLY LOVE IS SACRIFICIAL!
📖 1 Corinthians 13:4-7 – "Love is patient, love is kind… it does not seek its own."
🔥 HERE’S THE DIFFERENCE:
❌ WORLDLY LOVE:

Loves only when it feels good.
Wants to take, not give.
Full of lust, lies, and broken promises.
Ends when problems come.
✔️ GODLY LOVE:

Commits even when it’s hard.
Loves through sacrifice and selflessness.
Is faithful, pure, and built on trust.
Endures all seasons.
🚨 IF YOUR RELATIONSHIP IS BASED ON LUST, IT WILL FAIL!
💡 QUESTION: Is your love self-centered or Christ-centered?

🔥 3. GODLY MARRIAGE HONORS GOD—WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS HONOR THE FLESH!
📖 2 Corinthians 6:14 – "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers."
❌ WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS:

Compromise God’s standards for love.
Put pleasure over purity.
Ignore God’s commandments for marriage.
✔️ GODLY MARRIAGE:

Honors purity and holiness.
Follows biblical roles of husband and wife.
Puts Christ at the center.
🚨 MANY ARE TRAPPED IN RELATIONSHIPS GOD NEVER APPROVED!
💡 QUESTION: Does your relationship glorify God—or lead you away from Him?

🔥 4. GODLY LOVE LASTS FOREVER—WORLDLY LOVE FADES!
📖 Mark 10:9 – "What God has joined together, let no man separate."
❌ WORLDLY LOVE:

Based on feelings, attraction, and emotions.
Easily destroyed by temptations and trials.
Leads to heartbreak and broken families.
✔️ GODLY LOVE:

Rooted in God’s unchanging Word.
Strengthened through prayer and faith.
A reflection of Christ’s love for the Church.
🚨 WORLDLY LOVE BREAKS—BUT GODLY LOVE ENDURES!
💡 QUESTION: Are you chasing temporary love or eternal love?

🔥 5. HOW TO BUILD A GODLY MARRIAGE & LOVE THAT LASTS!
📖 Ecclesiastes 4:12 – "A cord of three strands is not quickly broken."
🔥 HERE’S HOW TO KEEP GOD FIRST IN YOUR RELATIONSHIP:

✔️ PRAY TOGETHER DAILY – Strengthen your bond in Christ.
✔️ STUDY GOD’S WORD TOGETHER – Build a marriage that lasts.
✔️ FORGIVE QUICKLY – Don’t let the devil create division.
✔️ SERVE GOD AS A COUPLE – Love grows when it’s rooted in faith.
✔️ PUT CHRIST ABOVE YOUR FEELINGS – Love is a commitment, not just emotions!
🚨 IF JESUS IS NOT THE CENTER, THE RELATIONSHIP WILL CRUMBLE!
💡 QUESTION: Will you commit to putting God first in your relationship?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: IF GOD IS NOT IN YOUR LOVE LIFE, YOU’RE HEADED FOR DISASTER!
📖 Proverbs 16:3 – "Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and He will establish your plans."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Temporary love that fades?
❌ Relationships built on lust and emotions?
✔️ A marriage that honors God and lasts forever?
🚨 DON’T SETTLE FOR LESS THAN GOD’S BEST!
💡 WILL YOU SURRENDER YOUR LOVE LIFE TO JESUS TODAY?

🙏 PRAYER FOR A GODLY RELATIONSHIP!
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my love life to You. I refuse to settle for a relationship that dishonors You. Teach me to wait on Your best and build a love that glorifies You. Protect my heart from worldly love and help me to seek You first in all things. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"

title: 🔥 MARRIAGE IS A COVENANT, NOT A CONTRACT—WHAT DOES THAT MEAN? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 MARRIAGE IS A COVENANT, NOT A CONTRACT—WHAT DOES THAT MEAN? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, I always hear that marriage is a covenant, but I don’t fully understand what that means. How is it different from a contract?"

🚨 MANY PEOPLE GET MARRIAGE WRONG! In today’s world, marriage is treated like a legal contract that can be broken at any time. But God designed marriage as a holy covenant—an unbreakable bond that reflects Christ and His Church!
📖 Key Verse: "So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore, what God has joined together, let no one separate." (Matthew 19:6)

🔥 1. WHAT IS A CONTRACT? THE WORLD'S VIEW OF MARRIAGE
A contract is a legal agreement between two people that can be broken if one party fails to meet certain expectations.

✔️ Contracts are based on terms and conditions.
✔️ They are made to protect personal interests.
✔️ If one person fails or changes their mind, the contract can be canceled.

🚨 EXAMPLE: Many couples today treat marriage like a business deal. They say things like:
❌ "If you stop making me happy, I’m leaving."
❌ "If you don’t meet my needs, I’ll find someone else."
❌ "If I fall out of love, I’m done."
This is why divorce rates are skyrocketing! People enter marriage thinking it’s just an agreement they can end if things get hard.

🔥 2. WHAT IS A COVENANT? GOD'S DESIGN FOR MARRIAGE
📖 Malachi 2:14 – "The Lord is the witness between you and the wife of your youth. She is your partner, the wife of your marriage covenant."
A covenant is not just a legal agreement—it is a holy, unbreakable vow before God.

✔️ A covenant is based on unconditional love, not conditions.
✔️ It is a lifelong commitment—until death.
✔️ It reflects God’s unchanging love for His people.
🔥 MARRIAGE IS A BLOOD COVENANT! In biblical times, covenants were sealed by blood—just like Jesus’ sacrifice for us. This is why God takes marriage so seriously!

🔥 3. MARRIAGE REPRESENTS CHRIST AND THE CHURCH!
📖 Ephesians 5:25 – "Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her."
God created marriage to reflect the relationship between Jesus and His Church.

💍 WORLDLY MARRIAGE: Based on emotions, attraction, and personal happiness.
💍 GODLY MARRIAGE: Based on sacrifice, commitment, and unconditional love.
🚨 IF MARRIAGE WAS JUST A CONTRACT, JESUS WOULD HAVE LEFT US LONG AGO! But His love is a covenant! He doesn’t abandon us when we fail—He loves us unconditionally.

🔥 4. WHY DO SO MANY MARRIAGES FAIL?
📖 Hosea 4:6 – "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge."
Many marriages fail because people don’t understand that marriage is a covenant. They enter marriage with a worldly mindset instead of a biblical foundation.

❌ COMMON MARRIAGE LIES:
✔️ "If I’m not happy, I can leave."
✔️ "I deserve better."
✔️ "Love is just a feeling."
✔️ "If we have problems, divorce is the answer."
🚨 SATAN HATES GODLY MARRIAGE! The devil attacks marriages because strong, Christ-centered marriages build strong families—and strong families build a strong Church!

🔥 5. HOW TO BUILD A STRONG, COVENANT MARRIAGE
📖 Ecclesiastes 4:12 – "A cord of three strands is not quickly broken."
A successful biblical marriage requires three people: Husband, Wife, and God.

✔️ MAKE JESUS THE CENTER – Pray together, study the Bible, and put God first.
✔️ COMMIT EVEN WHEN IT'S HARD – Love is a choice, not just a feeling.
✔️ FORGIVE LIKE CHRIST FORGAVE YOU – No marriage is perfect, but God’s grace is enough.
✔️ GUARD YOUR MARRIAGE FROM TEMPTATION – Avoid situations that could lead to sin.
🚨 A GODLY MARRIAGE TAKES WORK, BUT IT IS WORTH IT!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I choose to honor God’s design for marriage! I commit to love unconditionally, forgive, and build a covenant relationship that glorifies Him!"

🔥 THE COVENANT MARRIAGE CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Apply these truths to your marriage today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 married couples who need to hear this.
🔥 #MarriageGodsWay #CovenantLove #JesusAtTheCenter #BiblicalMarriage #FaithOverFeelings #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis

title: 🔥 SPIRITUAL WARFARE IN MARRIAGE – DEFEATING THE ENEMY! 🔥
paragraphs:

📖 Ecclesiastes 4:12 – "Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken."

🔥 YES! SATAN HATES GODLY MARRIAGES!

🚨 ARE THESE ATTACKS HAPPENING IN YOUR MARRIAGE?

🚨 MARRIAGE WITHOUT SPIRITUAL DEFENSES IS AN EASY TARGET FOR SATAN!
💡 ARE YOU GUARDING YOUR HOME OR LEAVING IT WIDE OPEN FOR THE ENEMY?

🔥 3. THE POWER OF A CORD OF THREE STRANDS
📖 Ecclesiastes 4:12 – "A cord of three strands is not quickly broken."
🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?

✔️ ONE STRAND = YOU – You have your own personal faith journey.
✔️ SECOND STRAND = YOUR SPOUSE – Your spouse has their own relationship with God.
✔️ THIRD STRAND = JESUS CHRIST – When Jesus is at the center, the marriage is unbreakable!
🚨 MARRIAGE WITHOUT JESUS IS WEAK AND VULNERABLE!
💡 IS JESUS THE FOUNDATION OF YOUR MARRIAGE?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DON’T FIGHT YOUR SPOUSE—FIGHT THE DEVIL TOGETHER!
📖 Mark 10:9 – "Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Continue allowing Satan to attack your home?
❌ Blame each other instead of fighting the real enemy?
✔️ Stand together as warriors for your marriage?
🚨 THE WAR IS NOT AGAINST YOUR SPOUSE—IT’S AGAINST THE DEVIL!
💡 WILL YOU FIGHT FOR YOUR MARRIAGE, OR LET THE ENEMY WIN?

🙏 PRAYER TO PROTECT YOUR MARRIAGE!
"Lord Jesus, I recognize that my marriage is under attack, but I will not let the enemy win! I surrender my relationship to You. Protect my spouse and me from division, pride, and temptation. Help us to grow in faith, love, and unity. Be the third strand in our marriage, making us strong and unbreakable! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"

title: I DON’T SHARE THE WORD OF GOD FOR MONEY.
paragraphs: I DON’T SHARE THE WORD OF GOD FOR MONEY.

In fact, my Facebook has been blocked from monetization since I started sharing God’s Word. And you know what? I DON'T CARE. Because this is not for me. This is for HIS GLORY ALONE.
